items.title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared!
items.subtitle: English {ASS}
items.description: The last boss of a great battle with heroes returns 200 years after her defeat to explore the world and its changes since her time.

items.title: Firefly Wedding
items.subtitle: English-Signs + English Dialogue + Dubtitle {ASS}
items.description: When the beautiful noblewoman Satoko is targeted for execution by the assassin Shinpei, she proposes a fake marriage to keep him at bay, leading to a dark, obsessive romance.

items.title: The Apothecary Diaries
items.subtitle: English-Sign + English Dialogue + Dubtitle {ASS}
items.description: A young maiden is kidnapped and sold into servitude at the emperor’s palace, where she secretly employs her pharmacist skills with the help of the head eunuch to unravel medical mysteries in the inner court.

items.title: Ameku M.D. Doctor Detective
items.subtitle: English-Signs & Songs + Dialogue
items.description: Follow the genius doctor Takao Ameku as she solves a series of medical mysteries!.

items.title: The Detective Is Already Dead
items.subtitle: English-Sign + English Dialogue + Dubtitle {ASS}
items.description: After thwarting a hijacking with beautiful, silver-haired detective Siesta, Kimihiko leads a life of globe-trotting and crime-solving—until Siesta dies. A year later, a new case will open old wounds as it threads murder, conspiracy, and his dead partner!

items.title: Psyren
items.subtitle: English-Sign + English Dialogue + Dubtitle {ASS}
items.description: Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious “red phone card” left behind in a public telephone booth. A few days later, his childhood friend and classmate, Sakurako Amamiya-who possessed the same card-suddenly vanishes without a trace.

items.title: Even Though I’m a Super Timid Noble Girl, I Accepted the Bet from My Cunning Fiancé
items.subtitle: Hindi,Tamil,Telugu-Signs + English Dialogue {ASS}
items.description: Pia Rockwell is a minor villainess in the game Caroline and the Rainbow Magic Sweets. At the end of the game, she’s destined to be judged at her graduation party, see her engagement broken off, and be banished from the kingdom. Realizing she’s doomed, Pia offers to end her engagement with Rufus Stan…but this only inspires the proud chancellor’s son to make a bet with her about their future!

items.title: Naruto: Shippuden
items.subtitle: English  (Softcoded)
items.description: The war is stopped to a halt as the series decides to dive into Kakashi’s past in the Anbu. It also includes Itachi and Yamato’s days in the Anbu as well.

items.title: Naruto: Shippuden
items.subtitle: English  (Softcoded)
items.description: In an interesting turn of events, Obito becomes the Jinchuriki for the Ten-Tails. Naruto and his father, Minato, also get to work together and fight against him. The five Kage also fight against Madara to try to stop him once and for all.

items.title: Overgeared
items.subtitle: English,Hindi,Tamil,Telugu-Signs + English Dialogue + Dubtitle {ASS}
items.description: Escape everyday life in SATISFY, a VR game where players earn real-world fame and fortune. One player, Grid, can’t seem to catch a break in the game or in real life. That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he’s leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.

items.title: Black Torch
items.subtitle: English-Sign + English Dialogue + Dubtitle {ASS}
items.description: Jiro Azuma comes from a ninja lineage and was trained by his grandfather in shinobi arts. He can communicate with animals. His life changes dramatically after meeting an injured black cat named Rago in the forest.

items.title: Black Clover
items.subtitle: English-Signs & Songs + Dialogue
items.description: Asta and Yuno were abandoned together at the same church and have been inseparable since. As children, they promised that they would compete against each other to see who would become the next Emperor Magus.

items.description: Asta and Yuno were abandoned together at the same church and have been inseparable since. As children, they promised that they would compete against each other to see who would become the next Emperor Magus.

items.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation
items.subtitle: English-Sign + English Dialogue + Dubtitle {ASS}
items.description: A 34-year-old underachiever gets run over by a bus, but his story isn’t over. Reincarnated as an infant, he’ll embark on an epic adventure.

items.title: Tomb Raider King
items.subtitle: English-Sign + English Dialogue + Dubtitle {ASS}
items.description: God-like tombs surface globally, granting magical relics. Betrayed and left for dead, elite hunter Jooheon travels 15 years into the past to loot every tomb, hoard artifacts, and execute revenge.

items.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life
items.subtitle: English,Hindi,Tamil,Telugu-Signs + English Dialogue + Dubtitle {ASS}
items.description: Once the Demon King, now a shut-in NEET—Ryusei Narukami’s second life is anything but peaceful! When Meteor Hanaori, the Hero who once defeated him, suddenly returns as a normal high school girl, his world is thrown into chaos. Determined to change, Ryusei reenters society as a teacher and ends up teaching at her school! Their explosive reunion reignites the past—and sparks an unexpected love! Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Season 1

items.title: Crushed
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After a month and a half hiatus, the newly christened

items.title: Khakee - The Bihar Chapter
items.subtitle: English
items.description: As a righteous cop pursues a merciless criminal in Bihar, he finds himself navigating a deadly chase and a moral battle mired in corruption.

items.title: Hostel Daze
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After experiencing the exhilarating freedom of the initial years and having had their fair share of fun in the past two years; Ankit, Akanksha, Jaat, Jhantoo, Nabomita and Chirag take on the third year, a roller coaster ride of newer awakenings and unique experiences.

items.title: Flames
items.subtitle: English
items.description: As Ishita (Tanya Maniktala) and Rajat (Ritvik Sahore) enter a more mature phase of their relationship, they must endure newer and bigger obstacles.

items.title: The Lord of the Rings
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Coming to screens for the very first time the heroic legends of the fabled Second Age of Middle-earth's history. This epic drama is set thousands of years before the events of J.R.R. Tolkiens The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings, and will take viewers back to an era in which great powers were forged, kingdoms rose to glory and fell to ruin, unlikely heroes were tested, hope hung by the finest of threads, and the greatest villain that ever flowed from Tolkien’s pen threatened to cover all the world in darkness.

items.title: Suzhal: The Vortex
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Created by Pushkar and Gayatri, Suzhal - The Vortex is a crime thriller that goes beyond the routine investigation and threatens to shake up the cultural societal fabric, when a crime hits a small town in India. Set against the backdrop of an unique micro-festival, ancient myths collide with the troubling present as we are drawn into the eye of the storm.

items.title: Aashram
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Primarily based on the activities of a self-proclaimed godman, Gurmeet Ram Rahim.Baba Nirala (Bobby Deol) is ruthless and relies on corrupt politicians to gain power while preying on innocent women. Baba, being a conman, hides his true intentions from the public like a pro and fools his devotees by wearing a mask of pretence.When the cops find skeletons and dead bodies buried in the Ashram property, it hints at various mysteries.Will the cops be able to unearth Baba’s crimes?

items.title: Panchayat
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Panchayat is a comedy-drama set in Uttar Pradesh’s Phullera village. Abhishek Tripathi (Jitendra Kumar), a fresh engineering graduate, reluctantly takes up the job of a secretary in Phullera’s panchayat (village council) office.Born and brought up in the city, the slow-paced lifestyle of rural India is alien to him. So is the idea of the panchayat office doubling up as his residence. Naturally, he finds himself tangled up in boredom, discomfort and frustration- lashing out at every chance he gets.

items.title: Panchayat
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An engineering graduate, Abhishek, is unable to find a job of his caliber. So, he ends up working for a panchayat in a remote Indian village and deals with several mundane challenges. As Abhishek settles, the village sees the rise of an opponent against Pradhan Ji and village politics of Phulera heats up.

items.title: I Became a Legend After My 10 Year-Long Last Stand
items.subtitle: English {ASS}
items.description: S-rank mage Luck sacrifices everything to defeat the Demon King. Returning ten years later to a world that mourns him as a dead legend, he hides his identity and starts over as “Lock,” an F-rank adventurer building a new life from scratch.

items.title: The Elusive Samurai
items.subtitle: Hindi Sings + English Dialogues
items.description: After a massacre, Tokiyuki flees with loyal retainers including Suwa Yorishige, who predicts Tokiyuki will rule Japan. Their priority is escaping enemy territory.

items.title: Chainsmoker Cat
items.subtitle: English-Signs + Dialogue
items.description: Catgirl Yani struggles to pay her rent and keep a job while feeding her smoking habit. As her loved ones’ concerns grow, she must rethink her future.

items.title: Trapped in a Dating Sim
items.subtitle: English-Sign + English Dialogue + Dubtitle {ASS}
items.description: A young man is transported into a video game world dominated by females.

items.title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
items.subtitle: English-Sign + English Dialogue + Dubtitle {ASS}
items.description: When enchantment mage Rein is dismissed from his guild after buffing all their gear, he reclaims every enhancement for himself. Armed with only basic equipment and stolen power, he embarks on an overpowered adventure from scratch.

items.title: First Dragon (Yuan Long)
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A story where Wang Sheng enters a fantasy soul world and merges with a carp’s soul. Despite facing ridicule, he persists in challenging established beliefs about the soul realm.

items.title: Blue Box
items.subtitle: English-Signs + Dialogue + Dubtitle
items.description: Third-year student Taiki joins badminton club. Despite being an early riser, star player Chinatsu, his crush, arrives first. Living together unexpectedly, Taiki strives to reach Nationals to impress Chinatsu.

items.title: Ranma 1/2 (2024)
items.subtitle: English-Signs + Dialogue + Dubtitle
items.description: Akane Tendo meets her new fiancé, Ranma Saotome, a martial arts prodigy with a twist: he magically transforms into a girl upon touching cold water.

items.title: Grand Blue Dreaming
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A college student spends his year at the seaside town of Izu, having fun on the beach with his school friends.

items.title: Black Butler
items.subtitle: English-Signs & Songs + Dialogue
items.description: Butler Sebastian Michaelis works with his 13-year-old master, the earl Ciel Phantomhive, to do the dirty work of “the Queen’s guard dog” in nineteenth century England’s gritty underworld.

items.title: Baki
items.subtitle: English-Signs + Dialogue [Softcoded]
items.description: While martial arts champion Baki Hanma trains hard to surpass his legendary father, five violent death row inmates descend upon Tokyo to take him on.

items.title: Horimiya
items.subtitle: English-Signs & Songs + Dialogue [Softcoded]
items.description: Two very different people—a popular, academically successful schoolgirl and a quiet schoolboy—meet and develop a friendship. As they get to know each other, they discover unexpected sides of one another.

items.title: Horimiya: The Missing Pieces
items.subtitle: English-Sign + Dialogue, Hindi {ASS} [Softcoded]
items.description: As graduation approaches, Kyouko Hori, Izumi Miyamura, and their friends look back on their high school experiences, exploring moments and stories that were not shown in the original series.

items.title: Minions & Monsters
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Follows the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they search for frightening creatures for their monster movie, partner with a green creature, and must save the planet after unleashing monsters.

items.title: ImMature
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Sixteen-year-old Dhruv (Omkar Kulkarni) is crushing hard on his classmate Chhavi (Rashmi Agdekar). As he tries to woo her with help from his friends — bad-boy Kabir (Chinmay Chandraunshuh), and colour-blind Susu (Visshesh Tiwari) — the trio experience the many faces of teenage years.

items.title: The Boys
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Vought International is now headed by the money-driven Stan Edgar (Giancarlo Esposito) and has welcomed a new member in the Seven: Stormfront (Aya Cash). Homelander (Antony Star) has handed over the drug Compound V to super-terrorists and Billy Butcher (Karl Urban) is in hiding after being framed for murdering Madelyn Stillwell (Elisabeth Shue). Also in hiding are The Boys: Hughie (Jack Quaid), Mother’s Milk (Laz Alonso), Frenchie (Tomer Capon), and Kimiko (Karen Fukuhara). The vigilantes can come out of the hiding only if they can expose Vought's secret of cooking up superheroes in a lab.

items.title: The Boys
items.subtitle: English
items.description: With Ryan (Cameron Crovetti) turning against his father Homelander (Antony Starr) after accidentally killing his own mother, and Hughie (Jack Quaid) taking up a job in Neuman’s (Claudia Doumit) office without realising that she is the superpowered assassin, season three of The Boys will be picking up at an interesting note. The show will be including one of the most popular storylines of the comic, Herogasm, an isolated annual Vought event for the superheroes fiddled with drugs, sex, and any other form of legal or illegal amusement. A company-sponsored orgy festival if you will.

items.title: The Boys
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The Boys is a television adaptation of DC Comic’s anti-superhero series of the same name. It is set in a universe where'' superpowered individuals work for a powerful corporate organisation called Vought Interna tional. While these heroic figures, grouped as the popular Seven are almost worshipped by the general public, in reality they are evil, corrupt, arrogant, and insensitive to the collateral damage to the innocent. The Boys is a group of human vigilantes who are on a mission to bring down Vought International and the villainous superheroes.

items.title: Vadhuvu
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Avika Gor-starrer Vadhuvu is now available for streaming on Hotstar. The show is based on the Bengali web series Indu and is directed by Poluru Krishna. Let’s see how it is.

items.title: Chamak
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After returning to Punjab from Canada, an aspiring young rapper learns that his father, a legendary singer, was shot dead during a performance along with his mother. He steers his way through the underbelly of the Punjab music industry, politics and business feuds with a fierce determination to unmask his parents’ killer. The power-packed musical thriller stars Paramvir Singh Cheema, Isha Talwar, Manoj Pahwa, Gippy Grewal, Mohit Malik and Mukesh Chhabra.

items.title: Dhootha
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In this supernatural horror, possessed inanimate objects wreak havoc on the lives of people who commit deadly sins.

items.title: Shehar Lakhot
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A neo-noir series about a man who reluctantly returns to his hometown where'' he not only battles his past demons, but also gets drawn into an even bigger cesspool of smoke and mirrors and must now prove his innocence.

items.title: The Village
items.subtitle: English
items.description: India’s first show based on a graphic novel, The Village follows a family on a road trip that falls victim to a clan of mutants.

items.title: The Railway Men
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Yash Raj Films forays into the streaming originals space with this tribute to the railway workers at Bhopal Station who are considered the unsung heroes of the the world’s biggest man-made industrial disaster, the 1984 Bhopal gas tragedy. “The Bhopal gas tragedy has impacted scores of people since the tragedy struck the city in 1984,” YRF SVP Akshaye Widhani says. “At YRF, we are constantly trying to develop the best compelling stories for audience and this is our tribute to the unsung heroes of the tragedy, that took place 37 years ago, who, despite saving thousands of lives on that fateful day, are still unknown to people across the world.”

items.title: Masterpeace
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In order to end marital discord between a young couple Binoy (Sharaf U Dheen) and Ria (Nithya Menen), their parents get involved.

items.title: Duranga
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Sammit Patel (Amit Sadh) risks everything when a man (Gulshan Devaiah) from his past becomes a threat to him and his family.

items.title: Kaala Paani
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In an invisible battle between humans and nature, individuals try to survive and escape the salty seas of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands in this survival drama series.

items.title: Constable Girpade
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Newbie Constable Mandaar Ghorpade, nicknamed Girpade, follows in his father’s footsteps and joins the police force as a lowly constable presiding over a rich Mumbai neighborhood. Girpade’s father, Senior Constable Amol Ghorpade, died on the job while chasing the notorious criminal Phenyl Mohan, who prides himself on being a master of disguise.

items.title: Mansion 24
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The horror- series centers around supernatural occurances in what is a haunted mansion as those who venture there never return.

items.title: Sultan of Delhi
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Set in 1960s Delhi, Arjun (Tahir Raj Bhasin), with a mysterious past, works for Delhi's biggest illegal arms dealer and aims to dominate the capital.

items.title: The Continental From the World of John Wick {Ep.01-03}
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The series will explore the origin behind the iconic hotel-for-assassins centerpiece of the John Wick universe, through the eyes and actions of a young Winston Scott (Colin Woodell), as he's dragged into the hell-scape of 1970s New York City to face a past he thought he had left behind.

items.title: Mumbai Diaries
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Nine months later, the crew at Bombay General Hospital is back doing what they do best - saving lives. This season our doctors and residents at BGH grapple with an unprecedented natural calamity that brings the city to a standstill, whilst also fighting their own personal battles.

items.title: Choona
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An unlikely group of six band together to take down a common enemy — an all-powerful corrupt politician who has wronged them — using jugaad as their only weapon.

items.title: Gen V
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Set at Godolkin University, America's only college exclusively for young adult superheroes, Gen V explores the lives of hormonal, competitive Supes as they put their physical, sexual, and moral boundaries to the test, competing for the best contracts in the best cities.

items.title: Who s Your Gynac
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Dr Vidushi Kothari, a 28-year-old optimistic OB-GYN struggles with her personal and professional problems while solving clinical cases that come her way.

items.title: Kumari Srimathi
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Srimathi is a 30 year old unmarried woman, with a dead end job, a dysfunctional family and a goal to win back her ancestral house. For that, she needs to raise a lot of money in a short period of time. Seeing a business oppurtunity, she decides to start a bar in her village. This is the journey of Srimathi, battling various societal and moral obstacles along the way.

items.title: Hostel Daze
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The gang prepares themselves for the placement year and give it their all to seek a respectable job before bidding a final adieu to their hostel lives.

items.title: Aakhri Sach
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Investigating officer Anya (Tamannaah Bhatia) tries to solve a case involving the horrific suicide of 11 members of a family. Based on the mass suicide case in Burari in 2018.

items.title: MY3
items.subtitle: English
items.description: We at Newsbugz will not support or encourage any kind of illegal activity. Sharing and downloading copyrighted content is a serious offense. People who violate this copyright and piracy act will be prosecuted by the Indian government. The sentence for doing so is three years in prison and ten lakh rupees fine.

items.title: Kaala
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An Intelligence Bureau officer must solve a case rooted in the underbelly of a crime world, with power, revenge, and action playing in the background.

items.title: Wilderness
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Deliciously twisted thriller starring Jenna Coleman. Liv and Will seem to have it all. A rock-solid marriage. A glamorous new life in New York. Until Liv learns about the affair. Enter the American road trip she’s fantasised about. For Will, it’s a chance to make amends, for Liv it’s a very different prospect – a landscape where'' accidents happen all the time. The perfect place to get revenge.

items.title: Bambai Meri Jaan
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In his quest to clean the mean streets of Bombay and keep in check the rise of organised crime in post-Independence India, an honest cop puts everything on the line, including the thing he wants to protect the most - his family.

items.title: Lucky Guy
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The plot of the web series revolves around a guy named Lucky who enters the world bearing an alignment of stars, making him the luckiest person in the world and earning him a magical necklace. However, as the saying goes, good fortune comes with a cost!

items.title: Leaked
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Following the leak of an MMS clip, the lives of the seniors at Oakwoods high gets turned upside down as they spiral into a web of lies, conspiracies with devastating outcomes! Follow the sordid lives of these miscreants as they try to figure out what actually happened to Rubina in this thrilling tale of love and trust gone wrong.

items.title: The Wheel of Time
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The second season focuses on the arrival of the Seanchan army from across the sea.

items.title: The Freelancer
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A freelancer Avinash Kamath (Mohit Raina) embarks on a rescue mission to find Alia Khan (Kashmira Pardeshi), a young girl who has been held captive in war-torn Syria.

items.title: Scam 2003
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Fruit seller Abdul Karim Telgi (Gagandev Riar) builds a mighty empire by counterfeiting stamp paper and printing fake passports, before he is eventually caught.

items.title: The Lost Flowers of Alice Hart
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After her family suffers a tragedy when she is nine years old, Alice Hart (Alycia Debnam-Carey) is forced to leave her idyllic seaside home. She is taken in by her estranged grandmother June (Sigourney Weaver) at Thornfield Flower farm, where'' she learns that there are secrets within secrets about her and her family’s past.

items.title: Bajao
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The series is set in the Punjabi pop music industry, and follows three young filmmakers Babbar, Ved, and Dhaari (Tanuj Virwani, Sahil Khattar, Sahil Vaid) as they navigate the quirky world of entertainment to become the biggest creators of music videos.

items.title: School Friends
items.subtitle: None
items.description: Stuti is sad as principal announces that this year’s headgirl and headboy will be only from science section.

items.title: Guns and Gulaabs
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An honest cop Arjun (Dulquer Salmaan), bored with his mundane lifestyle, turns to a life of chaos looking to make a quick buck and earn a promotion. However, he must face off with various strange criminals along the way, including Paana Tipu (Rajkummar Rao), 4 Cut Aatmaram (Gulshan Devaiah), and Chhota Ganchi (Aadarsh Gourav). The series serves as an ode to mid-90s bollywood action and crime films.

items.title: Man vs Wild With Sunny Leone
items.subtitle: None
items.description: The host, Sunny Leone, gears up to show her adventurous side as she undertakes several difficult stunts and shares survival strategies in various extreme conditions.

items.title: Taali
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The inspiring story of popular transgender social activist Gauri Sawant, played by Sushmita Sen in this biopic drama. "It is a mark of respect for us that a female actor is playing the role, instead of a male actor, which we have seen in the past," Sawant said.

items.title: Commando
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An action thriller revolving around the life of a commando. Adapted from Vidyut Jamwal-starrer Commando, and set in the same cinematic universe.

items.title: Made in Heaven
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The wedding planning team is back to plan new weddings, face fresh challenges and in the process, chart the journey of their own lives.

items.title: KaalKoot
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Kaalkoot is a suspense-crime drama starring Vijay Verma and Shweta Tripathi Sharma in lead roles. This series portrays the life of a determined police officer trying to bust an acid attack case while juggling his work-life balance.

items.title: Good Omens
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The debut season of this biblical saga ended on a different note than the original 1990 novel, and the second season picks up after the same. The four horsemen of the apocalypse have dismantled, Adam is no longer the Antichrist, and Gabriel and Beelzebub are off to heaven and hell respectively to lick their wounds.

items.title: Good Omens
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Almost 6,000 years have passed since life first began on Earth. Aziraphale (Michael Sheen) and Crowley (David Tennant) — the original guards of the garden of Eden — have been serving as the Ambassadors of heaven and hell since then.

items.title: Secret Invasion
items.subtitle: English
items.description: With Samuel L. Jackson returning as Nick Fury and Ben Mendelsohn as the Skrull Talos — characters who first met in Captain Marvel — the crossover comic event series Secret Invasion showcases a faction of shapeshifting Skrulls, led by Kingsley Ben-Adir's character, who have been infiltrating Earth for years. The series is much smaller in scope than the 2008–09 comic book storyline of the same name, which involved more characters than Avengers: Endgame. Secret Invasion is more about Jackson and Mendelsohn's dynamic, along with the political paranoia embedded in the comic book pages.

items.title: Half CA
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The series revolves around the challenges and experiences faced by Chartered Accountancy students in India. It sheds light on the struggles, aspirations, and intricate lives of these students, as they navigate through the demanding journey of becoming a Chartered Accountant.

items.title: Paurashpur
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Paurashpur is a magnum opus drama of conspiracies, politics, betrayal, patriarchy, lust, and power. With blood-stained swords, grand sets, magnificent costumes, and a dash of erotica, Paurashpur web series unravels the bitter truth behind the reign of an evil king and the women and third gender rising to revolt. Will they succeed?

items.title: Kohrra
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When an NRI bridegroom is found dead days before his wedding, two cops must unravel the troubling case as turbulence unfolds in their own lives.

items.title: Tom Clancys Jack Ryan
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Jack Ryan (John Krasinski) takes over as the new CIA Acting Deputy Director, and is tasked with unearthing internal corruption. He uncovers a series of suspicious black ops that could expose the vulnerability of the country. As Jack and the team investigate how deep the corruption runs, he discovers a far-worse reality—the convergence of a drug cartel with a terrorist organization—ultimately revealing a conspiracy much closer to home and testing our hero’s belief in the system he has always fought to protect.

items.title: The Trial Pyaar, Kaanoon, Dhokha
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A housewife is forced to take full responsibility of her family after her husband is imprisoned over a corruption and sex scandal. Starring Kajol, Kubbra Sait, and Flora Saini in the lead roles.

items.title: College Romance
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Amidst movie nights, adventures, trips, job interviews, and heartfelt farewells, the friends confront their anxieties and insecurities, making their way into the real world in the finale. Will they stumble or stand tall as they step into the real world? Join them on a journey of friendship, self-discovery, and the triumph of embracing their madness!

items.title: Ishq Next Door
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A love story of a boy named Dev (Abhay Mahajan) and a girl named Meher (Natasha Bhardwaj), who live next door to each other.

items.title: Invincible
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When Mark Grayson inherits superpowers at the age of seventeen, he joins his father as Earth's Greatest Hero. It's like all his dreams come true – but only when a shocking incident ends his life. Something changes.

items.title: Deadloch
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The Tasmanian town of Deadlock is shocked when a resident's body is discovered on a crowded Winter Festival evening. Two female detectives very different in temperament are roped in to solve the case together, joined by an eager junior constable, all three work together to track down the murderer.

items.title: The Horror Of Dolores Roach
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Dolores Roach (Justina Machado) has spent a big part of her life behind bars, and when she gets back home, she discovers that everything has changed and she has no idea where'' her family or lover are. Later, she reunites with an old friend Luis (Alejandro Hernandez), who lets her live and work as a masseuse in the basement under his empanada shop.

items.description: The Series Is An Live-Action Adaptation Of The Award-Winning And Beloved Nickelodeon's Animated Series Of The Same Name. "Avatar: The Last Airbender" Centered Around The Journey Of Twelve-Year-Old 'Aang', The Current Avatar And Last Survivor Of His Nation, As He Learns To Master The Four Elements (Water, Earth, Fire, And Air) To Restore Balance To A World Threatened By The Terrifying Fire Nation !!

items.description: Years after retiring from their formidable ninja lives, a dysfunctional family must return to shadowy missions to counteract a string of looming threats.

items.title: Rakshak Indias Braves - Chapter 2

items.description: Presenting the first look of Chapter II in the Rakshak India's Braves franchise, inspired from true events the story revolves around a foiled attack post Pulwama called 'Operation Kulgam'.

items.title: Maharani
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Bheema Bharti (Sohum Shah) is now out of prison and is ready to claim back the political position, which is now his wife Rani's (Huma Qureshi). As he gears up to fight the leader by any means, he might try to mislead public and defame her. Will the Chief Minister be able to win this political-cum-personal battle?

items.title: Maharani
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Maharani is a fictionalised political drama set in the Bihar of the 1990s. Bheema Bharti, the chief minister of Bihar (Sohum Shah) is shot down by a few supposedly political rivals, leaving him in critical health. Adamant at staying in the power loop, he announces his homemaker wife Rani Bharti (Huma Qureshi) as his successor — leaving everyone including Rani shocked. With no formal education, political experience, or even aspirations, she must tread her foot carefully in the male-dominated political fabric.

items.title: Dillogical
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When US returned Saransh decides to take it to the next level with his long-term sweetheart Jinal at a close friend’s destination wedding, she springs a surprise by suggesting that they try out an open relationship. Their friends and family grapple with the aftermath of this decision leading to heartburn, confusion and hard learning's for the two lovers and for everyone else involved.

items.title: Crushed
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Aadhya Anand, Rudhraksh Jaiswal, Arjun Deswal, Naman Jain, Urvi Singh, Anupriya Caroli, Sachin Singh, Siddhant Raj, Shubham Pandey, Manisha Mehra

items.title: Crushed
items.subtitle: English

Aadhya is unusually excited to hear the same and convinces her unsure friends about the trip.

items.title: Mr. Mrs. Smith
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Meet the Smiths: two lonely strangers, John and Jane, who have given up their lives and identities to be thrown together as partners – both in espionage and in marriage.

items.title: Backroad Hustle
items.subtitle: None
items.description: "In the gritty underbelly of Mumbai's Backroad, a close-knit group of friends, bound. by their troubled pasts and shared addictions, must confront their darkest secrets. when one of their own is found dead, as they uncover a web of deception, betrayal, and abuse, they become entangled in a dangerous game of survival, justice, and redemption, where' loyalties are tested, and the line between right and wrong blurs, challenging their bonds and their very existence."

items.title: Tatlubaaz
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Bulbul, a notorious con-man, wants to live a rich and luxurious life; finds himself in the middle of Tatlubaazi(phishing) in Banaras. Disha and Isabelle traps Bulbul in a series of mishaps filled with loot, deceit and murder.

items.title: Karmma Calling {2024}
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Follows Indrani Kothari (Raveena Tondon), the reigning queen of the Alibaug society who is looking for revenge and is in no mood for mercy.

items.title: Reacher
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After getting an information that a member of the 110th — his elite group of Army Special Investigators — has been murdered. Reacher (Alan Ritchson) and some of his former military cohorts reunite to investigate.

items.title: Reacher
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Jack Reacher (Alan Ritchson) — a brilliant man of wits and minimalism — has just retired from the rank of a military police investigator, and is tasting the civilian lifestyle after a long time. With no permanent residence and a few bare minimums toiling around in his ever-changing abodes, the former investigator naturally draws the curiosity of those around.

items.title: Hustlers Jugaad Ka Khel
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Sanjay Sharma (Vishal Vashishtha), a small-town boy from Rajasthan moves to Mumbai for his studies with big ambitions. His achievements have always been overshadowed by those of his brilliant elder brother — an unsettling scenario which now Sanjay wants to flip. As he gears up to top the ladder of success in Mumbai of 2010, an epicentre of the startup boom, he is bound to face challenges.

items.title: The Bequeathed
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A struggling lecturer (Kim Hyun-joo) learns that after the passing away of his uncle, whom she didn't know she have, she has now inherited a family burial graveyard. Soon she finds herself at the centre of horrible family secrets and a string of murders.

items.title: Hijack
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Hijack is a tense thriller that follows the journey of a hijacked plane as it makes its way to London over a seven-hour flight. Sam (Idris Elba), a talented business negotiator, must use his skills to bring a peaceful end to the hijacking of a flight from Dubai to London.

items.title: Monarch Legacy of Monsters
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Set after the battle between Godzilla and the Titans, two siblings are determined to uncover their family’s connection to Monarch dating back to half a century prior. The series also delves into Shaw's (Kurt Russell) involvement with Monarch, and the secrets he knows that threaten the organization in the modern day.

items.title: Badi Heroine Banti Hai
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In the vibrant world of Veer Singhania Designs, Kajal, a spirited dreamer from Punjab, collides with the monochromatic existence of Advait, the workaholic CEO. In a chic world where'''' bullets and murders are as fashionable as love itself, will Kajal-Advait find true love or will they become a victim of their own misunderstandings & prejudice?

items.title: Indian Police Force
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Rohit Shetty expands his Cop Universe — that's Singham with Ajay Devgn, Simmba with Ranveer Singh, and Sooryavanshi with Akshay Kumar — to the web series world with this seven-part limited series that follows a Delhi Police SWAT team led by Kabir Malik (Sidharth Malhotra).

items.title: The Legend of Hanuman
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Hanuman (Damandeep Singh Baggan) lives like an ordinary vaanar (monkey) and is forbidden to use his powers, on instructions of his king Sugreev (Vikrant Chaturvedi). Things change when the vaanar sena (the monkey force) meets Ram (Sanket Mhatre) and Lakshman (Richard Joel). Ram offers his help to Sugreev (Vikrant Chaturvedi), who is looking to win back his kingdom and his wife Ruma. Later, Hanuman follows the two brothers to find Sita (Surbhi Pandey).

items.title: The Legend of Hanuman
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Hanuman (Damandeep Singh Baggan) faces various difficulties while reaching Lanka, but when he finally makes it what he sees on the ‘land of demons’ is completely unexpected, and so is the war ahead. He has to battle hard with Ravan (Sharad Kelkar) in order to find and rescue Sita (Surbhi Pandey) and reunite her with Ram (Sanket Mhatre). For this, he puts Lanka on fire, finishes his task, and then finally proceeds to reunite with his king and his lord.

items.title: The Legend of Hanuman

The series stars R Sarathkumar, Prasanna, Aari Arujunan, Kalaiyarasan, Divyabharathi and Kashyap Barbhaya.

items.title: Killer Soup
items.subtitle: English

items.subtitle: English
items.description: The origin story of Echo revisits Maya Lopez (Alaqua Cox), whose ruthless behavior in New York City catches up with her in her hometown. She must face her past, reconnect with her Native American roots, and embrace the meaning of family and community if she ever hopes to move forward.

items.title: Cubicles

As Kaushal sir teaches in a different institute, doubts arise about his commitment to excellence. Rajat and Ishita embark on a journey, exploring the intersections of career and love and questions of a long distance relationship.

items.title: Mission Start Ab
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Mission Start Ab, a competitive reality series, sees three top investors handpick ten extraordinary early-stage founders. Throughout the series, they'll face relentless challenges that will test their entrepreneurial mettle. The last-standing founders get the chance of a lifetime: a potential investment in their startups. It's the dream deal every founder craves, and it's all on the line.

items.title: Dehati Ladke
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A young boy (Rajat’s) life changes when he moves from his village, Gonda to Lucknow city for the first time for his college education and experiences freedom, friendship, first love, and real hardships of life. Watch him on this heartwarming journey of self-discovery!

items.title: Mithya
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The stakes are much higher this season as Juhi and Rhea set out to seek revenge against each other. With the unexpected death of a close one, what lies next for the estranged sisters?

items.title: Hellbound
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Jung Jinsu (Kim Sung-cheol), founder of the religious cult the New Truth, returns from hell, only to discover that his extremist followers, the Arrowhead, now rule the society. But when he discovers that he is not the only one to be resurrected, Jinsu is forced to reconsider the true nature of resurrection: is it damnation, as he once preached, or a path to salvation?

items.title: The Legend of Hanuman
items.subtitle: English
items.description: This season, Lord Hanuman (Damandeep Singh Baggan) enchants one and all with his powerful Paanchmukhi avatar, which is known to harbour five faces that can control all elements of existence.

items.title: The Devils Hour
items.subtitle: English
items.description: This is a story of two Lucys – a police detective who failed to stop a tragedy, and a mother who may have to sacrifice everything in order to fulfil promises made in a previous life. Their realities collide in a mission to stop the worst thing imaginable. But who can you trust when your memories are no longer your own?

items.title: The Devils Hour
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Peter Capaldi and Jessica Raine star in this gripping six-part psychological thriller. Lucy wakes every night at exactly 3:33am. Nothing in her life has made sense for a long time. But the answers are out there, somewhere', at the end of a trail of brutal murders.

items.title: 1000 Babies

items.title: Fisaddi

items.description: 'Fisaddi' follows brothers Goldie and Vimal at Sangam University, where' their bond is tested by academic struggles, romance, and societal expectations. As Vimal finds unexpected success, Goldie faces repeated failures. Their journey challenges them to redefine their relationship and what it means to succeed, asking: Who truly is the 'Fisaddi'?

items.title: Snakes and Ladders
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Curated by Karthik Subbaraj, set in the 2000s, this story is about four reckless kids trying to cover up an accidental crime, only to find themselves caught in worse situations - chased by cops, dim-witted thugs, and their own bad choices!

items.title: The Penguin
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Taking place after the flood of Gotham City, Oswald Cobblepot (Colin Farrell) looks to take over the criminal underworld and fill the power vacuum. The series explores the rise to power of the Penguin in Gotham City's criminal underworld.

items.title: The Pradeeps of Pittsburgh
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The Pradeeps attempt to prove their innocence to a pair of investigating government agents by recounting their initial life in America after moving from India. Though each family member has a different perspective on the events, they weave together a story of humor, heartbreak, and the often-complicated pursuit of their respective American Dreams.

items.title: Fight Night - The Million Dollar Heist
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When boxing legend Muhammad Ali returns to the ring in 1970, hundreds get robbed in the celebratory party. As the city erupts in chaos, a charismatic hustler and a sharp-witted detective engage in a tense battle of wits, with fortunes and lives hanging in the balance.

items.title: Manvat Murders
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Based on the book 'Footprints on the Sands of Crime', the true story of a heinous crime shook the entire nation in 1972. When seven murders in the span of a year go unsolved, Special Crime Branch officer Ramakant Kulkarni, also known as 'Sherlock Holmes of India' is brought in to the small village of Manvat. Can he apprehend the culprit before any more lives are lost? 'Manvat Murders' stars Ashutosh Gowariker, Sai Tamhankar, Makarand Anaspure, Sonali Kulkarni, Kishor Kadam and Mayur Khandge.

items.title: Red Room
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When Tia steps into the Red Room, an ultra-exclusive nightclub that promises secrecy, she has no idea that her life will never be the same again. What begins as an evening of indulgence quickly spirals into a web of desires, deception and betrayal, plunging her into a chaotic world where'' nothing is as it seems. As events unfold, Tia finds herself entangled in a dangerous game that will challenge everything she thought she knew.

items.title: Raat Jawaan Hai

items.description: As three best friends (Anjali Anand, Barun Sobti, Priya Bapat) embark on the wild adventure of raising kids, sanity takes a backseat.

items.title: Gutar Gu
items.subtitle: English

Anuj is upset about the situation but his parents are overjoyed that he has been accepted into a good engineering college in Bhopal. He tries to persuade his father that there is a better college in Ahmedabad but his mother refuses when she gets to know reason behind it.

items.title: Zindaginama
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Six different stories from six creators with a common theme - to encourage us to be sensitive to our -environment and peers and to show openness to acknowledging mental health struggles in our lives.

items.title: Citadel Diana
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The Italian series in the Citadel world. Milan, 2030 Diana Cavalieri is a double agent for the secret syndicate Citadel, who infiltrated Manticore, the rival agency that destroyed Citadel eight years ago. Trapped behind enemy lines, Diana has a chance to leave the agency forever, but she has to decide whether to trust a surprising ally the heir of Manticore Italy, Edo Zani.

items.title: Highway Love
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Kartik (Ritvik Sahore) and Inaaya (Gayatri Bhardwaj) decide to take their relationship to the next level by moving in together. However, their seemingly perfect love story is put to the test as misunderstandings, jealousy, and insecurities pose as roadblocks. Will love be enough or is the journey too much for the fragile hearts?

items.title: Honeymoon Photographer
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Ambika (Asha Negi) arrives in the Maldives for a honeymoon photoshoot with newlyweds Adhir (Sahil Salathia) and Zoya (Apeksha Porwal). However, the romantic getaway takes a dark turn when Adhir is found dead the next morning, and Ambika has no memory of the previous night. With multiple suspects in picture, will the real cuplrit be exposed?

items.title: Taaza Khabar
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Vasya (Bhuvan Bam) sets out to rewrite his destiny.

items.subtitle: English

With newly found passions, they share experiences, play pranks, face challenges, and stand by each other. Living their last school days to the fullest, it promises to be an adventure filled with hilarity and heartfelt moments.

The Show's Format, Combining Celebrity Interactions With Comedy Sketches, Aims To Deliver Laughter And Insights Into The Lives Of Its Guests !!

items.title: The Mystery of Moksha Island
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In the heart of the Nicobar Islands lies Moksha, a private island crafted by Dr. Vishwak Sen (Ashutosh Rana) as a reflection of his inner world. When a group of visitors arrives for a tour, they're met with a series of unexplained deaths and tragedies, leaving them wondering: is it a tour or a trap?

items.title: Ishq In The Air
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A chance encounter collides the fates of Naman and Kavya on a flight propelling them on an unforeseen journey of love. But as time unfolds, will they surpass the turbulent complexities of their contrasting worlds and backgrounds to embrace the love that’s in the air?

items.title: The Frog
items.subtitle: English
items.description: One tranquil summer, a mysterious woman checks into a vacation rental — triggering events that disrupt the lives of the owner and those around him.

items.title: Khalbali Records
items.subtitle: English

As five colleaugues find themselves clueless in this period, new passions, deep friendships, and unexpected inspirations await.

items.title: Tanaav

The negotiations for the lives of those innocents and what happened on and off the plane are depicted in this series, which tells the story of those seven days of terror, turmoil, and diplomacy.

items.title: Manorathangal

Boasting an impressive ensemble cast, including Kamal Haasan, Mohanlal, Mammootty, and more, this series embarks on a thrilling journey through diverse narratives, genres, and unexpected plot twists, showcasing the mastery of storytelling.

His son, Yuvraj Singh Chauhan, heads to the Officers Training Academy (OTA), grappling with his father's high expectations. Simultaneously, the spirited Gurbaz Singh Kahlon embarks on his own journey to OTA, dealing with unique challenges. Their paths intersect humorously.

After being laid off from the company he has worked for his entire life, Sharmaji struggles to deal with the beast called retirement. His struggle to stay relevant in front of his two sons finally ends when he rekindles his love for cooking through a kitty party. A bunch of merry women rekindle in Sharma, a passion for cooking and chutzpah in general, that help him find his true calling.
