items.description: A man certain of his guilt faces a world certain of his innocence, and the truth shatters them both.

items.title: Pooja Meri Jaan
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After Pooja rejects Aniket’s romantic advances, his subsequent death by suicide leaves her facing accusations. As lawyer and friend Sana investigates the circumstances surrounding the incident, questions of obsession, consent, responsibility and the truth behind Pooja’s relationship with Aniket begin to emerge.

items.title: Ohh My Dog
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In Assam, 14-year-old Apu embarks on a desperate quest to rescue his beloved dog, Momo, after he is kidnapped. Elsewhere, in Bihar, a devoted dog named Oscar sets out on a perilous journey to find his kidnapped owner, a 15-year-old child labourer. As their journeys unfold, it becomes clear that the two kidnappings may be connected to a larger, sinister plan.

items.title: Kahan Shuru Kahan Khatam
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Meera is about to get married against her wishes and she decides to escape on the wedding day. On the run now, she bumps into a serial wedding crasher, who reluctantly decides to help her and the two develop an unlikely bond. Meanwhile, Meera’s family come to look for her and the chaos ensues when the circumstances make it seem like she has run away with him.

items.title: Bombay Stories
items.subtitle: None
items.description: Adapted from the short stories of Pakistani writer Saadat Hasan Manto, the film interweaves the lives of three sex workers and their pimps.

items.title: Bullett Raja
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A common man who transforms into a gangster revolts against the very system he once obediently followed by declaring war on the police, the government, and the industrialists.

items.title: The India Story
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A community confronts the devastating impact of pesticide contamination as industrial negligence threatens public health. The fight for accountability exposes systemic failures in regulatory oversight and corporate responsibility.

items.title: Udaipur Files Kanhaiya Lal Tailor Murder
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In June 2022, Kanhaiya Lal Sahu, a tailor in Udaipur, India, was brutally murdered. The events surrounding the murder are explored, delving into the conspiracy and the deeper issues of religious extremism, digital radicalization, and intelligence failures that led to the tragic event.

items.title: Haiwaan
items.subtitle: None
items.description: A retired judge faces difficulty keeping his daughter safe from a convict he imprisoned. Later, when he gets murdered, a man with visual impairment who was loyal to him tries to defend his daughter.

items.title: Main Actor Nahin Hoon
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A frustrated actor in Mumbai connects with a retired banker in Frankfurt through an online audition and ends up teaching him acting over video calls. Their sessions unfold across two cities, pushing both to confront buried emotions and truths they have long avoided.

items.title: Ghamasaan
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A cat-and-mouse tale set in the Hindi heartland, where male friendships and rivalries unveil homoerotic tensions. Men on both sides of the law traverse arid lands, creating a sense of place where unexplored histories reside.

items.title: Love in Vietnam
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A passionate cross-cultural romance unfolds between Vietnam and Punjab, inspired by the classic Turkish novel 'Madonna in a Fur Coat.

items.title: Lust Stories
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An anthology of four stories that sheds light on modern relationships from the viewpoint of the Indian woman.

items.title: Zanjeer
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A remake of the 1973 action film of the same name.

items.title: Mirzapur - The Movie
items.subtitle: None
items.description: The battle for Mirzapur's throne escalates as old enemies resurface and new threats emerge. Blood debts must be paid while power-hungry contenders fight to control the city's violent underworld.

items.title: Dhamaal 4
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The Dhamaal boys are back for another treasure hunt, facing hilarious challenges in their quest for the Treasure of Life.

items.title: Gandhari
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she takes matters into her own hands to hunt down those responsible.

items.title: Jhund
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A retired sports teacher transforms a bunch of teenage slum goons into disciplined football players against all odds.

items.title: Hanuman Ansh
items.subtitle: None
items.description: After the death of his mother, a young boy leaves his home in grief, believing that only by finding God can he meet her again. His search takes him across temples, forests, rivers and villages, where he lives in silence, discipline and devotion, slowly shedding all attachments. Through years of wandering and inner struggle, he discovers that God is not found in escape from the world, but in serving it. As his compassion grows, so do stories of quiet miracles, healing, and grace. Renouncing identity and ownership, the boy transforms into Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba, dedicating his life to feeding the hungry, loving all without distinction, and blessing humanity through humility, service and silent faith.

items.title: Bandar
items.subtitle: English
items.description: TV star Samar's life spirals when his ex Gayatri accuses him of rape after he blocks contact with her. Despite his new relationship with Khushi, he faces arrest and encounters a corrupt justice system.

items.title: Babita Singh Reporting
items.subtitle: English
items.description: People-pleasing cop Baby accepts a fake charge to get leave for her sister-in-law’s baby shower in Rewa. There, she reunites with her childhood friend Bansi, who is murdered that very night. Defying dismissive in-laws, an indifferent husband and an apathetic local police force, she secretly investigates the murder, uncovering family betrayals while finding her own voice, courage and place as a real cop.

items.title: Alpha
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When Sita, a highly trained assassin raised in isolation as a super-soldier by a rogue commander, discovers the dark truth about her family and her stolen childhood, she teams up with her long lost sister to take down her creator and his illicit military program.

items.title: Bhuj - The Pride of India
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Set in the backdrop of the 1971 Indo-Pakistan War, the film tells the story of the IAF Squadron Leader Vijay Karnik, and his bravery, patriotism and determination.

items.title: Nawabzaade
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Three best friends fall in love with a simple, stay-at-home girl from their neighbourhood, who (unintentionally) pits them against one another. But, as love flies out of the window, the three men realise that their beloved is more than what meets the eye

items.title: Dial 1975
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In 1975, India was declared in a state of emergency. This movie tells a story of that year and how the first mobile phone arrived to India.

items.title: Welcome to the Jungle
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A group of quirky characters gets stuck in a dangerous jungle during a chaotic mission. Filled with confusion, criminals, and hilarious situations, they must work together to survive and find their way out.

items.title: The Great Grand Superhero
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Follows a grandfather and grandson whose relationship transforms through the child's imagination when they encounter aliens.

items.title: Bhavai
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The story is about the dream of Rajaram and its impact on the society. Rajaram an enthusiast by nature had only one dream of becoming an actor since his childhood. Being a village resident, he was deprived of that chance to live his dream. Will the duo be able to survive the obstacles or become a victim and succumb to the blind beliefs of the society? Who is the real Ravan, Rajaram or We "The Society"?

items.title: Bagha Jatin
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Jatindranath Mukherjee is an Indian independence activist. He is the principal leader of the Jugantar party that is the central association of revolutionary independence activists in Bengal.

items.title: Ranapati Shivray Swari Agra
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A captive king turns the tables on his Mughal captors, engineering an ingenious escape from Agra that will echo through centuries of Indian history.

items.title: Batwara 1947
items.subtitle: None
items.description: The story of an elderly Hindu woman who refuses to leave her ancestral home in Lahore, only to have a Muslim refugee family from Lucknow allotted to her house following the events of the 1947 Partition of India and Pakistan.

items.title: Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Inside Cama Hospital, one of the sites targeted during the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks, nurses, ward boys, cleaners, lift operators, security personnel, and administrative workers keep 400 people alive while armed assailants struck the city around them.

items.title: Jumper
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The local cops take the services of a Local Cable Boy, a nobody who has the ability to sneak into anyone's house and anonymously keep a track of the neighbourhood.

items.title: Aakhri Sawal
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Vicky, a brilliant but volatile scholar who ignites a national firestorm when he publicly accuses his legendary mentor, Professor Gopal Nadkarni, of institutional bias. What begins as a faculty dispute is quickly hijacked by a sensationalist news anchor and an ambitious political activist, turning a private disagreement into a televised "intellectual trial" watched by millions.

items.title: Bhoot Part One - The Haunted Ship
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When an abandoned haunted ship called 'Sea Bird' washes up on the shores of Mumbai, surveying officer Prithvi is assigned to solve the mystery and close the case

items.title: Anarkali of Aarah
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Hailing from Aarah in Bihar, Anarkali is an item girl, famous for her vocals, suggestive dance moves and innuendo laden lyrics. She enjoys her stardom and revels in the lusty glances. The singer acknowledges that she is no saint and even makes peace with the hatred she evokes among civilised society but what she refuses to tolerate is being exploited in public by an influential politician.

items.title: Toolsidas Junior
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A young boy seeks to master the game of snooker to defend his father’s legacy after a humiliating loss. But first, he’ll need help from a hardened pro.

items.title: Helmet
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Desperate to make some quick money, Lucky and his friends rob an e-commerce company truck. But to their surprise, the looted boxes contain condoms instead of electronic gadgets. They decide to sell them directly to the people, who want the product but are too embarrassed to buy it publicly.

items.title: Attack Part 1
items.subtitle: English
items.description: With the Parliament under siege, India’s first super soldier Arjun Shergill is tasked to get hold of the terrorists in time, save the Prime Minister from their clutches and stop a dirty bomb from exploding and destroying Delhi.

items.title: Mimi
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An aspiring actress in a small town in Rajasthan agrees to bear a child for a visiting couple seeking a surrogate mother, but her experience takes an unexpected turn when they refuse to have the child anymore.

items.title: Main Vaapas Aaunga
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Haunted by a childhood romance and recollections of love lost during the 1947 Partition of India, 95-year-old Ishar Singh Grewal shares his story with his grandson Nirvair, the past unfolding through memories of migration, longing, and a romance that endures across generations.

items.title: Nikamma
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A lazy slacker struggles to get along with his diligent sister-in-law - until they must step up and fight together against a common enemy.

items.title: Shakuntala Devi
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Based on the life of Shakuntala Devi who is a well-known mathematical genius and calculating progidy from India. She has been nicknamed 'Human Computer' because of her extraordinary talent and skill in solving complex mathematical problems without any mechanical aid.

items.title: Good Luck Jerry
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In dire need of money, Jerry gets drawn into the dangerous world of drug trafficking. Things go awry when she decides to quit.

items.title: Govinda Naam Mera
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An abusive wife, a hot girlfriend and a court case, Govinda Waghmare is just not able to catch a break. The icing on top of that horrible cake - a murder.

items.title: Ghost Stories
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An anthology of four short horror tales.

items.title: Laal Singh Chaddha
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Events in India's history — from the Emergency and the famous Cricket World Cup win to the Punjab riots , unfold from the perspective of an innocent Sikh man Laal Singh Chaddha, a person with a low IQ but high optimism. Laal is able to achieve everything under the sun but his childhood love continues to elude him.

items.title: Mohabbatein
items.subtitle: English
items.description: At a prestigious all-male university, three friends seek love outside of the school grounds; at the same time, a newly-hired music teacher seeks to befriend and loosen up the militantly strict headmaster.

items.title: Hai Jawani toh Ishq Hona Hai
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When Jass leaves his marriage over conflicting priorities, a new romance abroad is upended by shocking revelations, forcing him to confront love, loyalty, and the true meaning of commitment.

items.title: 1920 London
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Shivangi lives in London with her husband Veer Singh. One day, he receives a gift from Rajasthan. From then, strange things happen with Veer and his condition deteriorates.

items.title: Section 375
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A filmmaker stands trial when a costume assistant on his movie accuses him of rape.

items.title: Freddy
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Introverted and awkward Dr. Freddy Ginwala desperately searches for a soulmate. When he finally finds her, the relationship becomes as painful as a root canal.

items.title: Bank Chor
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A comic-caper, that tells the story of 3 morons trying to rob a bank who pick the worst day possible when everything that can go wrong, goes wrong and how they're inadvertently caught in the crossfire.

items.title: Governor
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Set against Indias 1990 economic crisis, Governor follows Raman, a reluctant bureaucrat unexpectedly appointed as the Governor of the RBI when the nation stands on the brink of bankruptcy. As inflation rises, fuel runs low, and panic spreads, Raman must navigate political pressure and a collapsing system to prevent the country from falling apart.

items.title: Darlings
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Badru hopes her volatile husband will reform if he stops drinking. But when his rage goes too far, she and her mom boldly, albeit clumsily, seek revenge.

items.title: Goodbye
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After a mother's sudden death, chaos and grief collide when four adult siblings return to their traditional father's home for the funeral.

items.title: Forensic
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Little girls begin to disappear and their bodies are found soon after in the town of Mussoorie. Police officer Megha and forensic officer Johnny join hands to nab the killer.

items.title: Babli Bouncer
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A first-of-its-kind for her village, Babli takes up a bouncer's job to win over her love, leading to a series of funny and heart-warming events.

items.title: Momacu
items.subtitle: English
items.description: On a freezing winter night in rural Haryana, three men steal an ATM and hide it in a tube well room. Overnight, mistrust and chaos shatter their desperate plan.

items.title: Aamdani Athani Kharcha Rupaiya
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Jhoomri and her husband, Bhimsha, move into a new neighbourhood. Their immediate neighbours are three squabbling couples, namely Vijay and Anjali who are newly married; Appu Khote and Vimla, who are married and have 4 children; and Ravi and Meena, who are also married and have one child. With their wages unable to keep up with inflation and high cost of living, unable to pay even rent to the landlord, B.K. Kakkad, the wives decide to seek employment to augment their income, with hilarious results from their spouses, who will go to any extent to keep their wives at home, even if means to bring a dancing girl home to cook and look after the children!!

items.title: Khuda Haafiz Chapter 2 - Agni Pariksha
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Following a traumatic chapter in their lives, Sameer and Nargis try to lead a happy life by adopting Nandini, a friend's orphaned niece. But fate soon strikes back hard when Nandini goes missing.

items.title: Khuda Haafiz
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When the 2008 recession leaves Sameer Chaudhary and his wife Nargis jobless, they struggle to make a living and after three months, succeed when they find jobs in a Middle East country named Noman. Due to delay in arrival of documents, Sameer stays in India while Nargis heads to Noman, upon arriving where she is abducted as she pleads for help over a phone call to Sameer. Enraged and helpless, Sameer heads to Noman and teams up with a local taxi driver to find Nargis before it is too late.

items.title: Raaz Reboot
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Newly-weds Rehaan and Shaina move to Romania after the former is offered a job. When Shaina senses paranormal activity around her, she learns that her husband is harbouring a secret from her.

items.title: Raaz 3
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When an ingénue's sudden popularity threatens to shove her out of the spotlight, a movie star uses black magic in an attempt to derail her career.

items.title: Raaz - The Mystery Continues
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A beautiful lady turns up in an architect's masterpiece.When he founds that she is real, he realizes that she is haunted and hunted by the reasons they have to find out

items.title: Raaz
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A couple goes for a vacation to the scenic mountains of Ooty to save their crumbling marriage, but the bungalow they are staying at is haunted by a vengeful spirit that holds a secret.

items.title: Khufiya
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When a mole in an intelligence unit leads to the murder of an undercover spy, a hardened agent relentlessly pursues him to avenge the death.

items.title: Rustom
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A naval officer is devastated to learn about his wife's extramarital affair with a rich businessman while he was away. He pays him a visit and shoots him to death, following which he surrenders himself but claims to be "not guilty" in the court, much to the surprise of the businessman's sister and the officers dealing with his case.

items.title: Doctor G
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Uday Gupta, a medical college student wanted to specialise in Orthopaedic, but is stuck in an all-female class of Gynaecology. Will he change his department, or will the department change him?

items.title: Thank God
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An egoistic real estate broker in huge debts, meets with an accident. As he gains consciousness, he realizes that he is in heaven. God appears before him and informs him that he must play a 'Game of Life'. If he manages to win, he will be sent back to earth; if he loses, he will be sent to hell.

items.title: Heropanti 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Babloo is a computer genius and Inaaya is a self-made billionaire. The two fall in love but due to unforeseen circumstances they suddenly part ways as the cybercrime lord, Laila wants him dead.

items.title: Heropanti
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Two young people find love despite the violent landscape in which they live.

items.title: Mukhbir - The Story of a Spy
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An Indian spy embarks on a perilous mission in Pakistan to save India. Will he succeed?

items.title: Ikka
items.subtitle: English
items.description: With a loved one's life at stake, a celebrated lawyer must defend a man he suspects is guilty — battling his conscience every step of the way.

items.title: Pati Patni Aur Woh Do
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A seemingly perfect marriage in Prayagraj takes an unexpected turn when one decision leads to a chain of misunderstandings, suspicion, and comedic chaos.

items.title: Samrat Prithviraj
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The true story of legendary Hindu warrior king "Prithviraj Chauhan" including his early military successes, love story with Sanyogita & clashes with Muhammad of Ghor, a ruler of the Ghurid dynasty who led the foundation of Muslim rule in the Indian subcontinent.

items.title: Gunjan Saxena - The Kargil Girl
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Inspired by the life of a fearless young officer who made history by becoming the first Indian female Air Force officer to fly in a combat zone during the 1999 Kargil War

items.title: Dug Dug
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Mysterious events in the wake of a freak motorcycle accident sow the seeds of a new religion.

items.subtitle: English
items.description: On the 25th of June 1983, the Lord’s Cricket Ground witnessed one of the biggest underdog stories in the history of sports. Fourteen inspired players - led by a man's self-belief and conviction - fought against all odds and orchestrated India’s greatest sporting triumph by beating the two-time World Champions West Indies.

items.title: Radhe
items.subtitle: English
items.description: As Mumbai’s youth are falling prey to rampant drug abuse, suspended cop Radhe is recalled for a clean-up mission. But Radhe is up against a dangerous new outlaw Rana, who will stop at nothing to rule the city.

items.title: Bhoot Police
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Two brothers Vibhooti and Chiraunji have fought their share of ghosts. However, a new case in a remote village forces them to rethink their own abilities and beliefs.

items.title: Chup Chup Ke
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After surviving a suicide attempt in which his family and fellow villagers believe he drowned, a debt-ridden man decides to start his life afresh in another village. He pretends to be mute and starts working for a rich man where he falls in love with his mute daughter.

items.title: Squid Game
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When the winner and sole survivor of the deadly games, Seong Gi-hun (Lee Jung-jae) learns that the game recruiters are once again recruiting candidates for a new competition, he decides to take revenge on the game's organizers. Squid Game Season 2 TV Series Cast, Episodes, Release Date, Trailer and Ratings

items.title: Breaking Bad
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Walter-------------------- White (Bryan Cranston), a high-school chemistry teacher has just been told by the doctors that he can expect to live for only two years, because of his recently diagnosed inoperable lung cancer.Terrified at the idea of his family — which includes his wife (Anna Gunn) and a teenage son (RJ Mitte) who suffers from cerebral palsy — having to face monumental medical debts, he decides to manufacture and sell illegal crystal meth using his chemistry skills, and with help from his former student Jesse Pinkman (Aaron Paul).

items.title: Breaking Bad
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Walter-- White (Bryan Cranston) continues with his growing illegal operation of crystal meth manufacture and distribution — along with his former student-turned-business-partner Jesse Pinkman (Aaron Paul). Naturally, the duo starts attracting attention from competing cartels as well as some family members. The consequences might be more serious than Walter-- initially expected.

items.title: Breaking Bad
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The third season picks up shortly after the Wayfarer Flight 515 disaster when two cartel hitmen enter Mexico to avenge the death of Tuco Salamanca (Raymond Cruz). Walter-- White (Bryan Cranston) is now left with no other option but to come clean to his family and go into hiding. Meanwhile, Jesse Pinkman (Aaron Paul) returns from rehab with a change of heart.

items.title: Breaking Bad {Episode- 01-13}
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Walter- White (Bryan Cranston) is hell-bent on outwitting the powerful drug lord Gustavo Fring (Giancarlo Esposito) — for whom he used to make pure crystal meth. Meanwhile, Jesse Pinkman (Aaron Paul) discovers that he might be good at the game after all.

items.title: Breaking Bad
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Walter--- White (Bryan Cranston) has taken over the drug empire, after Gustavo Fring’s (Giancarlo Esposito) death. The business has now been divided three ways between him, Jesse (Aaron Paul), and Mike (Jonathan Banks). Meanwhile, the police’s seizure of Fring’s laptop sets the tone for a dramatic unfolding of shocking events.

items.title: The Silent Sea
items.subtitle: English
items.description: During a perilous 24-hour mission on the moon, space explorers try to retrieve samples from an abandoned research facility steeped in classified secrets.

items.title: Game of Thrones
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An adaptation of A Song of Ice and Fire, the series is based on the best-selling fantasy novel book series by George R.R. Martin — season 1 draws from the first book, "A Game of Thrones". Kingdoms battle with each other to attain the control of Westeros, unaware of the ancient enemy's comeback after being dormant for millennia.

items.title: Game of Thrones
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The Seven Kingdoms are battling with the King in the North, Robb Stark (Richard Madden), who declared independence in the wake of his father's beheading. Joffrey Baratheon's (Raymond Griffiths) uncle, Renly (Gethin Anthony), has claimed the throne with the help of House Tyrell, as he has larger armies. While rulers are eyeing and building conspiracies for the throne, Tyrion Lannister (Paul Teeny McCartan) returns to take the charge in hands, but faces opposition from his sister, Cersei (Lena Headey), who is now the Queen Regent.

items.title: Game of Thrones
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The Seven Kingdoms of Westeros are gripped by civil war. Renly Baratheon (Gethin Anthony) has been assassinated, and the cruel boy-king Joffrey Baratheon (Jack Gleeson) has defeated his uncle Stannis (Stephen Dillane) and won the battle with a great victory with House Tyrell, and now commands the largest armies in the kingdom.

items.title: Game of Thrones
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Season 4 is based on the second half of the third book, ""A Storm of Swords"" from A Song of Ice and Fire series by George R.R. Martin, along with elements from the fourth and fifth books, "A Feast for Crows" and "A Dance with Dragons". Lady Olenna (Diana Rigg) secretly poisons King Joffrey (Jack Gleeson) at his wedding with her granddaughter Margaery (Natalie Dormer). King Joffrey's family accuses Tyrion (Peter Dinklage) of the murder and is found guilty.

items.title: Game of Thrones
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Based on the fourth and fifth novels — of A Song of Ice and Fire series, by George R.R. Martin — "A Feast for Crows" and "A Dance with Dragons". The War of the Five Kings has entered a new and more chaotic phase, and Westeros is on the edge of collapse. Queen Cersei Lannister (Lena Headey) succeeds her father and takes over as Queen Regent — and is essentially the Ruling Queen of the Seven Kingdoms. The Lannisters form alliances with House Tyrell of the Reach to win on the battlefield with the armies and food resources.

items.title: Game of Thrones
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The eighth and final season of the epic fantasy show finally thrusts the living into a mindless war against the Army of the Dead. The suspense behind the final heir of the Iron Throne is also lifted, post a twisted turn of events.

items.title: Game of Thrones
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Westeros turns into a battle land, as noble families wage wars to take over its control. Daenerys Targaryen (Emilia Clarke) is hell-bent on taking down the Lannisters, more than ever. Meanwhile, Jon Snow (Kit Harington) struggles to prove that the Army of the Dead not only exists but is also coming over for blood. Unexpected romances and --executions also pop up in between .

items.title: Game of Thrones
items.subtitle: English
items.description: As some of the important characters are written off the show this season, some new faces rise to the occasion. The sixth season is heavily inspired by the unpublished text of George R. R. Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire series. It also takes a few creative tweaks to the original novel series.

items.title: House of the Dragon
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Based on George R.R. Martin’s “Fire & Blood,” House of the Dragon, which is set 200 years before the events of Game of Thrones, tells the story of House Targaryen.

items.title: House of the Dragon
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Following the conflict between Vhagar and Arrax in the season 1 finale, all-out war is on the cards.

items.title: From
items.subtitle: English
items.description: From unravels the mystery of a nightmarish town that traps all those who enter. As the unwilling residents fight to keep a sense of normalcy and search for a way out, they must also survive the threats of the surrounding forest.

items.title: From
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Hope wears thin and tensions run high as a busload of unsuspecting newcomers arrives in town. Season Two will explore just how far the residents of this nightmarish place are willing to go to find answers.

items.title: From
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The weather grows colder, food is scarce, and every day is more difficult than the last. Season Three brings a host of new terrors and startling revelations, but will the fight for survival force the residents of town to sacrifice the very humanity that sets them apart from the monsters they fear?

items.title: Money Heist
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The Professor (Álvaro Morte) brings together a unique gang of eight robbers, each of them with a talent of their own and nothing to lose. The mission is to --------execute one of the biggest heists in history, but without hurting anyone, or without actually stealing anyone's money! The Professor has it all charted out - a genius plan - with painful attention to every detail. Everything is under control at the Royal Mint of Spain, where'''' this unusual robbery is taking place, until someone gets hurt and the other falls in love.

items.title: Money Heist
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The Professor is successfully pulling off the biggest heist in recorded history and printing billions of euros in the Royal Mint of Spain. It's through and through plan until some unexpected events take over.

items.title: Money Heist
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Rio (Miguel Herrin) one of the robbers from the Professor's gang is caught and the gang comes together to rescue him while pulling off yet another heist.

items.description: During their last journey, Leo Suter (Harald Sigurdsson), Sam Corlett (Leif Eriksson), and Frida Gustavsson (Freydis Eriksdotter), unravel some dark secrets from their history.

items.title: Gyeongseong Creature
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Gyeongseong Creature Season 1 plunges viewers into the dark heart of Japanese-occupied Korea in 1945, mixing historical horror with a terrifying sci-fi premise. The story revolves around Jang Tae-sang, a wealthy and influential pawnshop owner known for his ability to uncover information, and Yoon Chae-ok, a resourceful tracker dedicated to finding her missing mother. Their paths intertwine when Tae-sang is coerced by the Japanese police commissioner to find his missing mistress, leading him to cross paths with Chae-ok and her search for her mother.

items.title: Campus Beats
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Two years after its golden era, MAD Academy struggles with declining passion and enrollment. Reuniting with old flames and rivals like Netra and his estranged stepbrother Ahaan, Ishaan battles inner demons and reignites old passions. Amid fierce rehearsals, love triangles, and rising rivalries, tensions escalate as the team prepares for the high-stakes World Dance Championship.

items.title: Campus Beats
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Ruthless battles Beat Breakers at WDC, with Ri stopping at nothing to defeat Netra and reclaim Ishaan. Amid betrayals, love triangles, and sabotage, Netra fights for her team while Ishaan struggles to protect her. As Ri's obsession spirals, alliances shift, Mehrotra's schemes unfold, and Netra makes a heartbreaking choice, leaving her fate uncertain.

items.title: Campus Beats
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Season 3 sets the stage for the finale for Netra’s story in this chapter where''' she uncovers the mystery of her past but at a personal cost. This season takes Ishaan Netra love story to a peak. New alliances, mysteries and enemies reveal themselves especially with Rihanna realizing her love for Ishaan. Season 3 Beats celebrates love, friendship, dance and promises the most dramatic season finale.

items.title: Campus Beats
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Season 2 takes the journey of Netra ahead where'' as she tries to solve the mystery of her past, she would forge new friendships and take on new challenges in the dance crew. An unlikely ally comes in form of Ishaan as their love story begins much to Rihanna’s dismay. But will this relationship withstand the new revelations which come in Netra’s life or is there a side to Ishaan.

items.title: Campus Beats
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In a prestigious dance academy, two groups OGs and the BGs are very talented and also hate each other a lot. A new girl Netra (Shruti Sinha) joins the college through a welfare program to uncover a secret but finds love and solace in a member of the OG group, Ishaan (Shantanu Maheshwari).

items.title: Mitti - Ek Nayi Pehchaan
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Mitti – Ek Nayi Pehchaan follows Raghav Sharma’s return to Dol Chhapra, his ancestral village, to fulfill his late grandfather’s vision of modern farming. Leaving behind his life as a creative director in advertising, Raghav confronts village rivalries and emotional ties as he embarks on a profound journey of transformation—from urban professional to progressive farmer, rediscovering identity.

items.title: Vikings
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After turmoil, the Vikings have a hold over Kattegat again. But, it may be time to let go. Politics is reshaping the land of Vikings as it looks for a single new king for all of Norway.

items.title: Vikings
items.subtitle: English
items.description: As their opponents devise defensive strategies, the Vikings come under great pressure. While they establish a hold in York, things get twisted in Kattegat.

items.title: Vikings
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Ragnar Lothbrok (Travis Fimmel) overcomes ailing health and rises as the ferocious Viking he is. Although there have been events that got out of his hands, he wins over the small battles and is now planning to head to Paris, again. The brave Viking’s ambitions don’t stop just there.

items.title: Vikings
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The Vikings settle in a new camp, and also gear up for yet another raid. They are now headed to Paris, where'''' the emperor is sending the city into a lockdown and gearing his army for defence.

items.title: Vikings
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Ragnar Lothbrok (Travis Fimmel) and King Horik (Donal Logue) are at battle with Jarl Borg (Thorbjørn Harr). Borg is joined by Rollo (Clive Standen) in this Viking war that has a brother against brother. A new raid on England is also in order.

items.title: Vikings
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The ferocious Ragnar Lothbrok (Travis Fimmel) is a farmer by the day but hailed as a Norse hero for his courage. When he decides to travel west, his equally fearless and ambitious family lends him their support. Not only does his son join him, an entire fleet of villagers agree to put their lives at risk at traverse the unknown. What’s more — they successfully raid and return home with riches, only to head back on another adventure.

items.title: Mercy for None
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After severing ties with his gang, a former gangster returns to uncover the truth behind his brother's death embarking on a relentless path of revenge.

items.title: Good Wife
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Lawyer-turned-housewife Tarunika's peaceful world is shattered when her family is hit by a scandal. How will she defend her loved ones from society?

items.title: The Sandman
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After a fateful reuni0n with his family, Dream of the Endless (Tom Sturridge) must face one impossible decision after another as he attempts to save himself, his kingdom, and the waking world from the epic fallout of his past misdeeds.

items.title: The Sandman
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The Sandman follows Dream (Tom Sturridge) who is the personification of dreams and stories, on a mission to restore order in his Kingdom of Dreaming. Dream has been held captive since 1916 by a group of black magic occultists. Now that he’s finally free he must oversee and influence the dreaming and storytelling for every living being in the universe.

items.title: The Hunt - The Rajiv Gandhi Assassination Case
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The Hunt - The Rajiv Gandhi Assassination Case is a series directed by Nagesh Kukunoor. The series stars Amit Sial, Bagavathi Perumal, Girish Sharma, Rama Rao Jadhav and Sahil Vaid in the lead roles.

items.title: Criminal Justice - A Family Matter
items.subtitle: English
items.description: While trying to solve a critical crime case, lawyer Madhav Mishra (Pankaj Tripathi) faces many challenges.

items.title: Peaky Blinders 06
items.subtitle: English
items.description: As times get tough, the gangster family must stick together more than ever before. There are new enemies making bold moves at Thomas Shelby (Cillian Murphy) and an unseen one has Aunt Polly (Helen McCrory) confused. The Shelbys must together beat their foes that include the Mafia, and get back home safely.

items.title: Squid Game
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Seong Gi-hun (Lee Jung-jae) continues his mission to dismantle the deadly competition after a failed rebellion. Facing the enigmatic Front Man (Lee Byung-hun), Gi-hun confronts new, perilous games and moral dilemmas, striving to end the organization's grip on society.

items.title: Mistry
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Mistry is a series directed by Rishab Seth. The series stars Mona Singh, Ram Kapoor and Shikha Talsania in the lead roles.

items.title: Inspector Avinash
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Inspector Avinash Mishra walks us through his journey to the top of the arms trafficking organisation. He discovers that Ayodhya is in danger due to the presence of RDX. How will Avinash save the holy site visited by thousands of people?

items.title: Panchayat
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In the fourth season of Panchayat, Abhishek Tripathi continues his role as the Panchayat secretary in Phulera, navigating the complexities of rural life and politics.

items.title: The Great Indian Kapil Show
items.subtitle: English
items.description: As Kapil Sharma moves to a new house, he brings new and an exciting comedy extravaganza for his fans around the world

items.title: First Copy
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In the heart of Mumbai during the 1990s, 'Arif,' a notorious and desperately romantic figure, rises to infamy as the kingpin of film piracy. As he weaves an intricate web of distribution, his audacious exploits attract the attention of law enforcement, Bollywood celebrities, and the criminal underworld, leading to a thrilling cat-and-mouse chase.

items.title: Kerala Crime Files
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An investigation takes place following the horrific murder of a sex worker at a suburban tourist guest house.

items.title: Peaky Blinders
items.subtitle: English
items.description: As times get tough, the gangster family must stick together more than ever before. There are new enemies making bold moves at Thomas Shelby (Cillian Murphy) and an unseen one has Aunt Polly (Helen McCrory) confused. The Shelbys must together beat their foes that include the Mafia, and get back home safely.

items.title: The Witcher
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The Witcher is a live-action drama based on the eight-book fantasy series of the same title by Andrzej Sapkowski. The first season is largely based on the first two books: Sword of Destiny (1992) and The Last Wish (1993).

items.title: The Witcher
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Geralt of Rivia (Henry Cavill) decides to bring Princess Cirilla (Freya Allan) to his childhood home in Kaer Morhen, one of the safest places known to the beast hunter where'''' she could also begin her training. Danger awaits the duo in the form of Continent's kings, elves, humans and demons strive for supremacy. However, Geralt is more concerned about the mysterious powers that Cirilla holds within

items.title: The Witcher
items.subtitle: English
items.description: As monarchs, mages and beasts of the Continent compete to capture her, Geralt takes Ciri of Cintra into hiding, determined to protect his newly-reunited family against those who threaten to destroy it.

items.title: La Brea
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When a massive sinkhole mysteriously opens in Los Angeles, it tears a family in half, separating mother and son from father and daughter.

items.title: Aspirants
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Follows the ambitions and challenges of a group of people as they attempt to pass the difficult UPSC examination.

items.title: Aspirants
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Aspirants captures the journey of three friends, who spend years of their youth preparing for Union Public Service Commission (UPSC), India's premier central recruiting agency for Group 'A' officers of Government of India. They make several attempts to crack the exams, but fail multiple times before they finally succeed

items.title: Rana Naidu
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The high-stakes family drama is back for a second season with more twists, turns, and explosive action

items.title: La Brea
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When a massive sinkhole mysteriously opens in Los Angeles, it tears a family in half, separating mother and son from father and daughter.

items.title: Devika And Danny
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Devika & Danny- Follows The Life Of A Middle-Class Woman, Devika, Who Works As A Teacher. She Leads A Simple, Uneventful Life Surrounded By Small Things That Mean A Lot To Her. However, Everything Begins To Change When 'Danny' Enters Her World, Prompting Her To Reinvent Herself And Altering Her Outlook On Life. What Unfolds Is An Unexpected Journey Of Love As Danny And Devika Navigate Life-Changing Events That Challenge And Reshape Their Beliefs.

items.title: Chhal Kapat - The Deception
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When a famous influencer is found dead at her friend's wedding, a cynical cop has to turn over the darkest secrets to find the killer. Will friendship, loyalty, and family survive the interrogation

items.title: Lafangey - Sapne - Dosti - Duniya
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The season begins with Chatty, Rohan and Kammo trying to figure out what to do next. It's been a while since they graduated; the family has started to taunt them, their romantic relationships are at stake, and life just seems to pass them by without answers. The people are not delusional; they are hardworking and dedicated, but it's just the state of the country where'' there are no jobs.

items.title: Special Ops 1.5 - The Himmat Story
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Himmat Singh (Kay Kay Menon), a young and idealistic RAW agent is determined to serve his country and to protect its honour, but first must go through the shackles of politics that continuously challenge him. Special Ops 1.5 is the story of how Singh beats the system and becomes the man he is.

items.title: Special Ops
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The action-thriller follows Himmat Singh (Kay Kay Menon), a RAW agent who is aimed at tracking down the mastermind behind multiple terrorist attacks. The storyline is inspired from several nationally significant events and espionage missions undertaken over the last two decades in India.

items.title: KanKhajura
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Adaptation of Israeli crime thriller Magpie which followed the story of a murderer who spent 17 years in prison — where''' he served as an informant (magpie) for the police. He gets an early release on the condition that he continues his role as the informant for the officials.

items.title: Meet Cute
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Five stories where'' strangers engage in conversations that leave them with a sense of nostalgia.

items.title: Wednesday
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The coming-of-age horror comedy is a spin-off of the Adamms Family. The show follows Wednesday (Jenna Ortega) trying to make her way through high school while trying to master her psychic abilities. She also has to fight monstrous creatures, save the town, solves the supernatural mystery involving her family, and navigate the new relationships in her life.

items.title: Peaky Blinders
items.subtitle: English
items.description: As times get tough, the gangster family must stick together more than ever before. There are new enemies making bold moves at Thomas Shelby (Cillian Murphy) and an unseen one has Aunt Polly (Helen McCrory) confused. The Shelbys must together beat their foes that include the Mafia, and get back home safely.

items.title: The Last Sunrise
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.

items.title: Hercules
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When a new enemy threatens the innocent, Hercules must lead his fearless team of warriors in a battle against overwhelming odds.

items.title: The Dark Knight Rises
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Following the death of District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman assumes responsibility for Dent's crimes to protect the late attorney's reputation and is subsequently hunted by the Gotham City Police Department. Eight years later, Batman encounters the mysterious Selina Kyle and the villainous Bane, a new terrorist leader who overwhelms Gotham's finest. The Dark Knight resurfaces to protect a city that has branded him an enemy.

items.title: The Punisher
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When undercover FBI agent Frank Castle's wife and son are slaughtered, he becomes 'the Punisher' -- a ruthless vigilante willing to go to any length to avenge his family.

items.title: The Notebook
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An epic love story centered around an older man who reads aloud to a woman with Alzheimer's. From a faded notebook, the old man's words bring to life the story about a couple who is separated by World War II, and is then passionately reunited, seven years later, after they have taken different paths.

items.title: Fall
items.subtitle: English
items.description: For best friends Becky and Hunter, life is all about conquering fears and pushing limits. But after they climb 2,000 feet to the top of a remote, abandoned radio tower, they find themselves stranded with no way down. Now Becky and Hunter's expert climbing skills will be put to the ultimate test as they desperately fight to survive the elements, a lack of supplies, and vertigo-inducing heights.

items.title: Argylle
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When the plots of reclusive author Elly Conway's fictional espionage novels begin to mirror the covert actions of a real-life spy organization, quiet evenings at home become a thing of the past. Accompanied by her cat Alfie and Aidan, a cat-allergic spy, Elly races across the world to stay one step ahead of the killers as the line between Conway's fictional world and her real one begins to blur.

items.title: Alien Invasion - Rise of the Phoenix
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An asteroid shower lands in a remote section of the Grand Canyon and begins to spread mysterious pods. Meanwhile, scientists on a space station that has been hit by the same asteroid shower, discover that a pod has mutated into a creature and is threatening the ship. Now the scientists and a team on Earth must learn to defeat this alien force, fighting fire with fire, fighting stone with stone.

items.title: Freefall - A Reckoning for Boeing
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..

items.title: Evil Dead Burn
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After her husband's abrupt death, Alice seeks solace with his remaining family — descendants of a leading researcher on demonic possession. As her in-laws transform one by one into creatures that feed on fear, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life survive even in death.

items.title: Mean Girls
items.subtitle: English
items.description: New student Cady Heron is welcomed into the top of the social food chain by the elite group of popular girls called ‘The Plastics,’ ruled by the conniving queen bee Regina George and her minions Gretchen and Karen. However, when Cady makes the major misstep of falling for Regina’s ex-boyfriend Aaron Samuels, she finds herself prey in Regina’s crosshairs. As Cady sets to take down the group’s apex predator with the help of her outcast friends Janis and Damian, she must learn how to stay true to herself while navigating the most cutthroat jungle of all: high school.

items.title: Bullet Proof
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The Thief pulls off the robbery of a lifetime when he robs the psychotic drug lord, Temple. The plan goes off without a hitch until the Thief discovers a stowaway in his getaway car - Temple's pregnant wife, Mia.

items.title: Beyond Justice
items.subtitle: None
items.description: A young criminal defense attorney struggles with a homicide case that is not as cut and dry as it appears while battling a drinking habit. The story goes beyond the lives of those directly related to the case and shines a much needed spotlight on the horrific world of human trafficking in the United States.

items.title: Swimming Pool
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A British crime novelist travels to her publisher's upmarket summer house in Southern France to seek solitude in order to work on her next book. However, the unexpected arrival of the publisher's daughter induces complications and a subsequent crime.

items.title: Orphan
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After losing their baby, a married couple adopt 9-year old Esther, who may not be as innocent as she seems.

items.title: The Wailing
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A stranger arrives in a little village and soon after a mysterious sickness starts spreading. A policeman is drawn into the incident and is forced to solve the mystery in order to save his daughter.

items.title: Rules of Engagement
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A Marine Colonel is brought to court-martial after ordering his men to fire on demonstrators surrounding the American embassy in Yemen.

items.title: Ghostquake
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A group of students are trapped at a school after a time capsule from the 1950's is cracked open by an earthquake. The students soon realize that ghostly spirits escaped from the time capsule, and possessed the principal and three other teachers.

items.title: The Frozen Ground
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An Alaska State Trooper partners with a young woman who escaped the clutches of serial killer Robert Hansen to bring the murderer to justice. Based on actual events.

items.title: Rush
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In the 1970s, a rivalry propels race car drivers Niki Lauda and James Hunt to fame and glory — until a horrible accident threatens to end it all.

items.title: Bury The Devil
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When a hospice nurse finds herself trapped with a dementia patient, she begins to suspect something else is wrong with the woman, something otherworldly, and must fight to survive the night.

items.title: Snake Woman
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The elite hunters of the Wu Shang tribe venture deep into the enigmatic Old Mountain, only to be attacked by a mysterious creature. The sole survivor, "Snake Master," escapes with a horrifying truth—the attackers were monstrous beings with human heads and serpent tails. The mountain has long been shrouded in eerie legends of the "Snake Woman"—could they be real? Snake Master teams up with the mountain keeper, Chen Shu, and a squad of elite mercenaries to return to the mountain. But as their investigation unfolds, a bloody and brutal forbidden truth begins to surface. In this hunt… who is truly the prey?

items.title: Snake 5 - Monster City
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After escaping prison during a monster attack, convict Wu Chuan must navigate a city overrun by prehistoric creatures and lead a desperate fight to save his trapped mother and stop an ancient beast from destroying the city.

items.title: Facing El Chapo
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.

items.title: Backrooms
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.

items.title: Somebody
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Swimming instructor, Young-eun is a single mom raising her 7-year-old daughter, So-hyun. However, a series of tragic events happens as So-hyun's puppy falls from the apartment and dies, and So-hyun bullies other kids in school. Despite her mom's earnest efforts to address So-hyun's mental disorder, her peculiar behavior persists. Twenty years later, Min, who works in handling unclaimed deaths, meets a new colleague, Hae-young, and they form a close bond. However, as Hae-young warmly integrates herself into Min's life, Min begins to feel uncomfortable and suspicious about her intentions.

items.title: The Chaser
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Joong-ho is a dirty detective turned pimp, who's in financial trouble as several of his girls have recently disappeared without clearing their debts. While trying to track them down, he finds a clue that the vanished girls were all called up by the same client, whom one of his girls is meeting with right now.

items.title: Ghost in the Shell
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In the near future, Major is the first of her kind: a human saved from a terrible crash, then cyber-enhanced to be a perfect soldier devoted to stopping the world's most dangerous criminals.

items.title: Bending The Rules
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Detective Nick Blades is a New Orleans cop on trial for corruption. Assistant District Attorney Theo Gold is the man in charge of putting him behind bars. When these two unlikely partners from opposite sides of the law stumble onto a criminal plot, they’ll need to rely on luck – and patience – to take down a dangerous killer without killing each other first.

items.title: Midwinter Break
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Longtime retired couple Stella and Gerry realise that their relationship has reached a crossroads while on holiday in Amsterdam. After so much time and so many memories, long-held promises and deeply concealed wounds threaten to come to light and force them to confront their future.

items.title: The Kissing Booth 3
items.subtitle: English
items.description: It’s the summer before Elle heads to college, and she has a secret decision to make. Elle has been accepted into Harvard, where boyfriend Noah is matriculating, and also Berkeley, where her BFF Lee is headed and has to decide if she should stay or not.

items.title: King Arthur
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The story of the Arthurian legend, based on the 'Sarmatian hypothesis' which contends that the legend has a historical nucleus in the Sarmatian heavy cavalry troops stationed in Britain, and that the Roman-British military commander, Lucius Artorius Castus is the historical person behind the legend.

items.title: The Grandmaster
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Ip Man's peaceful life in Foshan changes after Gong Yutian seeks an heir for his family in Southern China. Ip Man then meets Gong Er who challenges him for the sake of regaining her family's honor. After the Second Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man moves to Hong Kong and struggles to provide for his family. In the mean time, Gong Er chooses the path of vengeance after her father was killed by Ma San.

items.title: Stolen Girl
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In 1993, Maureen’s six-year-old daughter Amina is snuck out of the country by her ex-husband, Karim. After years of unsuccessful attempts to find her, Maureen intersects with a professional retriever of internationally abducted children who promises to help her find Amina in exchange for her collaboration.

items.title: Desperado
items.subtitle: English
items.description: El Mariachi plunges headfirst into the dark border underworld when he follows a trail of blood to the last of the infamous Mexican drug lords, Bucho, for an action-packed, bullet-riddled showdown. With the help of his friend and a beautiful bookstore owner, El Mariachi tracks Bucho, takes on his army of desperados, and leaves his own trail of blood.

items.title: Homefront
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Phil Broker, a retired DEA agent, leads a quiet life with his daughter Maddy, until a school bullying incident draws them into a conflict with Morgan “Gator” Bodine, a local crime boss.

items.title: Legend of the Guardians - The Owls of GaHoole
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When a young owl is abducted by an evil Owl army, he must escape with new-found friends and seek the legendary Guardians to stop the menace.

items.title: The Way Back
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A small band of multicultural convicts stages a daring escape from a WWII-era Siberian gulag, and embarks on a treacherous journey across five countries in a desperate race for freedom and survival.

items.title: Troy
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In year 1250 B.C. during the late Bronze age, two emerging nations begin to clash. Paris, the Trojan prince, convinces Helen, Queen of Sparta, to leave her husband Menelaus, and sail with him back to Troy. After Menelaus finds out that his wife was taken by the Trojans, he asks his brother Agamemnon to help him get her back. Agamemnon sees this as an opportunity for power. They set off with 1,000 ships holding 50,000 Greeks to Troy.

items.title: IT
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Mike Regan is a successful, self-made man who has it all: a gorgeous wife, a beautiful teenage daughter and a sleek, state-of-the-art “smart home”. But he soon finds himself in a deadly, high-stakes game of cat-and-mouse when his I.T. consultant, Ed, starts using his skills to stalk Mike’s daughter and endanger his family, his business, and his life. In a world where there is no privacy, and personal secrets can go viral by the click of a mouse, Mike needs to rely on his old connections to defeat a new kind of nemesis.

items.title: The Bad Boy And Me 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Freshman star quarterback Drayton struggles with the weight of expectations after a devastating setback, while dancer Dallas begins to question the future she thought she wanted. As their high school relationship begins to unravel under the pressures of distance and self-discovery, they’ll learn that the bravest versions of themselves emerge when they let life redirect them.

items.title: Red 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Retired C.I.A. agent Frank Moses reunites his unlikely team of elite operatives for a global quest to track down a missing portable nuclear device.

items.title: The Kings Man
items.subtitle: English
items.description: As a collection of history's worst tyrants and criminal masterminds gather to plot a war to wipe out millions, one man must race against time to stop them.

items.title: Casino Jack
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Based on a true story, a hot shot Washington DC lobbyist and his protégé go down hard as their schemes to peddle influence lead to corruption and murder.

items.title: Kingsman The Golden Circle
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When an attack on the Kingsman headquarters takes place and a new villain rises, Eggsy and Merlin are forced to work together with the American agency known as the Statesman to save the world.

items.title: The Tailor of Panama
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A British spy is banished to Panama after having an affair with an ambassador's mistress. Once there he makes connection with a local tailor with a nefarious past and connections to all of the top political and gangster figures in Panama. The tailor also has a wife, who works for the Panamanian president and a huge debt. The mission is to learn what the President intends to do with the Canal.

items.title: Orphan First Kill
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After escaping from an Estonian psychiatric facility, Leena Klammer travels to America by impersonating Esther, the missing daughter of a wealthy family. But when her mask starts to slip, she is put against a mother who will protect her family from the murderous “child” at any cost.

items.title: Kingsman The Secret Service
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The story of a super-secret spy organization that recruits an unrefined but promising street kid into the agency's ultra-competitive training program just as a global threat emerges from a twisted tech genius.

items.title: Close To Me
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Luca is a forty-year-old teacher experiencing a relationship crisis with his wife, Sara, who is much wealthier than him. During the lockdown, Luca finds himself a bystander in the life of his new neighbor, Amanda, and decides to bridge the distance between them, with disastrous consequences.

items.title: The Death of Robin Hood
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

items.title: Green Snake
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The green snake, who doesn't eat people, was driven away by the people in Hangzhou city. As she was injured and fled, she met a reincarnated little devil. The two of them walked together, and the green snake began to feel human emotions in their interaction with the little devil. The two established a deep friendship.

items.title: The Kissing Booth 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: With college decisions looming, Elle juggles her long-distance romance with Noah, changing relationship with bestie Lee and feelings for a new classmate.

items.title: To the Max
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Three skydivers died in similar accidents within five years. Salvador Calvo wanted to tell their stories with the sole survivor, Carlos Suárez.

items.title: My Best Friend His Girlfriend and Me
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Olli and Matze are best friends living, working and planning to travel the world together — until Matze's romance with Rebecca turns it all upside down.

items.title: Dont Say Good Luck
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Sophie Birenbaum is ready for the spotlight as the lead in her high school musical — until suddenly she’s living with even more drama at home than on the stage.

items.title: Starship Troopers 2 - Hero of the Federation
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A group of troopers take refuge in an abandoned outpost after fighting alien bugs, failing to realize that more danger lays in wait.

items.title: Higher Learning
items.subtitle: English
items.description: African-American student Malik is on a track scholarship; academics are not his strong suit, and he goes in thinking that his athletic abilities will earn him a free ride through college. Fudge, a "professional student" who has been at Columbus for six years so far, becomes friendly with Malik and challenges his views about race and politics in America.

items.title: Barbarian
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In town for a job interview, a young woman arrives at her Airbnb late at night only to find that it has been mistakenly double-booked and a strange man is already staying there. Against her better judgement, she decides to stay the night anyway.

items.title: In the Grey
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A covert team of elite operatives are living in the shadows. When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, they're sent to take it back—an impossible heist that erupts into a deadly game of strategy, deception and survival.

items.title: Stand Your Ground
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Former Special Forces operative, Jack Johnson, uses the Stand Your Ground law to seek vengeance for his wife’s murder, igniting a brutal war against a local crime lord’s family and ending in an explosive showdown.

items.title: Gold
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In the not-too-distant future, two drifters traveling through the desert stumble across the biggest gold nugget ever found and the dream of immense wealth and greed takes hold. They hatch a plan to excavate their bounty, with one man leaving to secure the necessary tools while the other remains with the gold. The man who remains must endure harsh desert elements, ravenous wild dogs, and mysterious intruders, while battling the sinking suspicion that he has been abandoned to his fate.

items.title: Our Hero Balthazar
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Eager to impress his activist crush, a wealthy New York teenager follows an online connection to Texas, where he's convinced he can stop an act of extreme violence.

items.title: The White Tiger
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An ambitious Indian driver uses his wit and cunning to escape from poverty and rise to the top. An epic journey based on the New York Times bestseller.

items.title: Oculus
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A woman tries to exonerate her brother's murder conviction by proving that the crime was committed by a supernatural phenomenon.

items.title: Vampires Of The Velvet Lounge
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A group of vampires confronts the challenges of adapting to contemporary society while grappling with their own mortality, all while engaged in a conflict with a dangerous enemy.

items.title: Wrangler
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Hayoung, a successful dog trainer, is visited by her sister, Sora, who has a criminal record for murder. As Sora's bizarre behavior unsettles the training center and Hayoung's daily routine, buried truths and repressed desires start to rise to the surface.

items.title: The Kissing Booth
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When teenager Elle's first kiss leads to a forbidden romance with the hottest boy in high school, she risks her relationship with her best friend.

items.title: Creation of the Gods II - Demon Force
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Taishi Wen Zhong led the army of Shang Dynasty including Deng Chanyu and four generals of the Mo Family to Xiqi. With the help of Kunlun immortals such as Jiang Ziya, Ji Fa led the army and civilians of Xiqi to defend their homeland.

items.title: Extinction
items.subtitle: English
items.description: And suddenly, overnight, the world came to a halt. Two men, two survivors, one kid, and hatred that separates them. A place forgotten by everyone, including the creatures that inhabit the Earth... until now.

items.title: Bride Hard
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Sam is a secret agent whose toughest mission to date is pleasing her bride-to-be best friend at a lavish destination wedding. When a team of mercenaries crashes the party and takes the guests hostage, Sam is thrown into a fight unlike any before — one where she can’t risk blowing her cover or ruining the big day. As she takes on the bad guys in a high-stakes battle disguised as a fairy-tale affair, she realizes the real threat might be closer than she thinks.

items.title: Escape Plan
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Ray Breslin is the world's foremost authority on structural security. After analyzing every high security prison and learning a vast array of survival skills so he can design escape-proof prisons, his skills are put to the test. He's framed and incarcerated in a master prison he designed himself. He needs to escape and find the person who put him behind bars.

items.title: Need for Speed
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The film revolves around a local street-racer who partners with a rich and arrogant business associate, only to find himself framed by his colleague and sent to prison. After he gets out, he joins a New York-to-Los Angeles race to get revenge. But when the ex-partner learns of the scheme, he puts a massive bounty on the racer's head, forcing him to run a cross-country gauntlet of illegal racers in all manner of supercharged vehicles.

items.title: Out Of The Furnace
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Two brothers live in the economically-depressed Rust Belt, when a cruel twist of fate lands one in prison. His brother is then lured into one of the most violent crime rings in the Northeast.

items.title: This Is the End
items.subtitle: English
items.description: While attending a party at James Franco's house, Seth Rogen, Jay Baruchel and many other celebrities are faced with the apocalypse.

items.title: Fantastic Four
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Four young outsiders teleport to a dangerous universe, which alters their physical form in shocking ways. Their lives irrevocably upended, the team must learn to harness their daunting new abilities and work together to save Earth from a former friend turned enemy.

items.title: Fantastic Four
items.subtitle: English
items.description: During a space voyage, four scientists are altered by cosmic rays: Reed Richards gains the ability to stretch his body; Sue Storm can become invisible; Johnny Storm controls fire; and Ben Grimm is turned into a super-strong … thing. Together, these "Fantastic Four" must now thwart the evil plans of Dr. Doom and save the world from certain destruction.

items.title: The Last House
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A family suddenly sealed inside their home must work together to survive against dwindling resources and the ominous threat keeping them trapped.

items.title: Beast Race
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Inspired by the illegal universe of the Brazilian animal lottery, a fearless young man must win a deadly race to save his sister in a dystopian future where each animal in the game is now represented by a runner vying for a prize.

items.title: The Witch Part 2 - The Other One
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A girl wakes up in a huge secret laboratory, then accidentally meets another girl who is trying to protect her house from a gang. The mystery girl overthrows the gang with her unexpected powers, and laboratory staff set out to find her.

items.title: The Witch Part 1 - The Subversion
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Ja-yoon is a high school student who struggles with memory loss after she endured some unknown trauma during her childhood. While trying to uncover the truth, she is unwittingly dragged into a world of crime and finds herself on a journey that will awaken many secrets hidden deep within.

items.title: No Time to Die
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Bond has left active service and is enjoying a tranquil life in Jamaica. His peace is short-lived when his old friend Felix Leiter from the CIA turns up asking for help. The mission to rescue a kidnapped scientist turns out to be far more treacherous than expected, leading Bond onto the trail of a mysterious villain armed with dangerous new technology.

items.title: Sherlock Holmes - A Game of Shadows
items.subtitle: English
items.description: There is a new criminal mastermind at large (Professor Moriarty) and not only is he Holmes’ intellectual equal, but his capacity for evil and lack of conscience may give him an advantage over the detective.

items.title: Sherlock Holmes
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Eccentric consulting detective Sherlock Holmes and Doctor John Watson battle to bring down a new nemesis and unravel a deadly plot that could destroy England.

items.title: Lady Chatterleys Lover
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After a crippling injury leaves her husband impotent, Lady Chatterly is torn between her love for her husband and her physical desires. With her husband's consent, she seeks out other means of fulfilling her needs.

items.title: Cruella
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In 1970s London amidst the punk rock revolution, a young grifter named Estella is determined to make a name for herself with her designs. She befriends a pair of young thieves who appreciate her appetite for mischief, and together they are able to build a life for themselves on the London streets. One day, Estella’s flair for fashion catches the eye of the Baroness von Hellman, a fashion legend who is devastatingly chic and terrifyingly haute. But their relationship sets in motion a course of events and revelations that will cause Estella to embrace her wicked side and become the raucous, fashionable and revenge-bent Cruella.

items.title: Carter
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Carter, who awakens two months into a deadly pandemic originating from the DMZ that has already devastated US and North Korea. He who has no recollections of his past finds a mysterious device in his head, and a lethal bomb in his mouth. A voice in his ears gives him orders to avoid getting killed and he's thrown into a mysterious operation while the CIA and North Korean coup chase him close.

items.title: Monster Hunter
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A portal transports Cpt. Artemis and an elite unit of soldiers to a strange world where powerful monsters rule with deadly ferocity. Faced with relentless danger, the team encounters a mysterious hunter who may be their only hope to find a way home.

items.title: Beast
items.subtitle: English
items.description: MMA legend Patton James, now a commercial fisherman, is pulled back into the cage when his brother is in danger. Reuniting with his old coach Sammy, he commits to one final fight in one championship against the brutal champion Xavier Grau.

items.title: Fantastic Four - Rise of the Silver Surfer
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The Fantastic Four return to the big screen as a new and all powerful enemy threatens the Earth. The seemingly unstoppable 'Silver Surfer', but all is not what it seems and there are old and new enemies that pose a greater threat than the intrepid superheroes realize.

items.title: Lonely Planet
items.subtitle: English
items.description: At an idyllic writers retreat in Morocco, a newly single novelist finds an unexpected connection with a younger man who's reevaluating his life choices.

items.title: Love Hard
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An LA girl, unlucky in love, falls for an East Coast guy on a dating app and decides to surprise him for Christmas, only to discover that she's been catfished. But the object of her affection actually lives in the same town, and the guy who duped her offers to set them up if she pretends to be his own girlfriend for the holidays.

items.title: Lone Survivor
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Four Navy SEALs on a covert mission to neutralize a high-level Taliban operative must make an impossible moral decision in the mountains of Afghanistan that leads them into an enemy ambush. As they confront unthinkable odds, the SEALs must find reserves of strength and resilience to fight to the finish.

items.title: Son of Sara - Volume 1
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Haunted by strange urges and visions, a pregnant woman past her due date accepts an invitation to dinner where the hosts have a demented interest in the birth of her child.

items.title: Chum
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A newlywed couple joins friends on a Mediterranean yacht excursion, only to find themselves caught between a predatory shark and a psychopathic killer in their midst-transforming a sun-drenched escape into a fight for survival.

items.title: You Always
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Ethan is a devoted best friend who soon realises he has long been in love with Dr Jen Bell. However, Jen’s world is turned upside down by the arrival of a charismatic author named Patrick.

items.title: Wild Sing
