items.subtitle: English
items.description: Twenty years after a scandal tears apart a popular 2000s K‑pop trio, the three reunite for a one-off gig — if they can overcome one snag after another.

items.title: The Loved One
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Ten years later, former lovers Ellie and Eric meet again to trace the memories of a love and sorrow that never went away.

items.title: Top Gun Maverick
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After more than thirty years of service as one of the Navy’s top aviators, and dodging the advancement in rank that would ground him, Pete “Maverick” Mitchell finds himself training a detachment of TOP GUN graduates for a specialized mission the likes of which no living pilot has ever seen.

items.title: Shake Rattle And Roll Evil Origins
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In 1775 during the Spanish colonial period in the Philippines, nuns attempts to survive the night after an unknown evil was set free in their cloister. Meanwhile in 2025, a group of friends attend a Halloween masquerade ball which was attacked by a serial killer. Fast forward to the future in 2050, a post-apocalytic Philippines is ruled by the aswang.

items.title: The Ballad of Wallis Island
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An eccentric lottery winner who lives alone on a remote island tries to make his fantasies come true by getting his favourite musicians to perform at his home.

items.title: Protector
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Nikki's life is shattered when her daughter is kidnapped. Thrust into the criminal underworld while hunted by cops and military, she must fight to rescue her child.

items.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Andy Sachs returns to Runway as Miranda Priestly navigates a new media landscape and Runway's position within. The duo reconnect with former assistant Emily Charlton, now the head of a luxury brand that possesses funding which could ensure Runway's survival.

items.title: The Devils Mouth
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Five college friends set off to explore the Devil's Mouth cave system in Thailand for one last adventure before life in the real world begins. But they soon discover that something is hunting them under the water… fast, silent, and deadly. In the suffocating darkness, trust erodes, panic spreads, and every wrong turn becomes a fight for survival.

items.title: Ghost Train
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Da-kyung, a horror YouTuber desperate for views, uploads a video about the eerie urban legends surrounding Gwanglim Station—the site of the highest number of missing person cases in the country. The video goes viral overnight. Despite everyone's warnings, Da-kyung's thirst for views only grows stronger. But as she digs deeper, she uncovers a shocking secret behind the station…

items.title: Godzilla x Kong - The New Empire
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Following their explosive showdown, Godzilla and Kong must reunite against a colossal undiscovered threat hidden within our world, challenging their very existence – and our own.

items.title: Godzilla vs Kong
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In a time when monsters walk the Earth, humanity’s fight for its future sets Godzilla and Kong on a collision course that will see the two most powerful forces of nature on the planet collide in a spectacular battle for the ages.

items.title: My Dead Friend Zoe
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Merit, a U.S. Army veteran suffering from PTSD, is repeatedly tortured by visions of her deceased friend and company buddy Zoe. After her Afghanistan service in 2016, she attends group therapy until Dale, her grandfather and former Lieutenant Colonel, is recently diagnosed with Alzheimer's. Merit steps up to his aide, and discovers more about herself and her family, while also gaining the courage to put her metaphorical demons to rest.

items.title: Shutter Island
items.subtitle: English
items.description: World War II soldier-turned-U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels investigates the disappearance of a patient from a hospital for the criminally insane, but his efforts are compromised by troubling visions and a mysterious doctor.

items.title: Supergirl
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When an unexpected and ruthless adversary strikes too close to home, Kara Zor-El, aka Supergirl, reluctantly joins forces with an unlikely companion on an epic, interstellar journey of vengeance and justice.

items.title: The Italian Job
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Charlie Croker pulled off the crime of a lifetime. The one thing that he didn't plan on was being double-crossed. Along with a drop-dead gorgeous safecracker, Croker and his team take off to re-steal the loot and end up in a pulse-pounding, pedal-to-the-metal chase that careens up, down, above and below the streets of Los Angeles.

items.title: Kong - Skull Island
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Explore the mysterious and dangerous home of the king of the apes as a team of explorers ventures deep inside the treacherous, primordial island.

items.title: Godzilla - King of the Monsters
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Follows the heroic efforts of the crypto-zoological agency Monarch as its members face off against a battery of god-sized monsters, including the mighty Godzilla, who collides with Mothra, Rodan, and his ultimate nemesis, the three-headed King Ghidorah. When these ancient super-species, thought to be mere myths, rise again, they all vie for supremacy, leaving humanity's very existence hanging in the balance.

items.title: Godzilla
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Ford Brody, a Navy bomb expert, has just reunited with his family in San Francisco when he is forced to go to Japan to help his estranged father, Joe. Soon, both men are swept up in an escalating crisis when an ancient alpha predator arises from the sea to combat malevolent adversaries that threaten the survival of humanity. The creatures leave colossal destruction in their wake, as they make their way toward their final battleground: San Francisco.

items.title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Dumbledore tries to prepare Harry for the final battle with Voldemort while Death Eaters wreak havoc in both Muggle and Wizard worlds.

items.title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When his name emerges from the Goblet of Fire, Harry Potter becomes a competitor in a grueling battle for glory among three wizarding schools. Signs of Voldemort's return emerge as Harry's friends help him prepare for the Triwizard Tournament.

items.title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Harry Potter's life is in danger once more as dangerous wizard Sirius Black has escaped from Azkaban Prison and is heading to Hogwarts.

items.title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerers Stone
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Harry Potter has lived under the stairs at his aunt and uncle's house his whole life. But on his 11th birthday, he learns he's a powerful wizard—with a place waiting for him at the Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. As he learns to harness his newfound powers with the help of the school's kindly headmaster, Harry uncovers the truth about his parents' deaths—and about the villain who's to blame.

items.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows - Part 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Harry, Ron and Hermione continue their quest to vanquish the evil Voldemort once and for all. Just as things begin to look hopeless for the young wizards, Harry discovers a trio of magical objects that endow him with powers to rival Voldemort's formidable skills.

items.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows - Part 1
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Harry, Ron and Hermione walk away from their last year at Hogwarts to find and destroy the remaining Horcruxes, putting an end to Voldemort's bid for immortality. But with Harry's beloved Dumbledore dead and Voldemort's unscrupulous Death Eaters on the loose, the world is more dangerous than ever.

items.title: 72 Hours
items.subtitle: English
items.description: To save his career, a 40-year-old ad exec joins a crew of twentysomethings for a wild Miami bachelor party after they mistakenly add him to a group chat.

items.title: The Truthers
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After her mother's sudden death, Ruth returns to her hometown and reunites with her father, whose odd behavior makes her question what really happened.

items.title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When a new professor's methods leave Hogwarts unprepared to fight the rising tide of evil, Harry teaches students how to defend against the dark arts.

items.title: Elize Shadows of a Woman
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In this retelling of a real case, a former escort discovers her wealthy husband's infidelity and struggles to cope as betrayal poisons their marriage.

items.title: Love in Slow Motion
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When Haya's best friend Jawad gets engaged, her chronically-single world unravels — because who knew true love could be hiding in the friend zone?

items.title: The Debt Collector
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Haunted by guilt after prison, a former debt collector races against a terminal illness, returning to his old world to avenge loan shark victims.

items.title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Cars fly, trees fight back, and a mysterious house-elf comes to warn Harry Potter at the start of his second year at Hogwarts. Adventure and danger await when bloody writing on a wall announces: The Chamber Of Secrets Has Been Opened. To save Hogwarts will require all of Harry, Ron and Hermione's magical abilities and courage.

items.title: Masters of the Universe
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After being separated for 15 years, the Sword of Power leads Prince Adam back to Eternia, where he discovers his home shattered under the fiendish rule of Skeletor. To save his family and his world, Adam must join forces with his closest allies, Teela and Duncan/Man-At-Arms, and embrace his true destiny as He-Man — the most powerful man in the universe.

items.title: Kate
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A ruthless criminal operative has less than 24 hours to exact revenge on her enemies and in the process forms an unexpected bond with the daughter of one of her past victims.

items.title: National Lampoons Van Wilder
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Van Wilder has been attending college for far too many years and is scared to graduate, but Van’s father eventually realizes what is going on. When he stops paying his son's tuition fees, Van must come up with the money if he wants to stay in college, so he and his friends come up with a great fund-raising idea – throwing parties. However, when the college magazine finds out and reporter Gwen is sent to do a story on Van Wilder, things get a little complicated.

items.title: The Ugly Truth
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A romantically challenged morning show producer is reluctantly embroiled in a series of outrageous tests by her chauvinistic correspondent to prove his theories on relationships and help her find love. His clever ploys, however, lead to an unexpected result.

items.title: Disclosure Day
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A cybersecurity expert becomes a whistleblower after uncovering secrets about aliens, putting him on the run from a corporation. Meanwhile, a meteorologist experiencing strange phenomena joins forces with him to prove there's life beyond our understanding.

items.title: Good Luck, Have Fun, Dont Die
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A 'Man from the Future' arrives at an LA diner where he must recruit the precise combination of disgruntled patrons to join him on a one-night quest to save the world from the terminal threat of a rogue artificial intelligence.

items.title: Exodus - Gods and Kings
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The defiant leader Moses rises up against the Egyptian Pharaoh Ramses, setting 400,000 slaves on a monumental journey of escape from Egypt and its terrifying cycle of deadly plagues.

items.title: Scary Movie
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Twenty-six years after outrunning a suspiciously familiar masked killer, the Core Four are back in the killer's crosshairs and no horror movie IP is safe.

items.title: The Devil Wears Prada
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A young woman from the Midwest gets more than she bargained for when she moves to New York to become a writer and ends up as the assistant to the tyrannical, larger-than-life editor-in-chief of a major fashion magazine.

items.title: 13 Days,13 Nights
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Kabul, August 15, 2021. US troops are preparing to withdraw from Afghanistan, while the Taliban are marching on the capital to seize power. Amid the chaos, Commander Mohamed Bida and his men are in charge of security at the French embassy, the last Western mission to remain open. Trapped along with 500 people, left to their own devices, the team must reach the airport at all costs. A perilous mission with no guarantee of success to flee the hell of Kabul and rescue what remains of humanity.

items.title: The Dictator
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The heroic story of a dictator who risks his life to ensure that democracy would never come to the country he so lovingly oppressed.

items.title: The Lost City
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Reclusive author Loretta Sage writes about exotic places in her popular adventure novels that feature a handsome cover model named Alan. While on tour promoting her new book with Alan, Loretta gets kidnapped by an eccentric billionaire who hopes she can lead him to the ancient city's lost treasure that featured in her latest story. Alan, determined to prove he can be a hero in real life and not just on the pages of her books, sets off to rescue her.

items.title: The Silent Planet
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An aging convict serving out a life sentence alone on a distant planet is forced to confront his past when a new prisoner shows up and pushes him to remember his life on earth.

items.title: Insidious - Out of the Further
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

items.title: Doing Life
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A single mother and an incarcerated man forge an unlikely bond through heartfelt letters, unlocking a door to redemption, hope and love against all odds.

items.title: Ip Man - Kung Fu Legend
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In 1950s Hong Kong, British merchants and Chinese triads have joined forces to expand their territory, forcibly demolishing factories without regard for public welfare. This move draws fierce opposition from Ip Man, standing up for the workers, he faces pressure from all sides. Framed for murder, he is sent to prison. Within the prison walls, the triads set multiple deadly traps. Can Ip Man overcome these trials, escape the danger, and clear his name?

items.title: Ballerina
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Grieving the loss of a best friend she couldn't protect, an ex-bodyguard sets out to fulfill her dear friend's last wish: sweet revenge.

items.title: Hacksaw Ridge
items.subtitle: English
items.description: WWII American Army Medic Desmond T. Doss, who served during the Battle of Okinawa, refuses to kill people and becomes the first Conscientious Objector in American history to receive the Congressional Medal of Honor.

items.title: Hokum
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When novelist Ohm Bauman retreats to a remote inn to scatter his parents' ashes, he is consumed by tales of a witch haunting the honeymoon suite. Disturbing visions and a shocking disappearance forces him to confront dark corners of his past.

items.title: The Woman in the Yard
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In the aftermath of her husband's death, widow Ramona's struggle to raise her two kids is hindered by the arrival of a mysterious woman with supernatural abilities.

items.title: Texas Chainsaw
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A young woman learns that she has inherited a Texas estate from her deceased grandmother. After embarking on a road trip with friends to uncover her roots, she finds she is the sole owner of a lavish, isolated Victorian mansion. But her newfound wealth comes at a price as she stumbles upon a horror that awaits her in the mansion’s dank cellars.

items.title: I Spit on Your Grave 3
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Jennifer Hills is still tormented by the brutal sexual assault she endured years ago. She’s changed identities and cities, reluctantly joining a support group where she begins to piece together a new life. But when her new friend’s murderer goes free and the tales of serial rapists haunt her, Jennifer will hunt down the men responsible and do what the system won’t – make them pay for their crimes in the most horrific ways imaginable. Only this time, no jury may be able to save her.

items.title: I Spit on Your Grave 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Broke, and in desperate need to update her portfolio, New York City model Katie calls a number from a tear-off flyer offering free photos. But this innocent attempt quickly turns into an unthinkable kidnapping nightmare where she's ripped away from everyone and everything she knows.

items.title: I Spit on Your Grave
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A beautiful woman from the city, Jennifer Hills, rents an isolated cabin in the country to write her latest novel. Soon, a group of local lowlifes subject her to a nightmare of degradation, rape, and violence.

items.title: The Wish of the Fairy Fish
items.subtitle: English
items.description: If you go fishing, be prepared to draw the fish of your dreams, the magical Pike, which can grant any three wishes. Only Emelya let two wishes down the drain, and decided to save the third. Therefore, in order to achieve the hand of the royal daughter Anfisa, he will have to act without magical power, on his own. And Pike will help him, who without her skin will appear as an ordinary girl Vasilisa.

items.title: One Night Only
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

items.title: Monster Island
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In the Pacific, 1944, a Japanese soldier and a British prisoner of war are stranded on a deserted island, hunted by a deadly creature. Two mortal enemies must come together to survive the unknown.

items.title: Mother - Android
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Georgia and her boyfriend Sam go on a treacherous journey to escape their country, which is caught in an unexpected war with artificial intelligence. Days away from the arrival of their first child, the couple must face No Man’s Land—a stronghold of the android uprising—in hopes of reaching safety before giving birth.

items.title: Sultana
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Sultana is a drama set in Istanbul's one and only strip club, telling a story of a women, power, rivalry and solidarity. A new Turkish story where women are not victims in a fairy tale, but warriors learning that the 'handsome prince' is often the real monster- and their only salvation is each other. Meral the long reigning queen of the one and only strip club of Istanbul which is Sultana, takes a talented new Belarusian dancer named Anna under her wing. But she soon realizes she has created a rival powerful enough to replace her, and a ruthless power struggle erupts between the two women.

items.title: The End of Oak Street
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

items.title: Deep Murder
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Set in an alternate reality in which everyone is a cliché from a tacky porn film, a group of increasingly self-aware stock characters are up against a mysterious killer offing them one by one.

items.title: A Great Awakening
items.subtitle: English
items.description: One of the most defining moments in American history is the story of an unlikely friendship between the Reverend George Whitefield and Benjamin Franklin.

items.title: White Elephant
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An ex-marine enforcer must battle his conscience and code of honor when he is forced to do things for the mob.

items.title: Pinocchio Unstrung
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Influenced by a sinister Cricket and created by Geppetto, Pinocchio launches a violent crusade to carve himself into a real boy like his brother James, one piece at a time.

items.title: Go Team
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Gracias, equipo follows a struggling Spanish cheese company whose rural team-building retreat spirals into betrayal and layoffs, satirizing office politics and corporate absurdity.

items.title: Salmokji - Whispering Water
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An incident unfolds when a film crew goes to a reservoir to update the road view where an unidentified figure was filmed, and they encounter something in the dark, deep waters.

items.title: Why Did I Get Married Again
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The couples reunite for the destination wedding of Marcus and Angela's daughter, bringing drama old and new as they ask, "Why did we get married again?"

items.title: Hungry
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A group of holidaymakers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose after becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands.

items.title: Call My Agent The Movie
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Five years after ASK Agency closed, debut director Andréa loses her lead actor just days before filming and reunited with her old team — for better or worse.

items.title: Drawn Together
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Marfil Cortés, a daughter of a wealthy Spanish businessman, is kidnapped and released, leading her father to hire Sebastian Moore as a bodyguard. Despite initial clashes, they form an irremediable attraction, navigating a world where no one is who they say they are.

items.title: Last Days
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Determined to fulfill his life’s mission, 26-year-old John Allen Chau embarks on a dangerous adventure across the globe to convert the uncontacted tribe of North Sentinel Island to Christianity, while a detective from the Andaman Islands races to stop him before he does harm to himself or the tribe.

items.title: Midsommar
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Several friends travel to Sweden to study as anthropologists a summer festival that is held every ninety years in the remote hometown of one of them. What begins as a dream vacation in a place where the sun never sets, gradually turns into a dark nightmare as the mysterious inhabitants invite them to participate in their disturbing festive activities.

items.title: Like Crazy
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A British college student falls for an American student, only to be separated from him when she's banned from the U.S. after overstaying her visa.

items.title: Sinners
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

items.title: Wanted
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Doormat Wesley Gibson is an office worker whose life is going nowhere. He meets an attractive woman named Fox and discovers that his recently murdered father - whom Wesley never knew - belonged to the Fraternity, a secret society of assassins which takes its orders from Fate itself. Fox and Sloan, the Fraternity's leader, teach Wesley, through intense training, to tap into dormant powers and hone his innate killing skills. Though he enjoys his newfound abilities, he begins to suspect that there is more to the Fraternity than meets the eye.

items.title: Normal
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An unassuming substitute sheriff with a troubled past responds to a bank robbery in a small, sleepy town and unknowingly uncovers something far more explosive.

items.title: Star Wars - The Mandalorian and Grogu
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The evil Empire has fallen, and Imperial warlords remain scattered throughout the galaxy. As the fledgling New Republic works to protect everything the Rebellion fought for, they have enlisted the help of legendary Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin and his young apprentice Grogu.

items.title: The Runner
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A high-powered attorney must race through London, following the cryptic commands of a mysterious caller, as she fights against time to save her abducted son.

items.title: The Twilight Saga - Breaking Dawn - Part 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After the birth of Renesmee, the Cullens gather other vampire clans in order to protect the child from a false allegation that puts the family in front of the Volturi.

items.title: The Twilight Saga - Breaking Dawn - Part 1
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Bella Swan and Edward Cullen's honeymoon phase is abruptly disrupted by betrayals and unforeseen tragedies that endanger their world.

items.title: The Twilight Saga - Eclipse
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Bella once again finds herself surrounded by danger as Seattle is ravaged by a string of mysterious killings and a malicious vampire continues her quest for revenge. In the midst of it all, she is forced to choose between her love for Edward and her friendship with Jacob, knowing that her decision has the potential to ignite the ageless struggle between vampire and werewolf. With her graduation quickly approaching, Bella is confronted with the most important decision of her life.

items.title: The Twilight Saga - New Moon
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Forks, Washington resident Bella Swan is reeling from the departure of her vampire love, Edward Cullen, and finds comfort in her friendship with Jacob Black, a werewolf. But before she knows it, she's thrust into a centuries-old conflict, and her desire to be with Edward at any cost leads her to take greater and greater risks.

items.title: Twilight
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When Bella Swan moves to a small town in the Pacific Northwest, she falls in love with Edward Cullen, a mysterious classmate who reveals himself to be a 108-year-old vampire. Despite Edward's repeated cautions, Bella can't stay away from him, a fatal move that endangers her own life.

items.title: Badland
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Detective Matthias Breecher, hired to track down the worst of the Confederate war criminals, roams the Old West seeking justice. His resolve is tested when he meets a determined pioneer woman who is far more than she seems.

items.title: Margin Call
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Set in the high-stakes world of the financial industry, involving the key players at an investment firm during one perilous 24-hour period in the early stages of the 2008 financial crisis. An entry-level analyst unlocks information that could prove to be the downfall of the firm.

items.title: The Orphans
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Gab and Driss, childhood friends on bad terms since they left the orphanage, now have opposite lives - one is a cop with the IGPN, the other a fixer for thugs. When their first love dies in a suspicious accident, her 17-year-old daughter, Leïla, takes Gab's gun and sets off on the trail of a powerful organization willing to do anything to cover the case up. Forced to team up, the orphans must stop her before she crosses a line she can't return from...

items.title: King of Prison
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Man-hee, imprisoned for being caught up in an accidental violent case, will be admitted to a violent room where the king of prison can be found. On the other hand, with Tae-soo, the opposition leader being admitted to the same prison, a group of people who are unhappy with the king gather one by one, and the gang members face a desperate crisis.

items.title: The Bay
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Best friends Emma and Lani, attending a destination wedding in Thailand, find themselves trapped on a sinking tour boat in the heart of a tiger shark sanctuary.

items.title: The Whisper Man
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.

items.title: The Wedding Banquet
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Frustrated with his commitment-phobic boyfriend Chris and running out of time, Min makes a proposal: a green-card marriage with their friend Angela in exchange for her partner Lee's expensive IVF. Elopement plans are upended, however, when Min's grandmother surprises them with an extravagant Korean wedding banquet.

items.title: Walking Against The Rain
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Two strangers, Blair and Tommy, are navigating their way across a barren landscape in a desperate attempt to find each other. With their only form of communication being two soon-to-die battery operated radio mics and with a new evil in the shape of 'The Forsaken' tracking them down, they must learn to confront loss and rediscover a trust in humanity.

items.title: The One
items.subtitle: English
items.description: On August 24, 1981, the newlyweds Larisa and Vladimir Savitsky stepped on board the plane following the flight Komsomolsk-on-Amur - Blagoveshchensk. 30 minutes before landing, the civilian aircraft AN-24 collided with another aircraft and broke into pieces at an altitude of more than 5 kilometers above the ground. No one was supposed to survive ... but a miracle happened. Larisa Savitskaya woke up in the middle of the wreckage of the plane in the impenetrable taiga. Now she herself had to create a real miracle, which only a strong-minded person is capable of.

items.title: The Phantom Empire
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When a man-eating cave creature appears with a fortune in uncut diamonds around his neck, Dr Chambers' daughter Denae hires adventurers C and C Salvage to find the underground source of the gems.

items.title: White House Down
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Capitol Policeman John Cale has just been denied his dream job with the Secret Service protecting President James Sawyer. Not wanting to let down his little girl with the news, he takes her on a tour of the White House, when the complex is overtaken by a heavily armed paramilitary group. Now, with the nation's government falling into chaos and time running out, it's up to Cale to save the president, his daughter, and the country.

items.title: Secret Stories - Roslin
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A 17-year-old girl is plagued by nightmares of a green-eyed stalker, pulling her into a spiral of fear and despair.

items.title: Sangamarmar
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The show centers on Amrita, a young woman whose life changes drastically when she must choose between love and family obligations.

items.title: Psycho Saiyaan
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Animal lover Kartik Pandey, a poetic student in Ujjain, falls obsessively in love with Charulata. When she disappears, a cryptic clue leads him to Huntry Chauhan, a ruthless gangster-politician holding her captive. To rescue her, Kartik enters a dangerous world of power, violence, and manipulation-where love may ultimately destroy him.

items.title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A century before the events of Game of Thrones, two unlikely heroes wandered Westeros: a young, naive but courageous knight, Ser Duncan the Tall, and his diminutive squire, Egg. Set in an age when the Targaryen line still holds the Iron Throne and the last dragon has not yet passed from living memory, great destinies, powerful foes, and dangerous exploits await these improbable and incomparable friends.

items.title: The Night Agent
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Coming off the explosive events of Season Two, Night Agent Peter Sutherland is called in to track down a young Treasury Agent who fled to Istanbul with sensitive government intel after killing his boss. This kicks off a sequence of events where Peter investigates a dark money network while avoiding its paid assassins, while putting him on a collision course with a relentless journalist. Working together, they uncover buried secrets and old grudges that threaten to bring the government to its knees -- and get them both killed in the process.

items.title: Paava Kadhaigal
items.subtitle: English
items.description: At times dark, at times disturbing, four short films explore stories of those who dare to dream and desire — and those determined to stand in their way.

items.title: Bandwaale
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Mariam, a young poetess, finds herself trapped in a sleepy town, where every young girl's future lies in wedlock. Mariam hopes to find her freedom against all odds, by uploading her poetry on the internet through an anonymous account.Along with her band of misfits - Robo and Psy, Mariam discovers the power of her poetry and her own voice.

items.title: Dil Dhokha Aur Desire
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Duty spirals into a volatile triangle of love, loyalty and betrayal when the dreams of a young boxer lands him in the dangerous world of a ruthless businessman, entangling him with his wife, the one woman he was hired to protect. He must now choose who, and what, he’s willing to lose.

items.title: Kohrra
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A new murder mystery intrigues the Punjab police with complex family dynamics, shocking secrets, and crimes at play.

items.title: Amar Vishwas
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Amar Vishwas is a gripping legal drama about a fearless lawyer who believes that the law has value only when it protects the truly innocent. Shaped by a painful past, Amar has built his life around one unbreakable principal - if a person is innocent in reality, justice must be delivered, even if it means crossing boundries.

items.title: Fallout
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Will the Ghoul be able to find his family? Will Lucy return to Vault No. 33? Will Maximus and Lucy unite? Will the cold fusion finally restore order? Will Hank MacLean succeed in his evil plans? Tune in to the second season for answers to many such questions, more twists, secrets, drama and fights!

items.title: Shabad - Reet aur Riwaaz
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The story highlights generational divides and the conflict between traditional family duties (Reet/Riwaaz) and personal aspirations.

items.title: Daldal
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Rita Ferreira, the youngest DCP of the Mumbai Crime Branch, must battle a patriarchal mindset at work and her own impostor syndrome as she embarks on an investigation that puts her on a collision course with a cold-blooded killer.

items.title: Wonder Man
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Aspiring Hollywood actor Simon Williams is struggling to get his career off the ground. During a chance meeting with Trevor Slattery, an actor whose biggest roles may be well behind him, Simon learns that legendary director Von Kovak is remaking the superhero film "Wonder Man." These two actors at opposite ends of their careers doggedly pursue life-changing roles in this film as audiences get a peek behind the curtain of the entertainment industry.

items.title: Space Gen - Chandrayaan
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The story behind lunar exploration mission, Chandrayaan 2, developed by Indian Space Research Organisation.

items.title: Steal
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A high-octane, heart-pounding thriller about the heist of the century. A typical day at Lochmill Capital is upended when armed thieves burst in and force Zara (Sophie Turner) and her best friend Luke (Archie Madekwe) to execute their demands. In the aftermath, conflicted detective Rhys (Jacob Fortune-Lloyd) races against time to find out who stole £4 billion pounds of people's pensions and why.

items.title: The Pitt
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The staff of Pittsburgh's Trauma Medical Center work around the clock to save lives in an overcrowded and underfunded emergency department.

items.title: Bindiya Ke Bahubali
items.subtitle: English
items.description: As Bada Davan tries to make mends with Bhamirs, Chhote davan's ambition comes in the way. Everyone in Davan family tries to find ways for their ambitions in middle of chaotic comedy that turns into tragedy. Power, politics, and family collide as Chhote Davan rises and the empire implodes. Between betrayals, blackmail, and bloodshed, love turns into vengeance and ambition into annihilation.

items.title: Can This Love Be Translated
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A love story that begins between a multilingual interpreter and a top actress, and depicts the challenges of their romantic relationship.

items.title: Bhootiyapa
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Sanjay plans a serious ghost doc, but the ghosts turn it into their personal reality show. Bhanu bosses everyone, Razia wants her "possessed baby" back, Labanga keeps dragging in strangers, and Sukumari falls for a ghost who might not even be dead. Total bhoot-chaos follows!

items.title: Taskaree - The Smugglers Web
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A customs officer and his team are on a mission to apprehend the boss of a smuggling syndicate.

items.title: The Night Manager
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Jonathan Pine thought he'd buried his past. Now living as Alex Goodwin - a low-level MI6 officer running a quiet surveillance unit in London - his life is comfortingly uneventful.

items.title: The Night Manager
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The Night Manager is based on the internationally acclaimed novel by master storyteller John Le Carre. This suspenseful thriller follows Jonathan Pine, as he endeavours to bring down the notorious arms dealer Richard Roper.

items.title: Freedom at Midnight
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Based on Larry Collins and Dominique Lapierre's bestselling book, Freedom At Midnight dramatizes the events leading to India's Partition and its socio-political upheaval. Starring Sidhant Gupta, Chirag Vohra, Rajendra Chawla, Luke McGibney, Cordelia Bugeja, Arif Zakaria, and Ira Dubey, the acclaimed series returns with Season 2, continuing the gripping saga of independence and its aftermath.

items.title: Mayor of Kingstown
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In season four, Mike's control over Kingstown is threatened as new players compete to fill the power vacuum left in the Russians' wake, compelling him to confront the resulting gang war and stop them from swallowing the town. Meanwhile, with those he loves in more danger than ever before, Mike must contend with a headstrong new Warden to protect his own while grappling with demons from his past.

items.title: Regai
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Rachel decides to take her three year old daughter to daycare. As the days pass, the woman feels that the teacher turns too with her daughter, reaching an almost obsessive relationship.

items.title: The Great Indian Kapil Show
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Season 4 of The Great Indian Kapil Show brings back India’s most loved comedy talk show with a grander scale, sharper humor, and an even wider range of celebrity guests. Hosted by Kapil Sharma, the season once again combines laugh-out-loud sketches, candid celebrity interviews, and musical performances, making it a wholesome entertainer for audiences of all ages. This season, Kapil is joined by his trusted ensemble including Sunil Grover, Krushna Abhishek, Kiku Sharda, and Archana Puran Singh, who deliver hilarious skits rooted in relatable everyday situations. The season also experiments with business-themed specials, film promotions, and personal storytelling that offer a refreshing mix of comedy and insight.

items.title: 90s A Middle Class Biopic
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Raghu's typical middle-class family consists of a strict father-cum-math teacher, Shekar; a homemaker mother, Sobha Rani; his partner in crime, Divya; and the youngest and naughtiest in the family, Aditya. Amid their daily struggles with academic pressures, coming-of-age problems, and financial burdens you will laugh, cry, and connect with Shekar and family like your own.

items.title: AIR - All India Rankers
items.subtitle: English
items.description: College isn’t just about marks and ranks – it’s about late-night bonding, messy dreams, unstoppable pressure, and memories that last forever. AIR brings to life the most nostalgic and real journey of every student in India.

items.title: Mrs Deshpande
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A woman in jail helps police catch a killer who copies her crimes. She must work with her own son, making the case emotional and dangerous.

items.title: Pharma
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A medical representative fight against corruption in the pharmaceutical industry.

items.title: Kesariya@100
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A journey commemorating 100 years of RSS, a selfless, nationalist organisation. The story of one man's dream that inspired a million minds to build a legacy of resilience and unwavering patriotism.

items.title: IT - Welcome to Derry
items.subtitle: English
items.description: IT: Welcome to Derry delves into the origins of Pennywise the Clown, set in the hauntingly eerie town of Derry, Maine. The prequel explores the dark history of the cursed town, unraveling the sinister events and horrifying secrets that paved the way for Stephen King's iconic IT saga.

items.title: Bhay - The Gaurav Tiwari Mystery
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Gaurav Tiwari, a paranormal investigator, faces his greatest challenge when his pursuit of the truth behind unexplained phenomena leads him into a deadly spiral. As his mysterious death leaves questions unanswered, a journalist delves into his eerie and celebrated legacy, unearthing secrets that blur the line between reality and the supernatural.

items.title: Single Papa
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Gaurav Gehlot (Kunal Kemmu) faces the challenges of single parenthood when he decides to adopt a child.

items.title: Real Kashmir Football Club
items.subtitle: English
items.description: From the heart of Kashmir comes a true story of grit, unity, and a beautiful sport. Two dreamers and twenty underdogs, against all odds, build one of India's most unlikely professional football clubs, turning passion into a force that brings everyone together - showing the world what hope truly looks like!

items.title: The Abandons
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A rich and powerful group tries to steal land from poor families. The families unite and fight back to protect their home and future.

items.title: Kuttram Purindhavan - The Guilty One
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A retired police officer who becomes entangled in a missing child case, drawing him into a world of guilt, emotional conflict, hidden truths, and unpredictable twists.

items.title: Aukaat Ke Bahar
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Violence, foul language, sexual content, alcohol use, tobacco depictions, Imitable behaviour, Fighting, Flashing lights and strobing patterns might affect photosensitive viewers

items.title: Stranger Things
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The fall of 1987. Hawkins is scarred by the opening of the Rifts, and our heroes are united by a single goal: find and kill Vecna. But he has vanished — his whereabouts and plans unknown. Complicating their mission, the government has placed the town under military quarantine and intensified its hunt for Eleven, forcing her back into hiding. As the anniversary of Will's disappearance approaches, so does a heavy, familiar dread. The final battle is looming — and with it, a darkness more powerful and more deadly than anything they've faced before. To end this nightmare, they'll need everyone — the full party — standing together, one last time.

items.title: Better Call Saul
items.subtitle: English
items.description: From the cartel to the courthouse, from Albuquerque to Omaha, season six tracks Jimmy, Saul and Gene as well as Jimmy's complex relationship with Kim, who is in the midst of her own existential crisis. Meanwhile, Mike, Gus, Nacho and Lalo are locked into a game of cat and mouse with mortal stakes.

items.title: Better Call Saul
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Changing his name to Saul Goodman, Jimmy recruits a new crop of clients. Kim wrestles with a moral dilemma at work. Lalo's feud with Gus heats up.

items.title: Better Call Saul
items.subtitle: English
items.description: As Jimmy copes with a shocking loss, a series of shady schemes propel him deeper into the criminal world -- and closer to his life as Saul Goodman.

items.title: Better Call Saul
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Jimmy resorts to ever more desperate measures to keep his law career afloat, while Mike is drawn into the orbit of a mysterious new figure.

items.title: Better Call Saul
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Jimmy McGill returns with a new outlook on life and growing appetites that will push his career -- and his relationships -- into uncharted territory.

items.title: Better Call Saul
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Jimmy McGill was a small-time lawyer, hustling to make ends meet. This is how the search for his destiny and the story of Saul Goodman collide.

items.title: The Family Man
items.subtitle: English
items.description: On a personal mission to avenge an assassination, Srikant Tiwari unravels a devious conspiracy that threatens to send India to the brink of war.

items.title: Co-Ed (Ep.01-06)
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Twins Shikha and Nikhil couldn't be more different. But when their all-boys and all-girls schools suddenly go co-ed, the chaos of teenagehood hits them head-on. Now, both must confront new feelings, friendships, and the messy business of growing up together.A

items.title: Dirty Scams
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A fast-paced show about clever women who run very smart scams. Each episode tells the story of a different woman using her smarts to trick people and get what she wants. No matter how risky it gets, she always finishes the job. The show is cool, tough, and inspired from real-life crimes.

items.title: Landman
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Landman is a series directed by Stephen Kay, Michael Friedman and Taylor Sheridan. The series stars Billy Bob Thornton, Ali Larter and Jacob Lofland in the lead roles.

items.title: Last Samurai Standing
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A warrior, Shujiro Saga, enters a dangerous competition to help his family.

items.title: The Crystal Cuckoo
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Hoping to learn more about her heart donor, a young doctor arrives in a mountain town where' decades of mysterious tragedies plague the small community.

items.title: Delhi Crime
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Vartika (Shefali Shah) and her squad return this season to solve more criminal cases in the Delhi region.

items.title: Family Matters
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A group with special abilities pretends to be a family to escape criminals. They face challenges from both their unique powers and the threats surrounding them.

items.title: Thode Door Thode Paas
items.subtitle: English
items.description: If family members stay away from the digital world for six months, they will receive a large sum of money. Will they be able to pass Ashwin Mehta's (Pankaj Kapur) challenge?

items.title: As You Stood By
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When two women plot to end an abusive marriage through murder, an unexpected visitor arrives — threatening to shatter everything they've planned.

items.title: Maharani
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In the new season, Rani (Huma Qureshi) faces new challenges.

items.title: First Copy Ep.01-10
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In 1990s Mumbai, a struggling young man joins a film production company but turns to video piracy after facing workplace humiliation. As his illegal empire grows, a determined cop closes in on the operation

items.title: The Witcher
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After the shocking, Continent-alter---ing events that close out Season 3, the new season follows Geralt, Yennefer, and Ciri, who are separated and traversing the war-ravaged Continent and its many demons. If they can embrace and lead the groups of misfits they find themselves in, they have a chance of surviving the baptism of fire — and finding one another again.

items.title: Peacemaker
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Peacemaker Season 2 continues the story of Christopher Smith, a jingoistic mercenary who believes in achieving peace at any cost.

items.title: Search - The Naina Murder Case
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A veteran police officer searches for the killer of a girl whose body is found in a politician's car.

items.title: 13th - Some Lessons Arent Taught in Classrooms
items.subtitle: English
items.description: 13th tells the story of Ritesh, a successful venture capitalist who reunites with his maverick IIT-JEE mentor, Mohit Tyagi Sir, to help scale his visionary educational institute. The series unfolds against the backdrop of India's most gruelling academic competition and a startup culture fixated on valuations. At its heart, 13th is a deeply nostalgic, human story of a master and his pupil-bound by ambition, respect, and the lessons that shape a lifetime.

items.title: Jamnapaar
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Shanky’s battle for his own identity collides with Jamnapaar’s quest for one. Torn between his father’s morality and his own ambitions, he steps into a new world—enthralling and transformative—that could change both him and Jamnapaar forever.

items.title: Kurukshetra
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A great war for dharma, between the Kauravas and the Pandavas, bound by blood, but torn by duty.

items.title: Peacemaker
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Peacemaker is committed to solving world issues by targeting dictators and other types of real-world villains.

items.title: The Game - You Never Play Alone
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A game designer who changes the game becomes entangled in a web of conspiracy.

items.title: Janaawar - The Beast Within
items.subtitle: English

items.description: The Ultimate Betrayal takes the Vijay-Waseem rivalry to its most personal and explosive chapter yet. Living under a false identity, Vijay Singh resurfaces after a devastating personal loss, reigniting his relentless pursuit of revenge against his greatest adversary, Waseem Khan.

items.title: Raktanchal
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Raktanchal is a crime drama inspired by real-life events from the '80s of Purvanchal, Uttar Pradesh, at the time when the state development work was distributed through tenders. The criminal empire of Waseem Khan, the tender mafia is challenged by a young criminal Vijay Singh who is driven by vengeance. The story sets in motion, a clash for acquiring tenders with a political battle in the background, which unleashes a bloodbath in the city of Purvanchal. Vijay must overcome great personal odds to beat Waseem Khan and become the tender king.

items.title: Raktanchal
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Raktanchal is a crime drama inspired by real-life events from the '80s of Purvanchal, Uttar Pradesh, at the time when the state development work was distributed through tenders. The criminal empire of Waseem Khan, the tender mafia is challenged by a young criminal Vijay Singh who is driven by vengeance. The story sets in motion, a clash for acquiring tenders with a political battle in the background, which unleashes a bloodbath in the city of Purvanchal. Vijay must overcome great personal odds to beat Waseem Khan and become the tender king.

items.title: Perfect Family
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Meet the Perfect Family - the lovable Karkarias. Perfect on the outside, but simmering with resentments, insecurities, and old wounds on the inside. When life hits hard, they're pushed into family therapy, where issues of trust, loyalty, and communication finally explode. With their quirks, chaos, and constant derailing of every session, progress is a miracle.

items.title: Decoupled
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In this unabashed comedy, a quirky novelist's offbeat opinions ruffle feathers with his soon-to-be-ex-wife... and almost everyone else he meets.

items.title: Rangbaaz - Darr Ki Rajneeti
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The series traces the rise and fall of ‘Saheb’ Haroon Shah Ali Baig, a gangster-turned-politician, who was much loved and feared in Bihar.

items.title: The East Palace
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A man who walks the spirit world and a court lady who hears the dead enter the East Palace by the king's orders — can they unravel its dark secrets?

items.title: The Map of Longing
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Before her death, Lucy creates a game for her sister, Greta, pushing her into a journey of self-discovery — and toward the charming Will Tucker.

items.title: Faadu
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Set in the year of the Indian economic meltdown, Abhay, an angry poet and dreamer from the dusty chawl of Kanjurmarg, aspires for a rags-to-riches story for himself. In this ambitious journey, he falls in love with Manjiri, a poetess with a starkly different view on life.

items.title: I Will Find You
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Wrongfully imprisoned for murdering his own son, a father sets out on a desperate rescue mission after learning the boy may still be alive.

items.title: Little House on the Prairie
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The close-knit Ingalls family builds a new life on the Western frontier, where the joys of nature and the struggle for survival are deeply intertwined.

items.title: Im Not Afraid
items.subtitle: English
items.description: 10-year-old Miguel stumbles upon a terrifying secret involving a boy trapped in a hole near his home.

items.title: Agent from Above
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Bound by a deity's pact, Han Chieh fights demons on Earth. When he uncovers an old enemy's plan for a second invasion, he must fight to save humanity.

items.title: Human Vapor
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A death on live TV. A culprit who turns to gas. Behind it, a secret project that used and discarded the vulnerable. One detective pursues the dark truth.

items.title: Chernobyl
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The true story of one of the worst man-made catastrophes in history: the catastrophic nuclear accident at Chernobyl. A tale of the brave men and women who sacrificed to save Europe from unimaginable disaster.

items.title: The Agency
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Martian is a CIA agent living undercover in his own life. Samia, his lover, is a political prisoner in Sudan, and he will do anything to try and save her, even past the point of treachery. The only way out is deeper in, which is a knife-edge Martian must walk if he is to save love, life, and his mission.

items.title: The Agency
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Undercover CIA agent Martian is ordered to return to London. When the woman he left behind suddenly reappears, their love is rekindled, entangling them in a deadly game of intrigue and international espionage.

items.title: Between Father and Son
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In just a few suspenseful minutes, a lawyer's world tilts as her visit to her fiancé's family estate ignites an irresistible bond with her future stepson.

items.title: Summer 36
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Quand deux mondes se rencontrent : la bourgeoisie d'un côté et la classe ouvrière qui découvre les congés payés de l'autre. L'action se situe sur la Côte d’Azur, où’un meurtre a été commis à l’Hôtel Negresco à Nice…

items.title: Ab Hoga Hisaab
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Recently-deported NRI Bobby's life shatters when brother Bunty vanishes. His search exposes a human-trafficking ring masked as a Canada immigration network. With Inspector Dosanjh's help, Bobby battles corruption to save his brother.

items.title: Pritam and Pedro
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Pedro and Pritam are distinct as night and day, but together they laugh every problem away. It's a battle of data versus danda, but a kahani of fun and chaos.

items.title: Super Subbu
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An unlucky teacher is assigned to teach sex ed in a hostile village. Can he balance this secret while chasing his dreams and saving his relationship?

items.title: Isakapatnam
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Set in the 1990s, in the ruthless port town of Isakapatnam, three forces collide—a woman driven by justice, a henchman torn by loyalty, and a common man hungry for revenge—each closing in on the empire built by the port’s most powerful man, Naidu.

items.title: Notes from the Last Row
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A literature professor discovers a student's talent and offers him writing lessons — but as he sinks into the story, their sessions spiral into chaos.

items.title: Avatar The Last Airbender
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A young boy known as the Avatar must master the four elemental powers to save a world at war — and fight a ruthless enemy bent on stopping him.

items.title: Lingam
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Framed for a crime he didn't commit, a kabaddi hero gets pushed into a world he never wanted and ultimately becomes a feared name.

items.title: Betaal
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A remote village becomes the arena of a breathless battle when an undead East India Company officer and his battalion of zombie redcoats attack a squad of modern-day soldiers

items.title: Gram Chikitsalay
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The young, idealistic and brilliant Dr. Prabhat, takes charge of a neglected Primary Health Centre in a North India Village hoping to bring about much needed changes only to realise it is he who will have do change before anything else.

items.title: Oasis
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Oasis is the most luxurious holiday resort in the country — a paradise reserved for the wealthiest families, featuring private beaches, VIP facilities, and impenetrable security. The perfect place to spend the best summer of your life. But everything falls apart when the police storm the resort to investigate a mysterious disappearance. In such an exclusive place, everyone is a suspect — and no one can leave until the culprit is found.

items.title: Gullak
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Set in quaint by-lanes in the heart of India, Gullak is a collection of disarming and relatable tales of the Mishra family.

items.title: Save the Tigers
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Revolves around three frustrated husbands who meet by chance and how their rants over their marital problems set off a series of crazy events.

items.title: Thukra Ke Mera Pyaar
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Two families clash over societal and caste differences spurring a saga of revenge. All this happens when a love story goes wrong.

items.title: Ab Hoga Hisaab
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Recently-deported NRI Bobby's life shatters when brother Bunty vanishes. His search exposes a human-trafficking ring masked as a Canada immigration network. With Inspector Dosanjh's help, Bobby battles corruption to save his brother.

items.title: Raakh
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When two teenagers vanish, a close-knit family is shattered and the city is left on edge. Determined to uncover the truth, a relentless officer leads a nationwide manhunt that pulls him deep into a world of violence and human depravity.

items.title: Every Year After
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Six summers to fall in love. One moment to fall apart. A week to get it right. A fun, sweeping, romantic story that asks the question, what if your first love actually was your soulmate?

items.title: Teach You a Lesson
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When respect collapses in schools, unconventional inspectors arrive to set things right with sharp, no-nonsense lessons you won't find in textbooks.

items.title: Brown
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Brown is a recovering alcoholic, who works for Kolkata Police and has to investigate the murder of a young woman from a well-known family.

items.title: The Pyramid Scheme
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Follows the story of Goldy, an ambitious but impatient young man, whose quest to get rich through a pyramid marketing business spirals into a rollercoaster of chaos - risking not just his future, but also the love and trust of his close-knit joint family.

items.title: Made in India - A Titan Story
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In a market ruled by smuggling and foreign brands, a determined Indian man Xerxes Desai, with the help of his team, dares to build a world-class watch from scratch. Battling rejection, failure, and global humiliation, they transform Titan into a symbol of national pride and innovation.

items.title: Spider Noir
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Private investigator Ben Reilly is hired on a couple of straightforward cases... until mobsters, monsters, and a mysterious femme fatale spin a web that brings him face to face with his former life as New York's only superhero: The Spider.

items.title: Brothers and Sisters
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Bound by love and unspoken truths, Shanmuga Sundaram and his devoted family's lives revolve around shared rituals... till hidden cracks begin to surface.

items.title: Whos Your Gynac
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Determined to prove that her decision to start a clinic was right, Dr. Vidushi Kothari prematurely returns her father's loan, only to struggle in keeping Choice & Care open.

items.title: Satrangi Badle ka Khel
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Witness the tale of Bablu, who is forced into Launda Naach, just like his murdered father. To what lengths will he go to avenge the wrongs that the powerful Singhs have bestowed on him and his family?

items.title: Vimal Khanna
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An accountant accused of killing his brother flees, assumes the identity Vimal Khanna, and faces blackmail while seeking his vanished wife. Survival and accidental heroism drive noir-style rescues and moral choices.

items.title: Undekhi
items.subtitle: English
items.description: From power to chaos, this is the journey so far. Everything built over time faces its end now!

items.title: Beinteha Ek Anokhi Dastaan
items.subtitle: None
items.description: A driven PR strategist, Ananya, enters Armaan Khanna’s cold and powerful world through a business project in Manali. What begins as professional admiration slowly turns into an unspoken attraction as Armaan unexpectedly values her ideas and lets her see the vulnerable silence behind his controlled exterior. Their chemistry deepens through late-night conversations, emotional moments, and subtle tension culminating in a quiet mountain moment where Armaan offers her a cigarette, hinting at the dangerous intimacy growing between them.

items.title: The Boroughs
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In a seemingly perfect retirement community, a crew of unlikely heroes must stop an otherworldly threat from stealing the one thing they don't have: time.

items.title: Business Proposal
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In disguise as her friend, Ha-ri shows up to a blind date to scare him away. But plans go awry when he turns out to be her CEO — and makes a proposal.

items.title: Looteri Dulhan
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Set across the Hindi heartland, Looteri Dulhan follows suspended police officer Sandhya Yadav as she chases Maya, a sharp and emotionally scarred con bride who targets wealthy men through fake marriages and disappears after looting them. As the investigation deepens from small-town Madhya Pradesh to Lucknow, the hunt slowly transforms into an emotional battle between two women shaped by survival, betrayal and difficult choices.

items.title: Berlin and the Lady with an Ermine
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Ansioso por dar un nuevo golpe, Berlín reúne a su banda en Sevilla y convierte a un ambicioso duque en víctima de su propio plan: robar una obra de arte de Leonardo da Vinci.

items.title: Inspector Avinash
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Set in 1998 UP, this is the story of a dynamic cop leading a Special Task Force which becomes instrumental in eliminating a dreaded weapons cartel.

items.title: Nemesis
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A relentless LAPD cop becomes obsessed with taking down the master thief behind a string of daring heists — and only one can come out on top.

items.title: Exam
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A determined young woman with a mysterious past enters the dangerous world of the Regional Public Service Exam (RPSE) scam to expose a powerful paper-leak network. But as she digs deeper, she uncovers a corruption chain embedded deep within the education system-and must bring it down before it destroys the dreams of an entire generation.

items.title: Off Campus
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Hannah Wells tutors hockey captain Garrett Graham to win over her crush. Their deal becomes real connection as they face their pasts. Friends Logan, Dean, Tucker, and Allie navigate college life and love.

items.title: Remarkably Bright Creatures
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Through unlikely bonds formed during night shifts at a local aquarium, Tova, an elderly widow, learns of a life-changing discovery that may bring her joy and wonder once again.

items.title: The Chestnut Man
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Detective Hess and Thulin reunite as they race against time to catch a perpetrator playing a disturbing game of hide and seek in the gloomy mists of Copenhagen's suburbs. As more victims are drawn into the deadly game and the body count rises, the duo must stop the killer before more lives are lost.

items.title: The Chestnut Man
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A figurine made of chestnuts is found at the scene of a grisly murder; from this creepy clue, two detectives hunt for a killer linked to a politician's missing child.

items.title: Legends
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In the early 1990s, Her Majesty’s Customs and Excise was losing its battle with illegal drug smuggling across Britain’s borders. In a top-secret operation, a small team of Customs employees were sent undercover with new identities and told to infiltrate Britain’s most dangerous drug gangs.

items.title: Lukkhe
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A young sportsman infiltrates the wild and dangerous world of Punjab's rap music to investigate a drug syndicate, only to find himself torn between love, family, guilt and brotherhood.

items.title: Citadel
items.subtitle: English
items.description: What if you lost your memory? What if a spy didn’t know they were a spy? Years ago, the top agents of Citadel, Mason Kane and Nadia Sinh, had their minds wiped. But, they’re called back to action as sinister forces emerge from the past. With the help of spymaster Bernard Orlick, these former lovers must remember the past to save the future.

items.title: Citadel
items.subtitle: English
items.description: One month after the events of the first season, Citadel spies are underground and being hunted by Manticore agents around the world. They're pulled out of hiding to join forces with a new team of unconventional spies when Manticore's Brazilian billionaire Paulo Braga threatens to unleash a cataclysmic piece of technology, built by Citadel's own Bernard Orlick, into the world.

items.title: NCR Days
items.subtitle: English
items.description: NCR Days depicts the life of a small town guy studying in a city that is completely contrasting to his perspectives in life.

items.title: Glory
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In a small-town boxing hub, two brothers investigate a shocking murder while navigating a troubled reunion with their father, a renowned coach

items.title: Sapne Vs Everyone
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Two men chase their dreams in different worlds. Prashant battles Mumbai's ruthless film industry to build his career, while Jimmy, a real estate salesman known as the "Sales God," will stop at nothing to take revenge on his Mama, as both question whether destiny is decided by fate or by those bold enough to take control of it.

items.title: Sapne Vs Everyone
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Two young men chase impossible dreams in the ruthless world of real estate sales. Prashant, driven by love, longs to be a great actor, while Jimmy, fueled by vengeance, seeks to be Delhi’s richest man. Both are obsessive dreamers with opposite paths. When fate unites them, they clash with each other and a brutal world that spares no one who dares to dream.

items.title: If Wishes Could Kill
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A mysterious app promises wishes — then starts a countdown to death. As a group of teens becomes entangled, they must break the deadly chain to survive.

items.title: Campus Beats
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Just as Ishaan and Netra finally embrace their love, fate throws them a curveball with Netra losing her memory! Now undercover in a new campus, Ishaan is determined to help her remember what they meant for one another! Along the way, they just might shake things up, bring a little joy to the campus, and rediscover their love!

items.title: Eyes
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Tina Sebastian, a police officer investigates disturbing cases involving women. As the investigation progresses, mental health professionals join forces with the police to understand the psychology of stalkers, identify warning signs and prevent situations from escalating.

items.title: Below
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a small Newfoundland town, a hard-bitten fisherman and his family fight to protect their close-knit community.

items.title: Lanterns
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

items.title: East of Eden
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In the early 1900s, a fiercely independent woman drives a rift between two brothers, igniting a saga that unfolds across two generations.

items.title: Carrie
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Misfit high schooler Carrie White has spent her life hidden away inside the walls of her home with her fiercely protective mother, Margaret. After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.

items.title: Ishqa Ishqa
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Kabir is a successful writer dating Suhani, who brings calm to his life. As he prepares for the sequel to his hit novel Ishqa Ishqa, inspired by Arohi, his childhood love, she is set to return to his life. Arohi brings the inspiration he needs for his writing, but her return threatens to disrupt the life Kabir has built with Suhani.

items.title: The Great Indian Kapil Show
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Comedian Kapil Sharma hosts this laugh-out-loud variety talk show with celebrity guests, hilarious antics and his signature supporting cast.

items.title: Mocktail
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Prerna asks her best friend Sonal to seduce her husband and check his loyalty. But when Sonal gets dangerously close to him, the question is if Prerna has created a situation she can no longer control.

items.title: I Would Rather Die
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The protagonist Archie, considered the school loser, is bitten by a zombie and finds himself at the center of a mission to save the city alongside his friends Cris and Brenda.

items.title: Love
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The pragmatic creator of a dating app and her adventurous competitor test their theories about love in a 60-day challenge to find their ideal partner.

items.title: Medusa
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Somebody wants to kill CEO Bárbara Hidalgo. Can she find the culprit as her family schemes ruthlessly for control of their Colombian business empire?

items.title: Medusa
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Somebody wants to kill CEO Bárbara Hidalgo. Can she find the culprit as her family schemes ruthlessly for control of their Colombian business empire?

items.title: Dupahiya
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Dhadakpur, the Belgium of Bihar, is on the cusp of celebrating 25 years of being crime free. But chaos strikes when a never-seen-before motorbike, that was purchased as a wedding gift gets stolen 7 days before the ceremony! The journey taken by the bride's family and ex-lover to find the Dupahiya forms the heart of this comedy, which explores the hopes and aspirations of simple people.

items.title: The Final Problem
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Un actor en horas bajas debe recurrir a las dotes detectivescas de sus personajes más famosos para resolver una misteriosa muerte en un hotel aislado donde todos son sospechosos.

items.title: The Protector
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Vezir ve Ölümsüzler modern İstanbul'a hükmeder. Hakan bir savaşı durdurmak için geçmişe yolculuk eder. Zeynep ise güçlü bir dönüşüm geçirir.

items.title: The Court
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A brilliant young lawyer with a stammer stands against her celebrated father in her fight for justice.

items.title: Hunkkaar - The Roar
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A victim takes a courageous stand against a powerful godman accused of misconduct in an intense courtroom drama centered on her fight for justice.

items.title: Shaque - Trust No One
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A mother receives yearly photos of her missing child. After nine years of searching, she discovers the truth about the abduction lies not far away, but hidden among her closest circle.

items.title: Bakaiti
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Set in old Ghaziabad, this heartwarming series follows the Kataria family grappling with a financial crunch. When Naina is forced to share her room with her younger brother Bharat, sibling tensions rise.

items.title: Monster - The Lizzie Borden Story
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When the repressed daughter of a wealthy New England family and her rebellious maid find themselves trapped in a house built on humiliation and cruelty, they escape into a fantasy of sex, power, and revenge. The gruesome unsolved murders that follow don't just shock the world — they give birth to an icon who refuses to live imprisoned in a cage, choosing instead to forge her own legend: shocking, monstrous, and gloriously free.

items.title: Neagley
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Frances Neagley is a private investigator in Chicago. When she learns that a beloved friend from her past has been killed in a suspicious accident, she becomes hell bent on justice. Using everything she's learned from Jack Reacher and her time as a member of the 110 Special Investigators, Neagley puts herself on a dangerous path to uncover a menacing evil.

items.title: Waiting Hai
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Sugam joins the RPF and investigates a Tatkal scam. Hamza and Mama turn booking software into a business, facing rivalry and betrayal. Sugam arrests the agents and tracks Hamza, ending the scam before his escape to Dubai.

items.title: Reacher
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Based on "Gone Tomorrow," when a chance encounter with a distraught stranger on a subway goes horribly wrong, Jack Reacher is drawn into a complex and deadly game that pits him against ruthless foes from the highest echelons of power.

items.title: Heartbeats - Pyaar aur Armaan
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Heartbeats is a hospital drama that follows Akshat as he pursues his dream of becoming a neurosurgeon while navigating a budding romance with Sanjh, a "nepo kid" from a family of doctors.

items.title: The Revolutionaries
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The Revolutionaries narrates the inspiring tale of brave young Indian freedom fighters who fought for ending British Raj with their unwavering spirit and ideology.

items.title: Chumbak
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Five quirky families navigate life as neighbors in Chumbak Colony, where chaotic conflicts and hilarious antics turn each day into a new chapter.

items.title: Hasratein
items.subtitle: None
items.description: After celebrating three acclaimed seasons, Hasratein is back with six new bold stories of women navigating love, betrayal, longing, and quiet rebellion. Each daring to challenge the world around her and reclaim what was always hers to begin with.

items.title: Crew Girl
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After a family scandal, teen rower Teagan Tao moves to a small town and joins an elite prep school's all-boys crew, sparking rivalry and attraction.

items.title: The Protector
