items.subtitle: English
items.description: İstanbul yeni bir tehdide yenik düşerken Hakan, şehri yok edecek anahtarı ele geçirmeye çalışan zorlu bir Ölümsüz ile karşı karşıya gelir.

items.title: The Protector
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Yeniden dirilen Ölümsüzler karşısında zorlu koşullara göğüs geren Hakan ve Sadıklar, şehri ve tüm insanları yok edecek şeytani bir planın önüne geçmelidir.

items.title: The Protector
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Günümüz İstanbulu'nda yaşayan ve kadim bir gizli birlikle olan bağını keşfeden genç bir adam, şehri ölümsüz bir düşmandan kurtarmak için maceraya atılır.

items.title: MobLand
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Power is up for grabs as the Harrigans and Stevensons, two warring London crime families, clash in a kill-or-be-killed battle that threatens to topple empires and ruin lives. Caught in the crossfire is Harry Da Souza, the street-smart 'fixer' as dangerous as he is handsome, who knows too well where loyalties lie when opposing forces collide. As kingdom goes up against kingdom, lines will be crossed - and the only saving grace is a bet-your-life guarantee: family above everything.

items.title: The Gentlemen
items.subtitle: English
items.description: It's been one year since Eddie and Susie joined forces to work together in Bobby's criminal empire overseas. As they drive to expand their enterprise, the decisions Bobby is making seem to be increasingly unsound. Now Eddie and Susie must decide whether to take action or risk losing it all, but unfettered ambition never ends well...

items.title: The Gentlemen
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When aristocratic Eddie inherits the family estate, he discovers that it's home to an enormous weed empire — and its proprietors aren't going anywhere.

items.title: Lovesick (Ep.01-07)
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Set during the Mexican Revolution, follow Emilia Sauri, a woman torn between two passionate loves while navigating a world dominated by violence and revolution.

items.title: All the Truth In My Lies
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Coco and Marín, best friends, embark on a caravan trip to celebrate Blanca's bachelorette party, but their adventure becomes a time bomb as secrets unravel.

items.title: Joggers Park
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After her husband leaves her, lonely Niharika finds an unexpected companion in much younger Kabir. Their friendship soon turns into a dangerous attraction. Will Niharika fight for her marriage, or surrender to the man who makes her feel alive again?

items.title: Missing Mahila
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A desperate man accepts a marriage broker’s 'No Questions Asked' deal — only to discover that his seemingly perfect bride is not what she appears to be.

items.title: Mousetrap
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

items.title: Leanne
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When her husband leaves her for another woman, a resilient Southern mom starts over with the support of her loving, but unfiltered family.

items.title: Ek Anjaan Rishtey Ka Guilt 5
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After years of betrayal, guilt and emotional distance, Sameer and Vandana travel to Europe hoping to give their troubled marriage one final chance. Their journey takes them from the romantic streets of Paris to the passionate chaos of Barcelona, but the past refuses to stay buried. When Vandana unexpectedly reconnects with a man from her past and Sameer is confronted by his own unresolved relationships, their holiday becomes a dangerous emotional journey of desire, jealousy and revenge. As hidden truths surface, the couple must decide whether their marriage can survive the guilt of what happened between them—or whether some relationships are impossible to repair.

items.title: Bicchoo Ka Khel
items.subtitle: English
items.description: What happens when a young student loses his father to a cover-up? Can he find it in himself to forget the past and move on, or is revenge the only thing that can give him some peace of mind?

items.title: Cobra Kai
items.subtitle: English
items.description: As Terry leads Cobra Kai into a new regime, Daniel, Johnny and an old ally join forces in a battle that goes way beyond the mat.

items.title: Cobra Kai
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Faced with a common enemy, Daniel and Johnny decide to start working together while Kreese looks to the past for a new ally of his own.

items.title: Cobra Kai
items.subtitle: English
items.description: With a new sensei at the helm of the Cobra Kai dojo, a three-way feud takes center stage. Old grudges — like Cobra Kai — never die.

items.title: Cobra Kai
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Johnny continues building a new life, but a face from his past could disrupt his future. Meanwhile, Daniel opens a Miyagi-Do studio to rival Cobra Kai.

items.title: Vadhandhi
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Murder of Velonie, a young Anglo-Indian girl in Kanyakumari, seen from the Rashomon-esque perspectives of an unrelenting obsessed cop, a novelist captivated by her grace and an opportunistic news editor.

items.title: Cobra Kai
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Decades after the tournament that changed their lives, the rivalry between Johnny and Daniel reignites.

items.title: Clean Up Company
items.subtitle: English
items.description: 3 boys stumble upon an opportunity to make easy money by getting rid of dead bodies in a small city marred by gang wars. Things quickly take a turn for the worse and they end up neck deep in trouble fighting to survive.

items.title: Lupin
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Inspired by the adventures of Arsène Lupin, gentleman thief Assane Diop sets out to avenge his father for an injustice inflicted by a wealthy family.

items.title: Khalifa
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Aamir Ali, a notorious gold smuggling kingpin who inherited his multi-million dollar criminal enterprise from a lineage of gangsters, is drawn into a web of vengeance, legacy and power.

items.title: Spider-Man - Brand New Day
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

items.title: Shaun of the Dead
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Shaun lives a supremely uneventful life, which revolves around his girlfriend, his mother, and, above all, his local pub. This gentle routine is threatened when the dead return to life and make strenuous attempts to snack on ordinary Londoners.

items.title: Spider-Man - No Way Home
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Peter Parker is unmasked and no longer able to separate his normal life from the high-stakes of being a super-hero. When he asks for help from Doctor Strange the stakes become even more dangerous, forcing him to discover what it truly means to be Spider-Man.

items.title: Spider-Man - Far from Home
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Peter Parker and his friends go on a summer trip to Europe. However, they will hardly be able to rest - Peter will have to agree to help Nick Fury uncover the mystery of creatures that cause natural disasters and destruction throughout the continent.

items.title: Spider-Man - Homecoming
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Following the events of Captain America: Civil War, Peter Parker, with the help of his mentor Tony Stark, tries to balance his life as an ordinary high school student in Queens, New York City, with fighting crime as his superhero alter ego Spider-Man as a new threat, the Vulture, emerges.

items.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: For Peter Parker, life is busy. Between taking out the bad guys as Spider-Man and spending time with the person he loves, Gwen Stacy, high school graduation cannot come quickly enough. Peter has not forgotten about the promise he made to Gwen’s father to protect her by staying away, but that is a promise he cannot keep. Things will change for Peter when a new villain, Electro, emerges, an old friend, Harry Osborn, returns, and Peter uncovers new clues about his past.

items.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Peter Parker is an outcast high schooler abandoned by his parents as a boy, leaving him to be raised by his Uncle Ben and Aunt May. Like most teenagers, Peter is trying to figure out who he is and how he got to be the person he is today. As Peter discovers a mysterious briefcase that belonged to his father, he begins a quest to understand his parents' disappearance – leading him directly to Oscorp and the lab of Dr. Curt Connors, his father's former partner. As Spider-Man is set on a collision course with Connors' alter ego, The Lizard, Peter will make life-altering choices to use his powers and shape his destiny to become a hero.

items.title: Spider-Man 3
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The seemingly invincible Spider-Man goes up against an all-new crop of villains—including the shape-shifting Sandman. While Spider-Man’s superpowers are altered by an alien organism, his alter ego, Peter Parker, deals with nemesis Eddie Brock and also gets caught up in a love triangle.

items.title: Spider-Man 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Peter Parker is going through a major identity crisis. Burned out from being Spider-Man, he decides to shelve his superhero alter ego, which leaves the city suffering in the wake of carnage left by the evil Doc Ock. In the meantime, Parker still can't act on his feelings for Mary Jane Watson, a girl he's loved since childhood. A certain anger begins to brew in his best friend Harry Osborn as well...

items.title: Spider-Man
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After being bitten by a genetically altered spider at Oscorp, nerdy but endearing high school student Peter Parker is endowed with amazing powers to become the superhero known as Spider-Man.

items.title: The Fantastic Four - First Steps
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Against the vibrant backdrop of a 1960s-inspired, retro-futuristic world, Marvel's First Family is forced to balance their roles as heroes with the strength of their family bond, while defending Earth from a ravenous space god called Galactus and his enigmatic Herald, Silver Surfer.

items.title: Captain America - Brave New World
items.subtitle: None
items.description: These include the mysterious Contessa Valentina Allegra de Fontaine (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) as she creates her own vigilante team with John Walker/ US Agent (Wyatt Russell), and former SHIELD and CIA agent turned Madripoor criminal leader Sharon Carton/ Power Broker (Emily VanCamp).

items.title: Venom - The Last Dance
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Eddie (Tom Hardy) and Venom must flee from both human and alien pursuers, leading to a desperate choice that threatens to sever their symbiotic bond forever. Third instalment in the Venom film franchise.

items.title: The Little Mermaid
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A young mermaid Ariel (Halle Bailey) gets in a Faustian bargain and trades her melodious voice in exchange of legs, with the hope of meeting her prince charming Eric (Jonah Hauer-King) on the land. A live-action remake of the animated Disney classic from 1989.

items.title: Black Panther - Wakanda Forever
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Queen Ramonda, Shuri, M’Baku, Okoye and the Dora Milaje fight to protect their nation from intervening world powers in the wake of King T’Challa’s death. As the Wakandans strive to embrace their next chapter, the heroes must band together with the help of War Dog Nakia and Everett Ross and forge a new path for the kingdom of Wakanda.

items.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Doctor Strange, with the help of mystical allies both old and new, traverses the mind-bending and dangerous alternate realities of the Multiverse to confront a mysterious new adversary.

items.title: Eternals
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The Eternals are a team of ancient aliens who have been living on Earth in secret for thousands of years. When an unexpected tragedy forces them out of the shadows, they are forced to reunite against mankind’s most ancient enemy, the Deviants.

items.title: Venom 2 (Venom Let There Be Carnage)
items.subtitle: English
items.description: As the lethal protector Venom, one of Marvel’s greatest and most complex characters, Eddie Brock (Tom Hardy) fights serial killer Cletus Kasady (Woody Harrelsons) whos got his own alien symibote, Carnage. The anti-hero film is a sequel to Venom that had released in 2018 and had grossed over $850 million worldwide.

items.title: Venom
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A struggling journalist, Eddie Brock (Tom Hardy), is trying to take down Carlton Drake (Riz Ahmed), the notorious, genius inventor and leader of the Life Foundation who is experimenting on symbiotes.

items.title: Hulk
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Bruce Banner, a genetics researcher with a tragic past, suffers massive radiation exposure in his laboratory that causes him to transform into a raging green monster when he gets angry.

items.title: Captain Marvel
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The story follows Carol Danvers as she becomes one of the universe’s most powerful heroes when Earth is caught in the middle of a galactic war between two alien races. Set in the 1990s, Captain Marvel is an all-new adventure from a previously unseen period in the history of the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

items.title: Black Panther
items.subtitle: English
items.description: King T'Challa returns home to the reclusive, technologically advanced African nation of Wakanda to serve as his country's new leader. However, T'Challa soon finds that he is challenged for the throne by factions within his own country as well as without. Using powers reserved to Wakandan kings, T'Challa assumes the Black Panther mantle to join with ex-girlfriend Nakia, the queen-mother, his princess-kid sister, members of the Dora Milaje (the Wakandan 'special forces') and an American secret agent, to prevent Wakanda from being dragged into a world war.

items.title: Doctor Strange
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After his career is destroyed, a brilliant but arrogant surgeon gets a new lease on life when a sorcerer takes him under her wing and trains him to defend the world against evil.

items.title: Captain America - Civil War
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Following the events of Age of Ultron, the collective governments of the world pass an act designed to regulate all superhuman activity. This polarizes opinion amongst the Avengers, causing two factions to side with Iron Man or Captain America, which causes an epic battle between former allies.

items.title: Murder Mubarak
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When a gym trainer is murdered at an elite Delhi club, a wily investigator unravels the sordid secrets of its ultrarich members to find the killer.

items.title: Fighter
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After joining the Indian Air Force, an ambitious youngster Shamsher Pathania (Hrithik Roshan) must rise above his limitations to become a hero of the Indian Armed Forces.

items.title: Joker
items.subtitle: English
items.description: “Joker” is an original, standalone story. Arthur Fleck (Joaquin Phoenix), a man disregarded by society, is not only a gritty character study, but also a broader cautionary tale.

items.title: DK Bose
items.subtitle: None
items.description: Shaped by a haunting childhood trauma, D.K. Bose leads a life of corruption and immorality, chasing wealth above all else. Will his worldview ever undergo a transformation?

items.title: Aashiqui 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Aditya Roy Kapur, Shraddha Kapoor, Shaad Randhawa, Mahesh Thakur, Shubhangi Latkar, Milind Phatak, Chitrak Bandhopadyay

items.title: Gladiator II
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The sequel follows Lucius (Paul Mescal), the son of Lucilla (Connie Nielsen), nearly 15 years after the first film.

items.title: Jango
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A neurosurgeon who is stuck in a time loop tries to save his estranged wife from being killed by a mystery man.

items.title: My Fault
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Noah (Nicole Wallace) leaves her town, boyfriend, and friends and moves with her mother to her new rich stepfather's mansion, where'' she meets and falls in love with her stepbrother Nick (Gabriel Guevara).

items.title: The School for Good and Evil
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Best friends Sophie and Agatha find their bond put to the test when theyre whisked away to a magical school for future fairy-tale heroes and villains.

items.title: Wicked
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Starring Cynthia Erivo and Ariana Grande, the untold story of the witches of Oz arrives on your screen as a generation-defining cinematic event.

items.title: Kabali
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After 25 years of wrongly imprisonment for a massacre in a Hindu temple, the mobster Kabali goes out in search of revenge.

items.title: Sarkar
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A ruthless businessman’s mission to expose electoral fraud brings him into a heated and dangerous political conflict with two corrupt ministers.

items.title: Dashmi
items.subtitle: None
items.description: Dashmi sheds light on the sensitive issue of multiple rapes plaguing our society.

items.title: Gogol. A Terrible Vengeance
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In 1829, Nikolay Gogol, a struggling writer, suffers from epileptic seizures that hold clues to real crimes. Investigator Yakov Guro teams up with Gogol to solve a baffling case in a village where'' everyone has a secret

items.title: Qalb
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Leo obsessed with a passion to migrate to Europe accidentally meets Thumbi ,whose presence changes Leo's world completely. An epic love story told through the seven stages of Love. Hub, Uns, Ishq, Aqeedath, Ibaadath, Junoon,Mauth.

items.title: Sookshmadarshini
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Manuel (Basil Joseph) returns with his mother to their former home in a middle-class neighbourhood. Suspicious of his intentions, Priyadarshini (Nazriya Nazim) and her friends begin gathering clues, convinced he may be hiding something sinister.

items.title: Nishabdham
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A murder-mystery thriller. A world-famous cello player is murdered and crucified in a Seattle Villa that has a reputation for being haunted. His friends and family try to figure out if he was really killed by a supernatural being or if he was assassinated by someone he knows. His dumb and deaf wife and a police detective are pinned against each other as they discover the victim's dark past.

items.title: Bodyguard
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When it comes to being punctual and doing his duties perfectly, Lovely Singh is unmatchable. He is extremely respectful of Mr Rana and his daughter Divya. While appointed as Divya's bodyguard, he falls in love with a girl he has never met, unaware that she is none other than Divya. Bodyguard is the story of conflict- between innocence and mischief, love and power and life and death!

items.title: Gandeevadhari Arjuna
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Gandeevadhari Arjuna is a Telugu spy action thriller movie, starring Varun Tej and Sakshi Vaidya in the lead roles.

items.title: Rowdy Boys
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Rowdy Boys Movie is directed by the Sree Harsha Konuganti and produced by Raju & Shirish under the banner Sri Venkateswara Creations, the movie cast includes Ashish, Anupama Parameswaran, Vikram Sahidev, Srikanth Iyyenger, Karthik Rathnam. Devi Sri Prasad composed the music for Rowdy Boys.

items.title: Kick 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Dr. Robin, an NRI, arrives in India to set up a hospital on a property that Durga has usurped. This feat leads him to a distant village, where' he has to find the true meaning of life.

items.title: Garudan
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When Nishanth (Biju Menon), a college lecturer, and DCP Harish Madhav (Suresh Gopi), a straightforward police officer, become involved in a crime, one of them must battle for justice and the other for his integrity. Both men must outwit one another in a network of deceit and mental tricks.

items.title: Hisaab Barabar
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Radhe Mohan Sharma, played by R. Madhavan, a railway ticket inspector who notices a small but puzzling inconsistency in his bank account. What starts as a minor issue quickly leads him to uncover a massive financial scam led by Micky Mehta, a powerful banker played by Neil Nitin Mukesh.

items.title: Lakshya
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Karan Sheirgill (Hrithik Roshan) is an aimless and lazy boy from Delhi who later joins the Indian Army, and with utmost dedication, transforms himself into a soldier to make his love interest, Romila Dutta (Preity Zinta), proud of him.

items.title: Baby
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In the movie Baby Caught between the comfort of her long-time boyfriend and the allure of a new flame at college, a middle-class girl battles her emotions. She grapples with guilt and confusion as her feelings deepen for the other guy. Eventually, she succumbs to temptation, betraying her true love in a whirlwind of psychological turmoil and heartache.

items.title: Tabaah
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The film follows two lovers whose bond is tested by tragic events, turning their relationship into a heartbreaking tale of love and separation

items.title: Ramayana - The Legend of Prince Rama
items.subtitle: None
items.description: A timeless tale of heroism and honour, the film is a visual blend of Japanese and Indian animation traditions. Based on Valmikis Ramayana.

items.title: The Legend of Maula Jatt
items.subtitle: None
items.description: Maula Jatt (Fawad Khan), a fierce prizefighter, sets out to take revenge on the Natt family that is responsible for the atrocities inflicted on him and his family in the past.

items.title: Hate Story
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Kaavya Krishna uses her body as a sexual weapon to destroy the man who ruined her life.

items.title: Hate Story 4
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The girl who will stop at nothing to become a star model in the most coveted advertising agency in London, Tasha is ambitious, beautiful and without a doubt voluptuous. Rajveer, the man known to stop at nothing to get the woman he wants spots her talent and pitches her to get the project. Aryan, on the other hand, the man who is smitten by Tasha at first sight, will go beyond bonds and boundaries.

items.title: Chal Mohan Ranga (A AA 2)
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Chal Mohan Ranga is a 2018 Hindi romantic comedy film starring Nithiin, Megha Akash, Madhunandan and Rao Ramesh. The story revolves around Mohan Ranga and Megha who fall in love but their relationship soon comes to an end. Will the couple realise their mistake and be together once again.

items.title: Veeram
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Veeram is inspired by the ballads of North Malabar and Vadakkan Pattukal, narrating the tale of Chandu Chekaver, a 13th-century Kalarippayattu warrior. Driven by ambition, he vows to gain power at any cost. Drawing parallels to Shakespeare's Macbeth, the film explores Chandu's rise and fall as a brave yet infamous figure in the political and martial landscapes of North Malabar.

items.title: Moana 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Moana (Auli'i Cravalho) journeys into the far, long-lost waters of Oceania, after receiving an unexpected call from her wayfinding ancestors, for an adventure unlike anything she has ever faced. Second installment in the Moana franchise and a sequel to Moana (2016).

items.title: Tenant
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Revolving around six characters resembling six faces of a dice chosen by Life in the game of snakes and ladders, this intriguingly designed drive reflects the current urban lifestyle, telling how women should be in our current society.

items.title: Dungeons Dragons - Honour Among Thieves
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A charming thief (Chris Pine) and a band of unlikely adventurers undertake an epic heist to retrieve a lost relic, but things go dangerously awry when they run afoul of the wrong people. Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves brings the rich world and playful spirit of the legendary role-playing game to the big screen in a hilarious and action-packed adventure.

items.title: Razakar
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The film stars Bobby Simha, Anasuya Bharadwaj, Vedhika, and Raj Arjun in key roles. Anasuya's performance, in particular, received praise from viewers

items.title: Marco
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In Kerala, the rulers of the gold empire are the very powerful and dangerous Adat family, apart from gold, the Adat family is at the forefront of all other important businesses.

items.title: Dil Diyan Gallan
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Laddi, and an internet star, Natasha, fall in love despite Natasha having a fiancé. What will happen now?

items.title: Rocky Mental
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Rocky, a national level boxer, earns Maninder's wrath after he gets close to his girlfriend Ibadat. Maninder frames Rocky in a rape case and kills his best friend Preet.

items.title: Jetty
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Like in the case of most trades, middlemen exploit the fishermen. To add to the woes of the poor, natural calamities like cyclones also affect their lives negatively. They rely on a Jetty (dock) to keep their boats from sinking. However, in order to get a Jetty, they have to go through a lot of hardship.

items.title: Mastaney
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In 1739, Nadar Shah faced a formidable challenge as Sikh Rebellions emerged, eventually leading to five men discovering the essence of Sikhism.

items.title: Daaku Maharaaj
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Daaku Maharaaj is an action drama film directed by Bobby Kolli. The film stars Nandamuri Balakrishna as Sitaram, who plays the role of Daaku Maharaaj. The film follows his journey as he combats exploitation in his village and battles against the oppressive Thakur brothers to protect his community. The film also features Bobby Deol, Pragya Jaiswal, and Shraddha Srinath in pivotal roles.

items.title: Rakshana
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A serial killer targets and murders successful women without leaving any trace. ACP Kiran, a bold and determined police officer, goes beyond the set of rules to follow her gut feeling to bring the killer to justice

items.title: Thandel
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Based on a true incident that happened in Andhra Pradesh’s fishing community in Srikakulam region in 2018, in which Pakistan forces caught a fisherman in Srikakulam in international waters.

items.title: Kudumbasthan
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Kudumbasthan features K. Manikandan and Saanve Megghana in lead roles. The film explores the humorous challenges faced by a newlywed man in Coimbatore.

items.title: My Dear Bootham
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A boy with stammering frees a genie, who helps him deal with his issues, but can he, given his speech disorder, grant the latter's one wish?

items.title: Yaathisai
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Set in the 7th century, Kodhi, an young hot-blooded warrior from the Einar clan, believes that his birth is destined to free his fellows from the nomadic life that they lead and goes on an impossible mission, to revolt against and defeat the Pandiyan king Ranadheeran.

items.title: Agent
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Directed by Surender Reddy, this spy thriller flick stars Mammootty, Akhil Akkineni, and Sakshi Vaidya in prominent roles. Akkineni will play the role of a spy, with his character inspired by Matt Damon's Jason Bourne character from the American film series of the same name, while Mammootty will play the role of a military officer.

items.title: Azaad
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In 1920s India, a young stable boy named Govind discovers a kindred spirit in a spirited horse named Azaad. As their lives intertwine against the backdrop of rebellion and tyranny, Govinds quest to ride the majestic Azaad turns into a journey of courage, awakening him to his own power amidst the countrys fight for freedom.

items.title: Viduthalai Part 1
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Kumaresan, a police constable, gets recruited for an operation implanted to capture Perumal Vaathiyar, who leads a separatist group dedicated to fighting against the authorities for committing atrocities against innocent village women in the name of police interrogations.

items.title: Swag
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The eternal battle of the sexes is played out across several generations of a family who seek to obtain a fortune.

items.title: Dragon
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Dragon follows the story of a follows a student navigating life's challenges, blending romance and comedy. The movie is directed by Ashwath Marimuthu and stars Pradeep Ranganathan and Anupama Parameswaran in the lead roles.

items.title: Yevade Subramanyam (Yeh Hai Zindagi)
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Raj, a pessimistic individual, has his outlook on life transformed by Kirti, a cheerful and optimistic girl, who teaches him the importance of enjoying life and living in the moment. Through her, Raj learns that there is more to life than just career goals and success.

items.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Jordan Belfort (Leonardo DiCaprio), a struggling but charismatic investor in the late 1980s, is determined to level up when he is made redundant from his first job. He sets up a brokerage firm and soon begins to make money promoting cheap penny stocks.

items.title: Twilight of the Warriors - Walled In
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Years after a bloody turf war in Hong Kong's underworld, Kowloon Walled City is a lawless haven for gangs and refugees. When a skilled fighter angers the most feared Triad boss, a bounty is placed on his head, despite his connections to the enclave's leader. The pursuit violates a fragile truce, reigniting old grudges and decades of tension, leading to a bloody boiling point.

items.title: Viduthalai Part 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The second part of the period crime thriller Viduthalai Part 1 (2023) in which a police officer was recruited to capture the leader of a separatist group.

items.title: X-Men - The Last Stand
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The discovery of a cure by the human government puts the lives of existing mutants in trouble: Wolverine (Hugh Jackman), Storm (Halle Berry), Jean Gray (Famke Janssen), Rogue (Anna Paquin), Mystique (Rebecca Romijn), and Beast (Kelsey Grammer).

items.title: Taron Paar
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Two lovers, separated in childhood by borders, now search for each other across India and Pakistan. Will fate reunite them? Watch Taron Paar to find out!

items.title: X-Men Origins - Wolverine
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Traces back to origins of Wolverine a.k.a Logan (Hugh Jackman), when he explores his mutant self, battles his brother Victor Creed/Sabretooth (Liev Schreiber), serves the special forces team of Weapon X programme that unleashes his primal fury, as well as his complicated love life.

items.title: Logan
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An elderly, weary, and dormant Wolverine/Logan (Hugh Jackman) forces himself out of hibernation when a child mutant, Laura (Dafne Keen), who has been created by scientists, seeks his help.

items.title: Adrishyam (Yugi)
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A detective, along with his team and with help of a suspended Police Sub-Inspector, goes in search of a missing girl, Karthika. What follows is shocking revelations about Karthika, who became the victim of power and economic exploitation.

items.title: First Man
items.subtitle: English
items.description: It is the early 1960s and NASA is hell-bent on landing the moon. The mission is joined by a team of dedicated astronauts including the test pilot Neil Armstrong (Ryan Gosling) — who later became the first man to walk on the moon.

items.title: 2 States
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Krish Malhotra (Arjun Kapoor) and Ananya Swaminathan (Alia Bhatt) hail from two different states of India. They meet at IIM Ahmedabad and fall in love. But they decide they won't get married until their parents agree. Everything goes downhill when the parents meet. There parents oppose the wedding due to different cultures.

items.title: Ascharya Fuck It (Ascharyachakit)
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Desire and greed intertwines the lives of a Bollywood star, his chauffeur, a prostitute and her pimp in an unlikely love story.

items.title: Uri - The Surgical Strike
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Following the roguish terrorist attacks at Uri Army Base camp in Kashmir, India takes the fight to the enemy, in its most successful covert operation till date with one and only one objective of avenging their fallen heroes.

items.title: Silence...Can You Hear It
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Manoj Bajpayee, Prachi Desai, Arjun Mathur, Barkha Singh, Hitha Chandrashekar, Sahil Vaid, Ujjawal Gauraha, Shishir Sharma, Denzil Smith, Vaquar Shaikh, Sohaila Kapoor, Amit Thakkar, Bhushan Shimpi, Garima Yagnik

items.title: Kannum Kannum Kollaiyadithaal
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Two wily online scammers mend their fraudulent ways after meeting the girls of their dreams — until a deceitful discovery throws their world for a loop.

items.title: Army of the Dead
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Following a zombie outbreak in Las Vegas, a group of mercenaries take the ultimate gamble: venturing into the quarantine zone to pull off the greatest heist ever attempted.

items.title: Tej I Love You
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Tej, a youngster who's highly attached to his family, is banished from his home by his uncle. He then finds himself in London, where''' he falls in love with Nandini. After long pursuit, he manages to win over her heart, but before she could even tell him, a tragic incident puts a full stop to their love story.

items.title: Thor - Love and Thunder
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After his retirement is interrupted by Gorr the God Butcher, a galactic killer who seeks the extinction of the gods, Thor Odinson enlists the help of King Valkyrie, Korg, and ex-girlfriend Jane Foster, who now wields Mjolnir as the Mighty Thor. Together they embark upon a harrowing cosmic adventure to uncover the mystery of the God Butcher’s vengeance and stop him before it’s too late.

items.title: Atithi Devo Bhava
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Love has eluded Abhay, who lives with an irrational fear of being alone. But when he falls for Vaishnavi, he must learn to trust and win her heart.

items.title: Brahmastra Part One - Shiva
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The story of Shiva – a young man on the brink of an epic love, with a girl named Isha. But their world is turned upside down when Shiva learns that he has a mysterious connection to the Brahmāstra... and a great power within him that he doesn’t understand just yet - the power of Fire.

items.title: Sita Ramam
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Lieutenant Ram's (Dulquer Salman) day-to-day routine involves patrolling through the breathtaking valleys of Kashmir, with no family to talk or write to. One day, he receives a letter from a woman called Sita (Mrunal Thakur), who claims to be his wife. Thus begins an unusual love story in the valley of 1965, agains the backdrop of war.

items.title: Virupaksha
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Set in a village named Rudravanam in 1990's, Surya along with his mother, visit there after a long time. Suddenly a series of mysterious deaths occur due to an unknown person's occult practice and whole village is scared. Will Surya find the person causing the deaths and save the village?

items.title: Yaadhum Oore Yaavarum Kelir
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A refugee struggles hard to find an identity for himself in order to accomplish his dreams.

items.title: Yaariyan 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Three friends (Yash Dasgupta, Pearl V Puri, Divya Khosla Kumar) move to Bengaluru, with fun, adventure, and challenges to follow.

items.title: Iraivan
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Arjun, a tough cop along with his friend Andrew embark on a mission to track down a truly gruesome psychopathic killer called Bhramma a.k.a The Smiley Man. They eventually manage to apprehend Bhramma at the cost of losing Andrew makes Arjun resign from the police force. However, tragedy hits home when Bhramma escapes from prison and resumes his killing spree.

items.title: Sukhee
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Sukhpreet (Shilpa Shetty) is a 38-year-old Punjabi housewife who gets to relive her life as a 17-year-old after attending her school reuni0n . Her experiences over the seven days reinvigorate her as a woman, after being restricted to the roles of a mother and a wife over the past many years.

items.title: Custody
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A man seeks justice after getting trapped in a court case.

items.title: Oppenheimer
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer (Cillian Murphy), the theoretical physicist and the father of the atomic bomb, who took part in the World War II Manhattan Project that led to the development of the world's first nuclear weapons — and who later found himself confronting the moral consequences of scientific progress.Based on the Pulitzer Prize-winning biography American Prometheus: The Triumph and Tragedy of J. Robert Oppenheimer.

items.title: The Vaccine War
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Based on India's battle against Covid-19, and the efforts the medical department took to overcome the global crisis.

items.title: Leo
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Parthiban, a cafe owner, lives with his family in Himachal Pradesh. Things take an absurd turn for him when he gets in the way of a drug cartel.

items.title: Chithha
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Chitta (Siddharth), whose entire world revolves around his 5-year-old niece, finds his life turned upside down when she goes missing and he sets out to find her.

items.title: Japan
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A fictionalized version of the events surrounding notorious criminal Tiruvarur Murugan, who was involved in a big jewellery shop robbery.

items.title: Falimy
items.subtitle: English
items.description: To fulfill the elderly patriarch's wish, a dissonant family embarks on a trip to Varanasi. Will this journey mend their bonds or deepen the fault lines?

items.title: Toby
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The titular character is based on a 8 page short story by T.K. Dayanand, Raj B Shetty retained the attributes of the character from the story and wrote a new screenplay for the film. The film is based in Kumta region of Uttara Kannada district in Coastal Karnataka.

items.title: Naa Rakumarudu
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Vaishnav meets Bindu, and they become close friends soon. When Bindu expresses her love, Vaishnav rejects and leaves to the US. Why did Vaishnav reject Bindu’s proposal? Will he come back and accept her in his life?

items.title: Kho Gaye Hum Kahan
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Three best friends juggle life as 20-somethings in Mumbai, where' romance, ambition and heartbreak collide with the addictive draw of social media.

items.title: Krishna Talkies
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Ajay, a journalist, sets out to hunt the mysterious or supernatural assailant who targets the moviegoers in Krishna Talkies with the F13 number seat ticket.

items.title: Parking
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An elderly man and a youngster who are tenants sharing two different floors of an individual house fight over a parking space

items.title: Meter
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After a reluctant cop is promoted, he attempts to sabotage his own rise — until an unexpected clash with a corrupt politician forces a change of heart.

items.title: Sasanasabha
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In Sasanasabha Ram Mohan Rao and Shyamala Bharath both are political rivals. Ram Mohan Rao is the chief minister of the Andhra Pradesh state. And shyamala Bharath is the opposition party leader. She is a brave and powerful leader. She can command the police

items.title: Kaathal – The Core
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Kaathal The Core unveils the captivating narrative of Mathew Devassy and Omana a seemingly harmonious couple residing in the serine village of Teekoy in Kottayam District Kaathal The Core is a poignant exploration of the intricate dynamics of a marriage the pursuit of justice and the quest of personal fulfilment set against the backdrop of a closeknit community.

items.title: Tamilarasan
items.subtitle: English
items.description: With no help from the hospital for his son's heart transplant, police officer Tamilarasan (Vijay Antony) kidnaps the hospital's heart surgeon in a desperate bid to save his son's life.

items.title: Ek Tha Tiger
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Tiger (Salman Khan), India’s top spy, falls in love with Pakistani agent Zoya (Katrina Kaif) while on a mission abroad. The intelligence agencies back home forbid such a relationship with anyone from the enemy country, so the duo decide to elope, agreeing to come in only if their countries shut down the agencies altogether.

items.title: Tiger 3
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Tiger (Salman Khan) and Zoya (Katrina Kaif) return to the big screen with action-packed sequences, in this third installment of their spy films that previously gave us Ek Tha Tiger and Tiger Zinda Hai.

items.title: Singham Returns
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After one of his colleagues is found dead, Bajirao Singham sets off to unravel the dark world of crime, injustice, corrupt godmen, and fraud in Mumbai. The film serves as a sequel to Singham (2011) and marks the second instalment in Rohit Shetty’s Cop Universe.

items.title: Bina Band Chal England
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A boy lies about his family occupation to his father in law to save his marriage. But it leads to further confusion and comical situations between the two families.

items.title: Sooryavanshi
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A fearless, faithful (and only slightly forgetful) Mumbai cop pulls out all the stops — and stunts — to thwart a major conspiracy to attack his city.

items.title: Alienoid
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In 2022, Guard and Thunder live on Earth, managing alien prisoners locked up in humans. One day, a spacecraft appears in Seoul, and Detective Moon catches a strange sight. Meanwhile, 630 years earlier in Goryeo, Muruk and Ean scramble to win the huge reward for the Divine Blade. The two sorcerers, Madam Black and Mr. Blue, as well as the masked Jajang, also set out on a race to find the Blade.

items.title: Jail
items.subtitle: English
items.description: GV Prakash Kumar is a youngster who engages in minor crimes and illicit acts. Abarnathi, a girl in his neighbourhood falls in love with him and aspires to reform him. When a crooked cop (Ravi Mariah) plays a pawn game with GV Prakash, his life becomes problematic. What happens to him is the rest of the movie.

items.title: The Marvels
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Carol Danvers aka Captain Marvel (Brie Larson) has reclaimed her identity from the tyrannical Kree and taken revenge on the Supreme Intelligence. But unintended consequences see Carol shouldering the burden of a destabilised universe.

items.title: Banaras
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Sidharth Simha (Zaid Khan) and Dhani (Sonal Monteiro) find their love by understanding Banaras, a city full of beauty, prosperity, and culture.

items.title: The Kitchen
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Izi's close to escaping The Kitchen, one of London’s last remaining housing estates. But when young Benji enters his life, he faces some hard decisions.

items.title: Sam Bahadur
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Sam Bahadur is a biopic film based on the life of late Field Marshal Sam Manekshaw, one of the most decorated army officers in India, with Vicky Kaushal in the titular role. Popular by the title of Sam Bahadur, Manekshaw had served the Indian army for over four decades and fought valiantly in a total of five wars- World War II (1942), Indo-Pak Partition War (1947), Sino-Indian War (1962), Indo-Pak War (1965), and the War of Bangladesh Liberation (1971). Known to have cheated death innumerable times during his tenure, he was awarded some of the most prestigious awards including Padma Bhushan, Padma Vibhushan, and a Military Cross for gallantry (World War II). He was also the first army officer to be promoted to the rank of a Field Marshal in the Indian Army.

items.title: Raththam
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Ranjith, an acclaimed editor of a leading publication leaves the job when he loses his wife and lives a secluded life in Kolkata with his daughter. After a few years, when his close friend is killed by a fanatic fan, Ranjith is forced to get back to the job.

items.title: Echo
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Prakash's troubled marriage is plagued by a paranormal presence. Seeking help from a black magician, he uncovers a dark family secret. Things get interesting when the spirit's true identity and the resolution of the mystery unravels.

items.title: Calling Sahasra
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Cyber expert Ajay joins new job but past tragedy motivates avenging crimes on women using RESQ app anonymously. Mass calls draw him into murder case amidst rescuing women.

items.title: Super 30
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Anand Kumar (Hrithik Roshan) is a mathematician genius from a modest family in Bihar. Despite hurdles in life, Anand's immense dedication leads to getting him selected for Cambridge. But owing to a personal tragedy, he lets go of his dream — and leads a group of 30 underprivileged students, educating them for free to crack one of the toughest entrance exams in India: the IIT's JEE. Super 30 Movie Cast, Release Date, Trailer, Songs and Ratings

items.title: Hacked
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Vivek, a hacker, gets obsessed with Sameera. But after she rejects his advances, Vivek hacks all her social media accounts to ruin her personal and professional life.

items.title: Lantrani
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The anthology film showcases three independent stories that capture the experience of small Indian towns and villages where' people take incredible measures to survive.

items.title: Dunki
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Follows an Indian who uses an unlawful method of

items.title: Narayana Co
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A middle-class family in financial distress agrees to an illegal deal and embarks on a hilarious journey to overcome their problems, discovering the true meaning of family in the process.

items.title: Anweshippin Kandethum
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Wrongfully suspended while pursuing the culprit in a missing persons case, a cop seeks redemption — and justice — when he gets a new assignment.

items.title: A1 Express
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Set in Yanam the story begins with a history about the Chittibabu hockey stadium which has seen its glory days back in the 40s. How a happy-go-lucky youngster Sanju, his lady love Lavanya & the local team’s coach fight hard to save the stadium from being usurped by a corrupt politician unravels as an inspiring tale.

items.title: K.G.F Chapter 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Vijendra Ingalgi, Son of Anand Ingalgi continues the story of KGF and Rocky in Chapter 2. Rocky survives the attack by Vanaram’s guards after killing Garuda. He is a hero and a saviour to the people of Narachi. While trying to fulfil his promise to his mother, he must face many obstacles in the form of Adheera, Inayat Khalil and Ramika sen.

items.title: Main Atal Hoon
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Follows the life of Atal Bihari Vajpayee (Pankaj Tripathi), who served as the Prime Minister of India thrice during his tenure. The Bharat Ratna and Padma Vibhushan recipient was also one of the key senior leaders and co-founders of Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).

items.title: Predator Badlands
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Cast out from his clan, a young Predator finds an unlikely ally in a damaged android and embarks on a treacherous journey in search of the ultimate adversary.

items.title: Border
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Border Is A Bollywood Epic War Hindi Action Movie, Directed By J. P. Dutta, Starring Sunny Deol, Sunil Shetty, Akshaye Khanna, Jackie Shroff, Sudesh Berry, Puneet Issar And Kulbhushan Kharbanda In The Lead Roles. A Band Of 120 Indian Soldiers In Longewala Region Defend Their Post All Night Until They Receive Assistance From The Indian Air Force The Next Morning.

items.title: Maa Vintha Gaadha Vinuma
items.subtitle: English
items.description: All hell breaks loose when a marriage video of Siddhu (Siddu Jonnalagadda) and Vineetha (Seerat Kapoor) goes viral on social media. With chaos and embarrassment in both the families, the couple must sort out all the unpleasant reverberations.

items.title: 10 Endrathukulla (10 Ka Dum)
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A driving instructor is ordered by a gangster to take Shakeela, a young woman, to a landlord, Daksha Bhai. But he later learns of a secret that could endanger her life unless he acts fast.

items.title: Interstellar
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A team of explorers travel beyond this galaxy through a newly discovered wormhole to discover whether mankind has a future among the stars.

items.title: Krishna Ki Love Story (Krishna Gaadi Veera Prema Gaadh)
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Krishna (Nani) is a coward who is in love with Mahalakshmi (Mehreen Pirzada) and they have kept it a secret. Mahalakshmi is sister of Ramaraju, who in turn is a henchmen of Rajayya. At the same time, Rajayya has a brother, encounter specialist ACP Srikanth (Sampath) who always kills criminals without arresting them.

items.title: Saripodhaa Sanivaaram (Suryas Saturday)
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Surya (Nani) keeps a journal where'''' he records the names of those who wronged him throughout the week. Every Saturday, he reviews the list, selects the names, and acts on his anger if he feels it's justified. However, things take a dangerous turn when a corrupt police officer (SJ Suryah) crosses him, and Suryas quest for justice becomes a risky endeavor.

items.title: Ufff Yeh Siyapaa
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Kesari Lal Singh’s wife leaves him, believing he was flirting with the neighbor—he wasn’t. To make matters worse, a drug parcel is mistakenly delivered to his home, leading to chaos when a dead body turns up. As he tries to dispose of it, another body arrives, plunging him deeper into mayhem.

items.title: Baaghi
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Ronny is a rebellious man, who falls in love with Sia but circumstances separate them. Years later, Ronny learns that Sia is abducted by a martial arts champion, Raghav.

items.title: Mission Impossible - The Final Reckoning
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Ethan Hunt and team continue their search for the terrifying AI known as the Entity — which has infiltrated intelligence networks all over the globe — with the world's governments and a mysterious ghost from Hunt's past on their trail. Joined by new allies and armed with the means to shut the Entity down for good, Hunt is in a race against time to prevent the world as we know it from changing forever.

items.title: Maareesan
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A petty thief embarks on a road trip with an elderly man suffering from memory loss under deceptive pretenses. As they journey across Tamil Nadu, the promise of an easy con unravels into a quietly shifting connection, with both men hiding secrets of their own.

items.title: Tron - Ares
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A highly sophisticated Program called Ares is sent from the digital world into the real world on a dangerous mission, marking humankind's first encounter with A.I. beings.

items.title: Pratinidhi 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Sequel of 2014's Political Drama

items.title: Chhorii 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Sakshi must rescue her seven-year-old daughter, Ishani, abducted by a dangerous underground tribe. In three days, Ishani will be sacrificed to appease their demonic deity. To save her, Sakshi must face Daasi, the evil high priestess, and destroy the malevolent, soul-devouring demon. If she fails, Ishani will be lost forever to this ancient evil.

items.title: Mantis
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Mantis, an ace assassin, returns to the contract killer industry after a hiatus, encountering his trainee friend Jae-yi and a retired legendary killer Dok-go, who now runs the organization.

items.title: Venky Mama
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Venkataratnam, son of famous astrologer Ram Narayan, lands in a military cantonment region one week after a major terrorist attack. When interrogated by the military police, he tells them he came in search of his nephew, Karthik, and tells them his story.

items.title: Devaki Nandana Vasudeva
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Driven by fears of astrological prophecy, Kamsaraja torments his sister's family, convinced her child will cause his downfall. When imprisoned, Krishna shields the family from Kamsaraja's sinister

items.title: Ash
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A woman wakes up on a distant planet and finds the crew of her space station viciously killed. Her investigation into what happened sets in motion a terrifying chain of events.

items.title: Thurthu Nirgamana (Emergency Exit)
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Vikram, An unemployed 32-year-old wastrel experiences life of 3 days leading to his death in an endless time loop, until he finds within himself what he was seeking and the true purpose of his life.

items.title: Demonte Colony 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Sequel to 2015 horror thriller Demonte Colony, featuring Arulnithi, Priya Bhavanishankar, Sarjano Khalid and Meenakshi Govindarajan in lead roles.

items.title: Mithada Maheman
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Distraught Aditya finds himself on a road trip with three strangers who offer different perspectives on his life.

items.title: Dolittle
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After losing his wife seven years earlier, the eccentric Dr. John Dolittle, famed doctor and veterinarian of Queen Victoria’s England, hermits himself away behind the high walls of Dolittle Manor with only his menagerie of exotic animals for company. But when the young queen falls gravely ill, a reluctant Dolittle is forced to set sail on an epic adventure to a mythical island in search of a cure, regaining his wit and courage as he crosses old adversaries and discovers wondrous creatures.

items.title: Kannappa
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After witnessing the cruel sacrifice of his childhood friend, an atheist warrior rejects religion until love forces him to find his own faith.

items.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing Missouri
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After seven months have passed without a culprit in her daughter's murder case, Mildred Hayes makes a bold move, painting three signs leading into her town with a controversial message directed at Bill Willoughby, the town's revered chief of police. When his second-in-command Officer Jason Dixon, an immature mother's boy with a penchant for violence, gets involved, the battle between Mildred and Ebbing's law enforcement is only exacerbated.

items.title: Jungle Cruise
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Dr. Lily Houghton enlists the aid of wisecracking skipper Frank Wolff to take her down the Amazon in his dilapidated boat. Together, they search for an ancient tree that holds the power to heal – a discovery that will change the future of medicine.

items.title: Laalo - Krishna Sada Sahaayate
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A rickshaw driver trapped in a farmhouse confronts his past demons while experiencing visions of Lord Krishna, who guides him through a transformative journey of self-discovery and healing.

items.title: The Bad Guys Reign of Chaos
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A respectable village head decides to keep his son away from the violent politics of rural life. However, fate intervenes, forcing the young man to not only return home, but also take up the sickle.

items.title: Boonie Bears The Hidden Protector
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After gaining magical powers from Nian, the legendary Year Monster, our heroes are transported to a magical realm to stop a world-ending crisis. Briar deals with losing his 'big brother' status after the others gain powers, leading him to stumble into a plot that threatens both the human and immortal worlds.

items.title: Minions And Monsters
items.subtitle: English
items.description: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

items.title: Penguins of Madagascar
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Skipper, Kowalski, Rico and Private join forces with undercover organization The North Wind to stop the villainous Dr. Octavius Brine from destroying the world as we know it.

items.title: Madagascar 3 - Europes Most Wanted
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Animal pals Alex, Marty, Melman, and Gloria are still trying to make it back to New York's Central Park Zoo. They are forced to take a detour to Europe to find the penguins and chimps who broke the bank at a Monte Carlo casino. When French animal-control officer Capitaine Chantel DuBois picks up their scent, Alex and company are forced to hide out in a traveling circus.

items.title: Madagascar 2 - Escape 2 Africa
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Alex, Marty, and other zoo animals find a way to escape from Madagascar when the penguins reassemble a wrecked airplane. The precariously repaired craft stays airborne just long enough to make it to the African continent. There the New Yorkers encounter members of their own species for the first time. Africa proves to be a wild place, but Alex and company wonder if it is better than their Central Park home.

items.title: David
items.subtitle: English
items.description: From the songs of his mother’s heart to the whispers of a faithful God, David’s story begins in quiet devotion. When the giant Goliath rises to terrorize a nation, a young shepherd armed with only a sling, a few stones, and unshakable faith steps forward. Pursued by power and driven by purpose, his journey tests the limits of loyalty, love, and courage—culminating in a battle not just for a crown, but for the soul of a kingdom.

items.title: Hoppers
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Scientists have discovered how to 'hop' human consciousness into lifelike robotic animals, allowing people to communicate with animals as animals. Animal lover Mabel seizes an opportunity to use the technology, uncovering mysteries within the animal world beyond anything she could have imagined.

items.title: Love Death And Robots
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Anthology series Love, Death + Robots returns for a fourth volume of mechanical madness.

items.title: Love Death And Robots
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Mad robots, quirky scientists, and ordinary humans return with interesting tales set in the shape of colourful animated stories.

items.title: Love Death And Robots
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The future is here and senior members of the society are enjoying the service given by robots, until these machines decide to kill the humans. In another chapter, some humans have been granted with extraordinary powers, while some have not, leading to a class conflict.

items.title: Love Death And Robots
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Short stories from varied genres including science fiction, fantasy, horror, and comedy that are brimming with heartfelt emotions. There are robots, demons, scientists as well as a common-man dominating the screen space.

items.title: The Legend of Hanuman
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The Legend of Hanuman returns for a new season.

items.title: Dragon Nest - Warriors Dawn
items.subtitle: English
items.description: For years, the land of Altera has observed an uneasy peace between the humans, the elves, and the beasts who are loyal to the legendary Black Dragon. But when the dragon wakes from its hibernation, mobilizing a force of beasts to make war, a small band of humans and elves unite in a search for the secret road to the dragon

items.title: Zootopia
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In the all-animal city of Zootopia, Officer Judy Hopps, the first bunny on the police force, is determined to prove herself. That's why she jumps at the chance to crack a case, even if it means partnering with scam-artist fox Nick Wilde to solve the mystery.

items.title: Moana
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The Polynesian island of Motunui is created and powered by forces of nature. Its inhabitants worship the goddess of nature Te Fiti, who brought life to the ocean. But when Maui (Dwayne Johnson), the shape-shifting demigod of the wind and sea, steals the heart of the ocean to give humanity the power of creation, things go wrong. A thousand years later, Moana (Auli?i Cravalho), daughter of Motunui's chief, comes to her village’s rescue.

items.title: Sonic the Hedgehog 3
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Sonic, Knuckles, and Tails are back for their most epic adventure yet. The team reunite to face a new formidable foe, Shadow, a mysterious hedgehog with powers unlike anything they've seen. Keanu Reeves joins the All-Star cast as the voice of Shadow.

items.title: Secret Level
items.subtitle: English
items.description: SECRET LEVEL is a new adult animated anthology series featuring original stories set within the worlds of some of the world’s most beloved video games. From the creative minds behind LOVE, DEATH + ROBOTS, each of the 15 episodes is a celebration of games and gamers.

items.title: Transformers One
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Follows two friends Optimus Prime (Chris Hemsworth) and Megatron (Brian Tyree Henry) who become enemies.

items.title: The Wild Robot
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An intelligent robot called Roz (Lupita Nyong'o) is stranded on an uninhabited island with a harsh ---environment after a shipwreck. He must adapt to the ---environment and befriend the animals there to survive. Based on American writer and illustrator Peter Brown's book series of the same name.

items.title: Panda Bear in Africa
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A young adventurous Panda travels from China to Africa to rescue his best friend, Jielong the Dragon who has been kidnapped. On his journey he discovers a strange amazing new world of mountains, deserts and jungles.

items.title: Inside Out 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Follows Riley (Kaitlyn Dias), now a teenager, who experiences the various emotions of adolescence, including anxiety (Maya Hawke).

items.title: Wish Dragon
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Determined teen Din is longing to reconnect with his childhood best friend when he meets a wish-granting dragon who shows him the magic of possibilities.

items.title: The Legend of Hanuman
items.subtitle: English
items.description: As Kumbhkaran (Anup Shukla) is woken up, he is all set to unleash his monstrous power. Meanwhile, Indrajeet (Ganesh Divekar) and Ahiravan (Sahil Vaid) are plotting deadly schemes. Lord Hanuman (Daman Baggan) and his vanar sena are preparing fiercely for a battle like never before.

items.title: Baahubali - Crown of Blood
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A prequel to Baahubali movie franchise focusing on the threat that Mahishmati kingdom faces when Raktadeva make plans to attack his kingdom along with his new general of the army, who knows all the military secrets of Mahishmati

items.title: Bujji Bhairava (Ep.01-02)
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A glimpse into the friendship and adventures of Bhairava (Prabhas) and his vehicle Bujji (Keerthy Suresh) from the world of Kalki 2898 AD. An animated prelude to the science ficton film.

items.title: Breakthrough
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Tragedy strikes when a woman named Joyce's son falls through the ice on a frozen lake and is trapped underwater for over 15 minutes. After being rushed to the hospital, the 14-year-old boy continues to fight for his life as Joyce, her husband and their pastor stay by his bedside and pray for a miracle.

items.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
items.subtitle: English
items.description: On a mission to make Christmas unforgettable for Quill, the Guardians head to Earth in search of the perfect present.

items.title: Laila Majnu
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Laila is a free-spirited girl from a conservative family who firmly believes in living for the present. Qais, a spoilt brat, falls head over heels in love with her. Their families, however, are warring over property, which leads to self-destruction, pain and bleeding hearts.

items.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Shang-Chi must confront the past he thought he left behind when he is drawn into the web of the mysterious Ten Rings organization.

items.title: Den of Thieves 2 - Pantera
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Big Nick is back on the hunt in Europe and closing in on Donnie, who is embroiled in the treacherous and unpredictable world of diamond thieves and the infamous Panther mafia, as they plot a massive heist of the world's largest diamond exchange.

items.title: Abbayitho Ammayi
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Abhi is a youth who wants to have fun in life. He is addicted to various social networking sites & always looks for reasons to flirt with girls. During his search, he falls for Prardhana & starts getting close to her. Twist in the tale arises when Abhi gets caught in a compromising situation in Prardhana's house. Rest of the story is about how Abhi gets his act right and wins her love back.

items.title: Bagheera
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Dismayed by corruption and violence, a virtuous police officer becomes a masked vigilante to deliver lethal justice to criminals and crooked cops alike.

items.title: Alien Romulus
items.subtitle: English
items.description: This truly terrifying sci-fi horror-thriller takes the legendary Alien franchise back to its iconic roots. While scavenging the deep ends of a derelict space station, a group of young colonizers come face-to-face with the deadliest life form in the universe. Warning: Some flashing-lights scenes in this film may affect photosensitive viewers.

items.title: Kabadadaari
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An ambitious traffic cop sets out to solve a murder which took place four decades ago with the help of a journalist and a retired cop.

items.title: Dark Phoenix
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Jean Grey (Sophie Turner) is stung by a powerful beam of energy in a mishap and develops incredible powers. However, the mutant starts behaving erratically, gets corrupt, and starts coming across as a real threat.

items.title: Abbara
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Dreaded gangster Vairamudi faces a vengeful attack against his ghastly crime 25 years back. Can the assailant Shiva's plan of getting into three unique avatars to avenge his father's brutal murder bring the villain to justice?

items.title: My Secret Santa
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A single mom needs a job. A ski resort needs a Santa. Disguised as a St. Nick lookalike, can Taylor fool a charming hotel heir into ho-ho-hiring her?

items.title: Josh
items.subtitle: None
items.description: Max Dias (Shah Rukh Khan), who lives with his twin sister Shirley (Aishwarya Rai Bachchan) in Goa, is enraged when he finds out that she has fallen in love with Rahul (Chandrachur Singh), his bitter rival Prakash's (Sharad Kapoor) younger brother. Set against the backdrop of Goa, they form two rival street gangs — the Bichhoos, who are Hindu migrants led by Max, and the Eagles, who are local Christians led by Prakash. Will the lovebirds have a happy ending? Or will the rivalry between the two gangs turn into animosity? Loosely inspired by West Side Story.

items.title: Fateh
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Follows a former gangster Fateh (Sonu Sood) who is hired to guard a young woman named Jacqueline. In order to keep her safe, Fateh must employ all of his abilities while simultaneously attempting to learn the truth about the threats made against her.

items.title: Bring Her Back
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Following the death of their father, a brother and sister are introduced to their new sibling by their foster mother, only to learn that she has a terrifying secret.

items.title: 120 Bahadur
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Valiant Indian soldiers fight against Chinese troops during the 1962 Sino-Indian War, preventing a potential occupation of Ladakh region in the Battle of Rezang La.

items.title: Ghaati
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Follows the story of an empowered woman who gets entangled with weed trade due to circumstances.

items.title: Be Happy
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A dance-drama film that follows a single father and his witty, wise-beyond-her-years daughter. When his daughter's dream of performing in the country's biggest dance reality show collides with a life-alter-ing crisis, the father is driven to do the unthinkable, showcasing the extraordinary lengths he will go to fulfill her wishes and find happiness.

items.title: Didi
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In 2008, during the last month of summer before high school begins, an impressionable 13-year-old Taiwanese American boy learns what his family can't teach him: how to skate, how to flirt, and how to love your mom.

items.title: xXx Return Of Xander Cage
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Xander Cage is left for dead after an incident, though he secretly returns to action for a new, tough assignment with his handler Augustus Gibbons.

items.title: Rampage
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Primatologist Davis Okoye shares an unshakable bond with George, the extraordinarily intelligent, silverback gorilla who has been in his care since birth. But a rogue genetic experiment gone awry mutates this gentle ape into a raging creature of enormous size. To make matters worse, it’s soon discovered there are other similarly alter-ed animals. As these newly created alpha predators tear across North America, destroying everything in their path, Okoye teams with a discredited genetic engineer to secure an antidote, fighting his way through an ever-changing battlefield, not only to halt a global catastrophe but to save the fearsome creature that was once his friend.

items.title: Manam (Dayaalu)
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A married couple die in an accident, leaving behind a son. As he grows up and becomes successful, he comes across reincarnations of his father and mother as youngsters, and vows to bring them back together.

items.title: Sikandar
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A tragic accident pushes the powerful Sikandar to protect the less fortunate by standing up to corruption and greed — using any means necessary.

items.title: Purushothamudu
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Ram (Raj Tarun) returns to India after completing his studies in London. His father (Murali Sharma) decides to make Ram the CEO of their company. However, Vasu (Ramya Krishna), who owns fifty percent shares in the company, disagrees with his proposal. In order to become the CEO, Ram agrees to the condition of quitting his luxurious life and living like a common man for 100 days. The twists and turns in Ram’s life thereafter, Ammulu’s (Hasini Sudheer) entry into his life, and whether or not Ram becomes the CEO form the rest of the story.

items.title: Nishaanchi 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Twin brothers, identical looks but different values, face brotherhood, betrayal, love, and redemption. Their paths weave through crime into a deeper story of human nature and its results.

items.title: Deva
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A rugged and rebellious cop (Shahid Kapoor) investigates a high-profile case, unknowingly unravelling a web of deceit and betrayal.

items.title: ParuParvathy
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Paru (Poonam Sirnaik), a senior citizen estranged from her husband, lives a frustrated life, surrounded by her controlling children and their respective families. Payal (Deepika Das) is a travel enthusiast and vlogger who spends her life moving from one destination to another.

items.title: Sapta Sagaradaache Ello - Side B
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Side B is set 10 years from the events of Side A. Manu's years behind bars has come to an end. He is a free man in a world that has been taken prisoner by the pandemic. Does he go in search of a long lost dream or does he pursue a new life? What choices does he make, and what path does it lead him to? Sapta Sagaradaache Ello - Side B is an interplay of dreams, decisions and destiny.

items.title: The Lord of the Rings - The Fellowship of the Ring
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Young hobbit Frodo Baggins, after inheriting a mysterious ring from his uncle Bilbo, must leave his home in order to keep it from falling into the hands of its evil creator. Along the way, a fellowship is formed to protect the ringbearer and make sure that the ring arrives at its final destination: Mt. Doom, the only place where it can be destroyed.

items.title: Balika Badhu
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In a village circa the British rule in India, lives a young school-going male named Amal, who is shortly to get married to a girl named Rajni. The traditional ritual-filled marriage takes place, the young couple are then left alone for a few days, and this is where the two develop their love and friendship. Then Rajni must return to her parents' house, while Amal continues with his studies in school, and at home with Masterji, an elderly teacher. His life is enlivened occasionally when Rajni is permitted to visit. Rajni next visit is scheduled for Durga Pooja, but she does not come, instead she comes at Vijay Dashami, to stay there for a couple nights, before going on a Tirth Yatra with her family, where they are scheduled to visit all the holy places in India namely, Benaras, Gaya, Mathura, Vrindavan, Hardwar, Nasik, Hrishikesh, Dwarka, Rameshwaram, Kamakshya, Puri, and Konarak.

items.title: Meiyazhagan
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A man makes a bittersweet journey back to his hometown after 22 years and meets an insistent yet kindhearted relative whose name he can't remember.

items.title: RX 100
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The protagonist Shiva who is stubborn and bold meets a tragic end waiting for his ex-girlfriend to return to the village even though she has been married for 3 years. Indu, ex-girlfriend hires paid killers as she was never in love with him.

items.title: Krispy Rishtey
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Karan breaks up with his childhood crush, Natasha, to honour his father's last wish. However, after marrying Anjali, he feels no bond with her and ultimately expresses his desire to escape this forced marriage. What lies ahead for Karan?

items.title: Wicked 2 - For Good
items.subtitle: English
items.description: As an angry mob rises against the Wicked Witch, Glinda and Elphaba will need to come together one final time. With their singular friendship now the fulcrum of their futures, they will need to truly see each other, with honesty and empathy, if they are to change themselves, and all of Oz, for good.

items.title: Argo
items.subtitle: English
items.description: As the Iranian revolution reaches a boiling point, a CIA 'exfiltration' specialist concocts a risky plan to free six Americans who have found shelter at the home of the Canadian ambassador.

items.title: The Girlfriend
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A young woman explores love, compatibility and self-discovery during college, experiencing relationship complexities and personal growth.

items.title: The BFG
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An orphan little girl befriends a benevolent giant who takes her to Giant Country, where they attempt to stop the man-eating giants that are invading the human world.

items.title: Sarvam Maya
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A man who loses his belief in God meets the spirit of a young woman unable to remember what happened to her.

items.title: Our Fault
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Jenna and Lion's wedding brings about the long-awaited reuni0n between Noah and Nick after their breakup. Nick's inability to forgive Noah stands as an insurmountable barrier. He, heir to his grandfather's businesses, and she, starting her professional life, resist fueling a flame that's still alive. But now that their paths have crossed again, will love be stronger than resentment?

items.title: Gatha Vaibhava
