items.subtitle: English
items.description: Gatha Vaibhava is a fantasy drama that weaves together history, mythology, and destiny. When Purathan and Adhunika meet in the present, they embark on a mystical journey through their past lives from the divine realms of Devaloka to Vasco da Gama's voyage and the coastal lands of pre-independence Karnataka. As echoes of the past resurface, they must unravel their fate. Will love endure across lifetimes, or is history doomed to repeat itself?

items.title: Jee Ve Sohneya Jee
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Cross-border love blooms between a wanderlust deliveryman and a solo-adventuring student. Lies lead to tough choices, unveiling an emotional tale of enduring love.

items.title: Rabb Da Radio 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When Manjinder Singh takes his newly wedded wife Guddi to his maternal home, he is heartbroken to realize that things are not what they used to be 16 years back. Once a close-knit family of his four maternal uncles now have walls not only between their houses but within their hearts as well. Manjinder and Guddi vow to reunite the estranged brothers and their families.

items.title: Nishaanchi
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Twin brothers, identical looks but different values, face brotherhood, betrayal, love, and redemption. Their paths weave through crime into a deeper story of human nature and its results.

items.title: Rishte Naate
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Jass’s failing business strains his marriage with Reet. Family drama intensifies when his mother and old friend reunite. Can Jass fix it before it’s too late?

items.title: The Divine Fury
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After losing his father at a young age in a terrible accident, Yong-hu (Park) abandons his faith and chooses to only believe in himself. Now as an adult, Yong-hu is a champion MMA fighter and has everything he has ever wanted, that is until mysterious wounds appear in the palms of his hands..

items.title: John Wick - Chapter 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Retired super-assassin John Wick's (Keany Reeves) plans to resume a quiet civilian life are cut short, when Italian gangster Santino D'Antonio (Riccardo Scamarcio) shows up on his doorstep with a gold marker, compelling him to repay past favours.

items.title: Anveshi
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A food delivery guy, finds himself captivated by Subbu's (Dushara) charm. However, their lives take a tumultuous turn when a series of unexpected events unfold, plunging them into a chaotic world

items.title: Chidiya
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Three restless cousins search for a way to achieve their dream of playing badminton in a little Indian town, overcoming obstacles such like the lack of a play area, the necessary equipment, having to go to work all day and dealing with a single mother and stuck-up neighbors.

items.title: Retro
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Raised by a criminal father, Paarivel Kannan leaves behind his adoptive family to build a quiet life with his love, Rukmini. But his violent past won't let him go.

items.title: Bhadrakaali (Shakthi Thirumagan)
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A tribal woman is brutally assaulted and killed. Her newborn is mercilessly abandoned in a dump yard, left to die. But fate intervenes — an old man discovers the infant and decides to raise him as his own. The child, named Kittu,After the old man’s death, Kittu is left to fend for himself,determined to confront his mother’s killer.

items.title: The Other Boleyn Girl
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A sumptuous and sensual tale of intrigue, romance and betrayal set against the backdrop of a defining moment in European history: two beautiful sisters, Anne and Mary Boleyn, driven by their family's blind ambition, compete for the love of the handsome and passionate King Henry VIII.

items.title: Main Hoon Lucky The Racer (Race Gurram)
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Main Hoon Lucky The Racer is all about two brothers who do things differently. While one brother follows rules and regulations, the other tries to achieve it in his own unique way.

items.title: Boss
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Disowned by his father as a boy, Surya is taken in by a crime boss. When his brother Shiv is wrongly imprisoned, his father pleads for Surya's help.

items.title: The Map That Leads to You
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Heather is a young woman traveling Europe with friends before starting her perfectly planned life. A chance meeting with Jack sparks an unexpected romance that leads to deep emotional discovery. As secrets and life choices test their bond, her path changes forever.

items.title: Lubber Pandhu
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Set against the rural backdrop, explores gully cricket stars Gethu (Dinesh) and Anbu's (Harish Kalyan) intense rivalry. Anbu's romantic involvement with Gethu's daughter escalates the clash. Their skills and emotions are put to the ultimate test.

items.title: Balls Up
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Two marketing executives go "balls out" and pitch a bold full‑coverage condom sponsorship with the World Cup. After their drunken celebration in Brazil sparks a global scandal, they must outrun furious fans, criminals, and power-hungry officials to salvage their careers and make it home alive.

items.title: Shiddat
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A unique love story of Jaggi (Sunny Kausha), who is madly in love with Kartika (Radhika Madan). He decides to swim across the seven oceans to meet her and stop her marriage.

items.title: Radhe Shyam
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Radhe Shyam is a period romance flick in which Vikramaditya (Prabhas) can predict the future. He discovers that Prerana (Pooja Hegde) will die soon but he falls in love with her. The movie showcases to what extent Vikramaditya will go to save her lady love.

items.title: Aadujeevitham - The Goat Life
items.subtitle: English
items.description: An Indian man seeking work follows a job lead to Saudi Arabia, only to find himself forced to labor without pay as a goat herder in the remote desert

items.title: Downton Abbey - The Grand Finale
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When Mary finds herself at the center of a public scandal and the family faces financial strife, the entire household grapples with the threat of social disgrace. The Crawleys must embrace change as the staff prepares for a new chapter with the next generation leading Downton Abbey into the future.

items.title: Bhairathi Ranagal
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The story revolves around the life of Bhairathi Ranagal's journey from being a law-abiding responsible lawyer to the benevolent crime boss of Karnataka.

items.title: Sangathamizhan
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Manoj is a carefree man who discovers his resemblance to a revered social activist. Embracing the activist's legacy, he fights corruption and injustice. Can he live up to his hero's name?

items.title: Kisko Tha Pata
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The story of Kisko Tha Pata revolves around three people.

items.title: Yeh Ballet
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Discovered by an eccentric ballet master, two gifted but underprivileged Mumbai teens face bigotry and disapproval as they pursue their dancing dreams.

items.title: Ek Din
items.subtitle: None
items.description: Dino is in love with his colleague Meera but lacks the courage to express his feelings. He finally gets his chance during the company trip. He makes a wish to be with Meera for just one day, and his wish comes true.

items.title: Hippi
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Devadas is a kick boxer turned techie who wants to break his relationship with Amukta Malyada at any cost. But will she let it happen?

items.title: Pirates of the Caribbean - At World s End
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Elizabeth, Will, and Captain Barbossa rescue Captain Jack Sparrow from Davy Jones locker to unite against the East India Trading Company and free the seas from their control.

items.title: Maanaadu
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A Muslim man, who is stuck in a time loop, has to stop a political rally from taking place in order to save the state's chief minister and prevent religious violence.

items.title: Blue Cave
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Cem, an officer in the navy, embarks on an expedition to the love of his life, Alara’s most beloved archeological site, the Blue Cave, to feel close to her. Engulfed in memories of their love, their struggles, their passion, and their pain, Cem’s journey to the Blue Cave will be illuminating.

items.title: Warcraft
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Humans and orcs clash when Draenor's warriors arrive at Azeroth through a portal in this fantasy tale based on the popular video game.

items.title: Sivaji The Boss
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A software engineer comes to India to serve the nation and invest in nation's welfare. A few corrupt officials and politicians try to stop him while he tries to do good for the poor.

items.title: Anaconda
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A group of friends facing mid-life crises head to the rainforest with the intention of remaking their favorite movie from their youth, only to find themselves in a fight for their lives against natural disasters, giant snakes and violent criminals.

items.title: Criminal or Devil
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In 'Crime or Devil', Siddu is terrified of ghosts. He thinks a ghost haunts him, from which he had previously watched a horror movie. Later, a mentally disturbed woman enters and starts to kidnap girls. Watch to know how they both got connected! Don't miss.

items.title: Tufang
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Veera shoplifts a weapon from a respected gun house, unaware that the shop's heir, Arjan, will track her. Arjan falls for Veera, but she challenges him.

items.title: Sayen Desert Road
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Rallen Montenegro, Enrique Arce, Jorge López

items.title: Sonu Ke Titu Ki Sweety
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Sonu and Titu are childhood friends. Titu has always been a naive lover, who falls in love easily and Sonu has always had to step in to save him. But Sweety is the perfect bride and Titu is head over heels in love with her. Sonu's instinct to protect Titu at whatever cost, makes him feel that she's too good to be true.

items.title: Madam Collector
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Uniki Directed by Rajkumar Bobby. With Chitra Shukla, Ashish Gandhi, Darbha Appaji Ambarisha, Tnr.

items.title: 12th Fail
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Follows the struggles of a student (Vikrant Massey), who attempts the world's toughest competitive exam - UPSC. Based on a true story.

items.title: Rebel
items.subtitle: English
items.description: After His Parents Are Brutally Murdered, Rishi Sets Out On A Quest To Find The Killers. He Finds That His Own Uncle, Who Has Now Disguised Himself As Robert, Is Involved In The Killings.

items.title: Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In this sequel to 2018's Aquaman, Jason Momoa returns as Atlantis king and Justice League member Arthur Curry/ Aquaman. He will have to face new and returning dangers, led by high-seas mercenary David Kane/ Black Manta (Yahya Abdul-Mateen II) and Arthur's half-brother Orm Marius/ Ocean Master (Patrick Wilson).New to Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom are Indya Moore (Pose) as mutated shark with telepathic powers Karshon, and Jani Zhao (Sentimentos) as original character Stingray.

items.title: Darbar
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A police officer on a chase to hunt down a dreaded gangster for fulfilling his own secret agenda.

items.title: Kodi (Dharma Yogi)
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A young politician competes with his ambitious girlfriend in the elections while his twin brother gets forcefully dragged into this battle.

items.title: Single Salma
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A woman from Lucknow, India, who has dedicated her life to supporting her family, yet continues to be identified as single and “unsettled” due to remaining unmarried.

items.title: Anandham Vilayadum Veedu (Bhumi Rakshak)
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Half-brothers Muthupandi and Kasiappan decide to build a home and live together peacefully. But trouble begins when Karuppan, an evil localite, decides to create a rift between the two brothers.

items.title: Rekhachithram
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The investigation of an apparent suicide leads a police officer to a decades-old mystery tied to the disappearance of a young woman last seen on the sets of a classic 1985 Malayalam film. As the probe escalates into a gripping confrontation where'' past and present collide, can the officer uncover the truth behind the crimes? Directed by Jofin T. Chacko, 'Rekhachithram' stars Asif Ali, Anaswara Rajan, Manoj K Jayan, Siddique, Jagadish, Saikumar, Harisree Ashokan and Indrans.

items.title: Officer on Duty
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A demoted police inspector investigates a counterfeit jewelry racket, becoming entangled in a dangerous web of crime that puts his life at stake.

items.title: Yashoda
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A young woman called Yashoda (Samantha Ruth Prabhu) agrees to become a surrogate mother given how financially lucrative it is. But when a trail of risky events expose her to the dark truth behind the surrogacy mafia in India, Yashoda sets out to bring the perpetrators to justice.

items.title: Connect
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The announcement of a nation-wide lock-down due to the spread of COVID-19 pandemic disrupts the peace of a family. What follows is a series of bizarre events as one of them tries to invite the spirit of a family member

items.title: Kaagaz 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The Struggles of a common man whose right to life is infringed upon by protests and rallies.

items.title: Lok Parlok (Yamadonga)
items.subtitle: None
items.description: Raja, an orphaned thief, dies while helping a gang in kidnapping a wealthy heiress, Mahi, in exchange of money. He then lands in Yamlok and fights with Yama, the god of death, to get his life back.

items.title: Crew
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Three women (Kareena Kapoor Khan, Tabu, Kriti Sanon) try to hustle and make their through various situations while navigation the aviation and airline industry, as they find themselves caught in the web of lies.

items.title: Sufiyum Sujatayum
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Sujata (mute) is in love with her neighbour, a sufi priest but her father gets her married off to a well-do-to NRI, in Dubai. Ten years have passed since and she thinks that she’s left that love in her past… until, one day, she gets a call. Her husband (Rajeev) decides to bring her back to the village. What follows, forms the crux of Sufiyum Sujathayum, a musical love story.

items.title: Kerebete
items.subtitle: English
items.description: The annual Kerebete fishing event brings together the people of a Karnataka village. During the festivities, a controversial relationship causes tensions.

items.title: Blind Spot
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When 24-year-old Divya is found dead, what seems like a suicide soon spirals into a complex murder mystery. Officer Vikram, known for his sharp instincts, dives into a tangled web of motives involving her husband, stepchildren, and maid. As secrets unravel and lies collide, Vikram must race against time to unmask the killer in a house full of suspects.

items.title: Yuddhakaanda Chapter 2
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A hotel cashier turned lawyer, Bharath Hanumanth, navigates his early career in a small law firm while defending Niveditha in a high-stakes courtroom case. He faces off against his former mentor in a story exploring justice.

items.title: Maharaja
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When his prized possession gets stolen, a barber seeks help from the police, who jeer at his request — until they learn what they're really looking for.

items.title: Raees
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Raees (Shubham Chintamani) is a young sharp-minded boy, who lives in Fatehpur, Gujarat, and gets involved in the illegal liquor trade from a young age. Over time, Raees (Shah Rukh Khan) gains popularity in his community and becomes the bootlegging king of Fatehpur, Gujarat. As he tries to balance his criminal life with helping the people of his community, he unknowingly falls in a political trap.

items.title: Mutants
items.subtitle: English
items.description: In 2150, artificial intelligence mutated and replaced humans' control of the earth, and launched an eradication operation against humans. The surviving humans united together to form a resistance army, and with simple weapons, they fought a desperate battle with the artificial intelligence army.

items.title: Robin Hood
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A war-hardened Crusader and his Moorish commander mount an audacious revolt against the corrupt English crown.

items.title: Inspector Zende
items.subtitle: English
items.description: When serial killer Carl Bhojraj escapes prison and resurfaces in Mumbai, the determined Inspector Zende steps up to nab the cunning fugitive once more.

items.title: Legally Veer
items.subtitle: English
items.description: A gripping murder case in Hata City tests the limits of justice. Veer, an aspiring lawyer, takes on a high-stakes defense against a criminal charge, battling through courtroom revelations and twists.

items.title: The Conjuring - Last Rites
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren take on one last terrifying case involving mysterious entities they must confront.

items.title: Siya
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Siya, a 17-year-old rape survivor, decides to go against all odds and fight for justice after being held captive and repeatedly abused by a group of powerful men. Can she win against the perpetrators?

items.title: Sergeant
items.subtitle: English

Andy's toys mount a daring rescue mission, Buzz Lightyear meets his match and Woody has to decide where he and his heart truly belong.

items.title: Toy Story 4

But after Bonnie creates a reluctant new toy called "Forky", a road trip adventure alongside old and new friends challenges everything Woody believes about loyalty, purpose, and what it truly means to be a toy.

items.title: Toy Story
items.subtitle: English
items.description: Led by Woody, Andy's toys live happily in his room until Andy's birthday brings Buzz Lightyear onto the scene. Afraid of losing his place in Andy's heart, Woody plots against Buzz. But when circumstances separate Buzz and Woody from their owner, the duo eventually learns to put aside their differences.
